sanskrit: nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānāpakṣiravairyute śaityasaugandhyamāndyāḍhyamarudbhirupavījite sthiracchāyadrumacchāyācchādite snigdhamañjule sarvadā svagaṇaiḥ sārddhamṛturājaniṣevite śabdairyukte marudbhirvāyubhirupavījite sārddhamṛturājena vasantena niṣevite tatra maunadharaṃ devaṃ carācarajagadgurum karpūrakundadhavalaṃ śuddhasattvamayaṃ vibhum gaṅgāśīkarasaṃsiktajaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam trilocanaṃ trilokeśaṃ triśūlavaradhāriṇam jaṅgamānāmacarāṇāṃ sthāvarāṇāñca jagatāṃ pitaram vyāpakam saṃsiktena jaṭāmaṇḍalena jaṭāsamūhena maṇḍitam nirvikalpaṃ nirātaṅkaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ nirañjanam vinayāvanatā devī pārvatī śivamabravīt tvadadhīnā'smi deveśa tavā'jñākāriṇī sadā tadā nivedyate kiñcinmanasā yadvicāritam nirañjanaṃ aviduṣāmapratyakṣam śakyate || 11 chettā bhavitumarho vā sarvajñaḥ sarvaśāstravit yadakathyaṃ gaṇeśe'pi skande senāpatāvapi kimasti triṣu lokeṣu gopanīyaṃ tavāgrataḥ sarvajñā kiṃ na jānāsi tvanabhijñeva pṛcchasi vinayāvanatā sādhvī paripapraccha śaṅkaram

pañcamyantaṃ bhinnaṃ vā padam yogyatvamastīti sūcitam upasaṃkhyānamiti saptamyantāt svārthe tasiḥ anabhijñeva aviduṣī iva || 16 kṛpāvatā bhagavatā brahmāntaryāminā purā varṇāśramādiniyamā yatra caiva pratiṣṭhitāḥ devān pitṝn prīṇayantaḥ puṇyaśīlāḥ kṛte yuge mahābalā mahāvīryyā mahāsattvaparākramāḥ kṛpāvatetyādi pañcamaślokasthitena padenānvayaḥ satyadharmaparāḥ sarve sādhavaḥ satyavādinaḥ mātṛvat parayoṣitsu putravat parasūnuṣu āsan svadharmaniratāḥ sadā sanmārgavarttinaḥ na caurā na paradrohakārakā na durāśayāḥ sadantaḥkaraṇāḥ sarve sarvadā'nandamānasāḥ mahāsattvaparākramāḥ tasya vaktāraḥ parayoṣitsu parastrīṣu parasūnuṣu anyaputreṣu || 23 durāśayā na duṣṭābhiprāyāḥ hṛdayaṃ yeṣānte gāvo'pi dugdhasampannāḥ pādapāḥ phalaśālinaḥ striyo na vyabhicāriṇyaḥ patibhaktiparāyaṇaḥ svaiḥ svairdharmairyajantaste nistārapadavīṃ gatāḥ vedoktakarmabhirmartyā na śaktāḥ sveṣṭasādhane kartuṃ na yogyā manujāścintāvyākulamānasāḥ

vedārthayuktaśāstrāṇi smṛtirūpāṇi bhūtale lokānatārayaḥ pāpāt duḥkhaśokāmayapradāt bhūmaya iti | parjjanyā meghāḥ tejorūpaguṇānvitāḥ tejasā rūpeṇa anyaiśca guṇairyuktāḥ brāhmaṇā ityādi | yajantaḥ parameśvaramarcayantaḥ bharttā pātā samuddharttā pitṛvat priyakṛt prabhuḥ saṃhitādyupadeśena tvayaivoddhāritā narāḥ durācāre duṣprapañce duṣṭakarmapravartake bodhyam | ādhirmānasī vyathā āyāte ityādi | durācāre duṣṭa ācāro yatra tasmin nānetihāsayuktānāṃ nānāmārgapradarśinām tadā lokā bhaviṣyanti dharmakarmavahirmukhāḥ kāmukā lolupāḥ krūrā niṣṭhurā durmukhāḥ śaṭhāḥ niḥśrīkā nirbalā nīcā nīcācāraparāyaṇāḥ paranindāparadrohaparivādaparāḥ khalāḥ nirdhanā malinā dīnā daridrāścirarogiṇaḥ ayājyayājakā lubdhā durvṛttāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ netyādi | prabhavaḥ samarthāḥ || 37 durmukhāḥ abaddhamukhāḥ | śaṭhāḥ anṛjavaḥ karmadhārayaḥ nīceti | khalā durjanāḥ kanyāvikrayiṇo vrātyāstapovrataparāṅmukhāḥ pāṣaṇḍāḥ paṇḍitammanyāḥ śraddhābhaktivivarjitāḥ śūdrānnabhojinaḥ krūrā vṛṣalīratikāmukāḥ brāhmaṇyacihnametāvat kevalaṃ sūtradhāraṇam

dharmaśāstre sadā nindā sādhudrohī nirantaram tvayā kṛtāni tantrāṇi jīvoddhāraṇahetave viprā bhaviṣyantīti pūrveṇānvayaḥ prītijanakavyāpāraḥ tābhyāṃ hīnāḥ kathitā bahavo nyāsāḥ sṛṣṭisthityādilakṣaṇāḥ paśuvīradivyabhāvā devatā mantrasiddhidāḥ latāsādhanakarmāṇi tvayoktāni sahasraśaḥ kalau na paśubhāvo'sti divyabhāvaḥ kuto bhavet na śūdradarśanaṃ kuryyāt manasā na striyaṃ smaret dvandvātīto vītarāgaḥ sarvabhūtasamaḥ kṣamī sṛṣṭisthityādisvarūpāḥ muktapadmāsanādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ mṛtaśarīrāsanam || 52 dvābhyām | patramityādi | āharet ānayet nidrālasyaprasaktānāṃ bhāvaśuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet etāni pañcatattvāni tvayā proktāni śaṅkara lobhāttatra patiṣyanti na kariṣyanti sādhanam bhaviṣyanti madonmattā hitāhitavivarjitāḥ tadvān pratipādayitumāha | kalītyādi madyamāṃsādīni pañcatattvāni ca tvayā proktānītyanvayaḥ kalijā iti | tatra madyādipañcatattveṣu indriyāṇāmiti | madhu madyam na kariṣyanti te mattāḥ pāpāyonivicāraṇam śaktihīnā buddhihīnā bhūtvā ca vikalendriyāḥ

patiṣyanti mariṣyanti manujā madavihvalāḥ kecinmaunā mṛtaprāyā apare bahujalpakāḥ hitāya yāni karmāṇi kathitāni tvayā prabho ke vā yogaṃ kariṣyanti nyāsajātāni ke'pi vā bhaviṣyantyatidurvṛttāḥ sarvathā pāpakāriṇaḥ āyurārogyavarcasyaṃ balavīryavibarddhanam yena lokā bhaviṣyanti mahābalaparākramāḥ svadāraniṣṭhāḥ puruṣāḥ parastrīṣu parāṅmukhāḥ devatāgurubhaktāśca putrasvajanapoṣakāḥ siddhyarthaṃ lokayātrāyāḥ kathayasva hitāya yat vinā tvāṃ sarvalokānāṃ kastrātā bhuvanatraye jīvanistāropāyapraśno nāma prathamollāsaḥ ārogyāya varcase tejase ca hitam prajñāvantaḥ | lokayātrāyāḥ lokanirvāhasya || 71 kathayāmāsa tattvena mahākāruṇyavāridhiḥ etādṛśaḥ śubhaḥ praśno na kenāpi kṛtaḥ purā yadyaduktaṃ tvayā bhadre satyaṃ satyaṃ yathārthataḥ bhūtaṃ bhavadbhaviṣyañca dharmayuktaṃ tvayā priye mahākāruṇyavāridhiḥ mahādayāsamudraḥ sarvajñetyādi | bhavat vartamānam kalikalmaṣadīnānāṃ dvijādīnāṃ sureśvari na saṃhitādyaiḥ smṛtibhiriṣṭasiddhirnṛṇāṃ bhavet vinā hyāgamamārgeṇa kalau nāsti gatiḥ priye āgamoktavidhānena kalau devān yajet sudhīḥ na tasya gatirastīti satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

pratipādyo'smi nānyo'sti prabhurjagati māṃ vinā satyamiti | hītyavadhāraṇe mayaivoktamityanvayaḥ || 8 bodhayitavyaḥ manmārgavimukhā lokāḥ pāṣaṇḍā brahmaghātinaḥ niṣphalaṃ tadbhaveddevi kartā'pi nārakī bhavet brahmahā pitṛhā strīghnaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ śastāḥ karmasu sarveṣu japayajñakriyādiṣu satyādau saphalā āsan kalau te mṛtakā iva brahmaghātino bhaveyuriti śeṣaḥ tattatphalapradātṛtvāccātiprāśastyamāha kalāvityādibhiḥ tattatphalāniṣpādakāśca boddhavyā ityanvayaḥ amūraśaktāḥ kāryeṣu tathānye mantrarāśayaḥ na tatra phalasiddhiḥ syāt śrama eva hi kevalam tṛṣito jāhnavītīre kūpaṃ khanati durmatiḥ amṛtaṃ svagṛhe tyaktvā kṣīramārkaṃ sa vāñchati yathā tantrodito mārgo mokṣāya ca sukhāya ca siddhānāṃ sādhakānāñca vidhānāni ca bhūriśaḥ niścitametat || 17 vāñchati | ārkam arkavṛkṣodbhavam nānya iti | amutra pare loke || 20 kulācāroditaṃ dharmaṃ guptyarthaṃ kathitaṃ kvacit devā nānāvidhāḥ proktā devyo'pi bahudhāḥ priye śāktāḥ śaivā vaiṣṇavāśca saurā gāṇapatādayaḥ bhūriprayāsasādhyāni yathoktaphaladāni ca

tadā tasyopakārāya tathaivoktaṃ mayā priye yugadharmānusāreṇa yāthātathyena pārvati tava snehena vakṣyāmi sārātsāraṃ parātparaṃ kulācāroktaṃ dharmaṃ guptyarthaṃ kathitam apītyasya jīvapravṛttikārīṇītyatrānvayaḥ kartavyaḥ || 23 tāni sāramuddhṛtya deveśi tavāgre kathyate mayā yathā'haṃ tridiveśānāmāgamānāmidaṃ tathā vijñāte'smin mahātantre sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet ataste kathayiṣyāmi yadviśvahitakṛdbhavet prīto bhavati viśvātmā yato viśvaṃ tadāśritam vedānāmityādi | sāraṃ sthirāṃśam mahānirvāṇatantram || 30 yata ityādi | viniyojitaḥ pravartitaḥ vartate'to viśvātmā sa bhavati svaprakāśaḥ sadāpūrṇaḥ saccidānandalakṣaṇaḥ guṇātītaḥ sarvasākṣī sarvātmā sarvadṛgvibhuḥ sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaḥ sarvendriyavivarjitaḥ cidānandau jñānānandau tatsvarūpaḥ prāptasamastaiśvaryaḥ cakṣurādisakalendriyaśūnyaḥ sa vetti viśvaṃ sarvajñastaṃ na jānāti kaścana tadālambanatastiṣṭhedavitarkyamidaṃ jagat tenaiva hetubhūtena vayaṃ jātā maheśvari lokeṣu sṛṣṭikaraṇāt sraṣṭā brahmeti gīyate

indrādayo lokapālāḥ sarve tadvaśavartinaḥ tvaṃ parā prakṛtistasya pūjyā'si bhuvanatraye tadbhinnastvakhilaḥ padārtho'nevambhūtatvādasatya ityarthaḥ prakāśate ityanvayaḥ | vayaṃ śaṅkarādayaḥ || 38 svasvakarma prakurvanti na svatantrāḥ kadācana varṣanti toyadāḥ kāle puṣpanti taravo vane vedāntavedyo bhagavān yattacchabdopalakṣitaḥ ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ tanmayaṃ sakalaṃ jagat tadārādhanato devi sarveṣāṃ prīṇanaṃ bhavet viṣaye pravartitāḥ | na svatantrāḥ na svādhīnāḥ || 43 bodhitaḥ parabrahmasvarūpaṃ bhavati tasminnityādi | ata iti śeṣaḥ | tasmin paramātmani tṛpyanti tadanuṣṭhānāt tathā sarve'marādayaḥ bhavanti tuṣṭāḥ sundaryastathā jānīhi suvrate tathārcādīni karmāṇi taduddeśyāni pārvati tattaddadāti so'dhyakṣastaistairdevagaṇaiḥ śive dhyeyaḥ pūjyaḥ sukhārādhyastaṃ vinā nāsti muktaye naivā'cārādiniyamo nopacārāśca bhūriśaḥ tadanuṣṭhānāt parameśvarārādhanāt yathetyādi | pūjanāt mānasārcanāt yeṣāmarcādikarmaṇāṃ tāni adhyakṣaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tattatkriyāsu pravartakaḥ bahunetyādi | sukhenārādhya upāsyaḥ sukhārādhyaḥ pariśramaḥ

yatsādhane kuleśāni taṃ vinā ko'nyamāśrayet jīvanistāropāyapraśno nāma dvitīyollāsaḥ taṃ paramātmānam vaktā tvaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ sādhanasya ca yasyopāsanato martyo bhuktiṃ muktiñca vindati kiṃ tasya sādhanaṃ deva mantraḥ ko vā prakīrtitaḥ tattvena śrotumicchāmi kṛpayā kathaya prabho tava snehena vakṣyāmi mama prāṇādhikaṃ param tathā tattvasvarūpeṇa lakṣaṇairvā maheśvari asattrilokīsadbhānaṃ svarūpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛtam dvandvātītairnirvikalpairdehātmādhyāsavarjitaiḥ yāthārthye iti kośaḥ | rahasyaṃ guhyam padārtho yaiḥ tāni lakṣaṇāni taiḥ | karaṇe lyuṭ sadvadjñānaṃ yasmāt tadbrahmaṇaḥ svarūpaṃ smṛtam yasmin sarvāṇi līyante jñeyaṃ tadbrahma lakṣaṇaiḥ lakṣaṇairāptumicchūnāṃ vihitaṃ tatra sādhanam tatrādau kathayāmyādye mantroddhāraṃ maheśituḥ yogāḥ samyagdarśanādayo yeṣāṃ taiḥ samādhiyogairjanaiḥ taṭasthairetairlakṣaṇairjñeyaṃ veditavyam sādhanaṃ vihitam maheśiturmaheśvarasya mantroddhāraṃ kathayāmi ekaṃ padānte brahmeti mantroddhāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ tārahīnena deveśi ṣaḍvarṇo'yaṃ manurbhavet nātra siddhādyapekṣā'sti nārimitrādidūṣaṇam sarvathā siddhamantro'yaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā

tadā tadvaktrato jñātvā janmasāphalyamāpnuyāt mantroddhāro'yameva prakīrtitaḥ kathitaḥ praṇavatyāgenāyaṃ pūrvokta eva manuḥ ṣaḍvarṇo bhavet sākṣādityādinā na tithiriti | tithirna gaṇanīyeti śeṣaḥ mantramimaṃ jñātvā p. 31) caturvargaṃ kare kṛtvā paratreha ca modate sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ yasya karṇapathopāntaprāpto mantramahāmaṇiḥ gāyanti gāyanīṃ gāthāṃ pulakāñcitavigrahāḥ kimasmākaṃ gayāpiṇḍaiḥ kiṃ tīrthaiḥ śrāddhatarpaṇaiḥ vayamakṣayatṛptāḥ sma satputrasyāsya sādhanāt pāṭhe'pyaṅkitaṃ cihnitamityarthaḥ] avinaśvaratṛptimantraḥ || 21 parabrahmopāsakānāṃ kimanyaiḥ sādhanāntaraiḥ brahmabhūtasya deveśi kimavāpyaṃ jagattraye tasya darśanamātreṇa palāyante parāṅmukhāḥ kiṃ vibheti grahādibhyo mārtaṇḍa iva cāparaḥ vidravanti ca naśyanti pataṅgā iva pāvake ko vopadravamanvicchedātmāpaghātakaṃ vinā śṛṇvityādi | sādhanāntaraiḥ sādhanaviśeṣaiḥ iva śalabhā iva || 27 || śuddhasya nirmalāntaḥkaraṇasya svadrohaṃ te prakurvanti nātiriktā yataḥ sataḥ tasyāniṣṭe kṛte devi ko vā syānnirupadravaḥ śatalakṣaprajapto'pi tasya mantro na siddhyati

akāreṇa jagatpātā saṃhartā syādukārataḥ sacchabdena sadā sthāyi ciccaitanyaṃ prakīrtitam mantrārthaḥ kathito devi sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhidaḥ || 29 || sa tu brahmaniṣṭhastu prathamataḥ praṇavārthaṃ nirūpayati akāreṇetyādinā || 31 atha saccidādipadārthamāha sacchabdenetyādinā || 33 tajjñānaṃ parameśāni bhaktānāṃ siddhidāyakam avitarkyaṃ nirātaṅkaṃ vācātītaṃ nirañjanam dīyate vividhā vidyā māyā śrīḥ sarvatomukhī yugmayugmakrameṇā'pi mantro'yaṃ vividho bhavet bhaktānāṃ siddhidāyakaṃ bhavet mantrasyādhiṣṭhātṛ bhavet saccidekaṃ brahmetyanena tu śrīriti devatā paramaṃ brahma sarvāntaryāmi nirguṇam aṅganyāsakaranyāsau kathayāmi śṛṇu priye aṅguṣṭhatarjanīmadhyānāmikāsu maheśvari namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ hū/ vauṣaṭ phaḍantairyathākramam cidbrahma | ekaṃ brahma | saccit | cidekamiti aṅganyāsetyādi || 39 hṛdādikaraparyantamevameva vidhīyate madhyamānāmikābhyāñca dakṣahastasya pārvati pūayet pavanaṃ mantrī mūlamaṣṭamitaṃ japan japeddvātriṃśatā'vṛttyā tato dakṣiṇanāsayā vāmanāsāpuṭe'pyevaṃ pūrakumbhakarecakam prāṇāyāmavidhiḥ prokto brahmamantrasya sādhane

p. 37) tato dhyānaṃ prakurvīta sādhakābhīṣṭasādhanam sakalabhuvanabījaṃ brahma caitanyamīḍe tata ityādinā pūjayet parayā bhaktyā brahmasāyujyahetave naivedyaṃ toyatattvena pradadyāt paramātmane samarpya brahmaṇe paścādvahiḥpūjāṃ samārabhet vastrālaṅkaraṇādīni bhakṣyapeyāni yāni ca nimīlya netre matimānarpayet paramātmane brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhinā sakalabhuvanabījaṃ samastasya bhuvanasya kāraṇam gandhamityādinā || 51 tajjapaṃ brahmasāt kṛtvā stotrañca kavacaṃ paṭhet yat śrutvā sādhako devi brahmasāyujyamaśnute namo brahmaṇe vyāpine nirguṇāya brahmaiva gantavyaṃ prāptavyaṃ na tu phalāntaramityarthaḥ brahmasāt brahmādhīnam stotramiti | brahmasāyujyamaśnute brahmatvaṃ prāpnoti sattvādiguṇarahitāya tvamekaṃ paraṃ niścalaṃ nirvikalpam pareṣāṃ paraṃ rakṣakaṃ rakṣakāṇām jagadbhāsakādhīśa pāyādapāyāt śreṣṭham | nirvikalpaṃ nānāvidhakalpanāśūnyam pareṣāṃ śreṣṭhānāmapi bhaktibuddhyādiviśleṣāt bhavāmbhodhipotaṃ śaraṇyaṃ vrajāmaḥ

yaḥ paṭhet prayato bhūtvā brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt śrāvayedbodhayet prājño brahmaniṣṭhān svabāndhavān paṭhanāddhāraṇād yasya brahmajño jāyate dhruvam kaṇṭhaṃ pātu jagatpātā vadanaṃ sarvadṛgvibhuḥ sarvāṅgaṃ sarvadā pātu paraṃ brahma sanātanam jagadāśrayabhūtam | nirālambam āśrayaśūnyam pañcaratnamityādinā | prayataḥ pavitraḥ || adaḥ stotram || 64 paṭhitavyamatastadabhidhātumupakramate itīti caitanyarūpaḥ || 67 caturvargaphalāvāptyai viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ sa brahmajñānamāsādya sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavet kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāho sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet dadyāt priyāya śiṣyāya gurubhaktāya dhīmate paṭhitvā stotrakavacaṃ praṇamet sādhakāgraṇīḥ nirguṇāya namastubhyaṃ sadrūpāya namo namaḥ ārādhane pareśasya bhāvaśuddhirvidhīyate mahāprasādaṃ svīkuryād brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ sarvatra sarvakāleṣu sādhayed brahmasādhanam pūjayet paramātmānaṃ sadā nirmalamānasaḥ dīyate parameśāya tadeva pāvanaṃ mahat parabrahmārpite dravye spṛṣṭāspṛṣṭaṃ na vidyate ārādhana ityādi | bhāvaśuddhirantaḥkaraṇaśuddhatvam śālagrāmaśilādau || 79 sādhako brahmasāt kṛtvā bhuñjīyāt svajanaiḥ saha na kālaniyamo'pyatra śaucāśaucaṃ tathaiva ca

brahmasāt kṛtanaivedyamaśnīyādavicārayan tadannaṃ pāvanaṃ devi devānāmapi durlabham parameśasya naivedyasevanād yat phalaṃ bhavet sakṛt prasādagrahaṇāt mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ tat phalaṃ labhate martyo brahmārpitaniṣevaṇāt bhakṣite brahma naivedye tasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ labhet mahāprasādamāhātmyaṃ varṇituṃ naiva śakyate gṛhītvā kīkaśo vā'pi brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt tadannaṃ brāhmaṇairgrāhyamapi vedāntapāragaiḥ yo'śuddhabuddhiṃ kurute sa mahāpātakī bhavet parabrahmārpite hyanne na kuryādavahelanam annatoyādikaṃ bhadre pitṝṃste pātayantyadhaḥ brahmasātkṛtanaivedyadveṣṭṝṇāṃ nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ svecchācāro'tra vihito mahāmantrasya sādhane yatretyādi | amṛtam śīdhu | kīkaśo vāpi cāṇḍālo'pi bhāvitaṃ cintitaṃ brahmaṇe'rpitamityarthaḥ || 91 klīvaṃ manāk priye ityamaraḥ | avahelanam tiraskāram || 93 pralayakālaparyantamityarthaḥ | niṣkṛtirnistāraḥ ivācarantītyarthaḥ brahmaniṣṭhasya viduṣaḥ svecchācāro vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ na vighnaḥ pratyavāyo,asya brahmamantrasya sādhanāt paropakāranirato nirvikāraḥ sadāśayaḥ mātāpitroḥ prītikārī tayoḥ sevanatatparaḥ yatātmā dṛḍhabuddhiḥ syāt sākṣādbrahmeti bhāvayan parastrīgamanañcaiva brahmamantrī vivarjayet

brahmārpaṇamastu vākyaṃ pānabhojanakarmaṇoḥ tadeva kāryaṃ brahmajñairidaṃ dharmaṃ sanātanam eva vidhiḥ | asya brahmaniṣṭhasya || 97 mātāpitroḥ || 99 yāṃ kṛtvā brahmasampattiṃ labhante bhuvi mānavāḥ pūrvavat paramabrahma dhyātvā sādhakasattamaḥ japaṃ samarpya vidhivat pūrvavat praṇamet sudhīḥ yadanuṣṭhānato mantrī śuddhāntaḥkaraṇo bhavet parameśvaraṃ ṅe'ntamuktvā vidmahe tadanantaram iyaṃ śrībrahmagāyatrī caturvargapradāyinī yadyatkarma prakurvīta brahmamantreṇa sādhayet pūrvavat praṇamed brahma prātaḥkṛtyamidaṃ smṛtam taddaśāṃśena havanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ brāhmaṇān bhojayenmantrī puraścaraṇakarmaṇi na kālaśuddhiniyamo na vā sthānanirūpaṇam brahmetyādimantram || 111 sādhayet paramaṃ mantraṃ svecchācāreṇa sādhakaḥ vinā nyāsaṃ vinā mudrāṃ vinā setuṃ varānane akasmāt paramabrahmasākṣātkāro bhaved dhruvam sādhane brahmamantrasya bhāvaśuddhirvidhīyate mahāmanoḥ sādhane tu vyaṅgaṃ sāṅgāyate dhruvam nistārabījametāvat brahmamantrasya sādhanam kalau durbalajīvānāmasādhyāni maheśvari pratyavāyo na bhavet | vyaṅgam aṅgahīnamapi || 120 yadyapi tathāpītyadhyāhāryam

lubdhā dhanārjane vyagrāḥ sadā cañcalamānasāḥ teṣāṃ hitāya mokṣāya brahmamārgo'yamīritaḥ brahmadīkṣāṃ vinā devi kaivalyāya sukhāya ca parabrahmopāsane tu sādhakecchāvidhiḥ śive svecchācāreṇeṣṭasiddhistadvinā ko'nyamāśrayet dhṛtvā taccaraṇāmbhojaṃ prārthayed bhaktibhāvataḥ śeṣaḥ | annādhīnāsavaḥ annavaśībhūtaprāṇāḥ kalāvityādi prātariti | sādhakecchaiva vidhiḥ | yatra parabrahmopāsane tvatpadāmbhoruhacchāyāṃ dehi mūrdhni yaśodhana kṛtāñcalipuṭo bhūtvā tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhet guroḥ puraḥ āhūya kṛpayā dadyāt sacchiṣyāya mahāmanum svavāme śiṣyamānīya kāruṇyenā'valokayet japedaṣṭaśataṃ mantraṃ sādhakasyeṣṭasiddhaye saptadhā śrāvayet mantraṃ sadguruḥ karuṇānidhiḥ nātra pūjādyapekṣā'sti saṃkalpaṃ mānasañcaret vinītaścetyādikam kṛpāyuktayā dṛṣṭyā dakṣetyādi | vāmataḥ vāme karṇe | mantram pūrvoktameva upadeśeti | atra brahmamantropadeśavidhau | caret kuryāt utthāpayed guruḥ snehādimaṃ mantramudīrayan jitendriyaḥ satyavādī valārogyaṃ sadā'stu te gurorājñāvaśībhūtvā vihareddevavad bhuvi brahmabhūtasya deveśi kimanyairbahusādhanaiḥ gurukāruṇyamātreṇa brahmadīkṣāṃ samāśrayet

viprā vipretarāścaiva sarve'pyatrādhikāriṇaḥ taṃ mantramevāha uttiṣṭha vatsetyādi || 136 tata iti | svaṃ dhanam ātmānaṃ vā brahmasvarūpaḥ gurvityādi ityādinā | atra brahmamantre svecchācārī nirvikalpo mantrasyā'sya prasādataḥ brahmā brahmarṣayaścāpi devā devarṣayastathā upāsitā brahmabhūtāḥ paramātmaprasādataḥ svīyamantraṃ gururdadyāt śiṣyebhyo hyavicārayan mātulo bhāgineyāṃśca naptṝn mātāmaho'pi ca ahamityādinā | ahaṃ mṛtyuñjayo'bhavamiti śeṣaḥ nāradādayaḥ rājarṣayo janakādayaḥ siddhe brahmamahāmantre taddoṣo naiva vidyate brahmabhūto naraḥ pūtaḥ puṇyapāpairna lipyate svasvavarṇottamārate tu pūjyā mānyā viśeṣataḥ tasmāt sarve pūjayeyurbrahmajñān brahmadīkṣitān patanti ghoranarake yāvadbhāskaratārakam tasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ pāpaṃ brahmopāsakanindanāt ityādi | yo doṣaḥ ukta iti śeṣaḥ || 147 dvitīyātatpuruṣaḥ bhaveyuḥ | itare kṣatriyādayaḥ gacchanti brahmasāyujyaṃ tathaiva tava sādhanāt tṛtīyollāsaḥ

brahmasāyujyam brahmatvam paramānandasampannā śaṅkaraṃ paripṛcchati sarvalokapriyakaraṃ sākṣādbrahmapadapradam tṛptā'smi jagadīśāna tava vākyāmṛtaplutā gacchanti brahmasāyujyaṃ tathaiva mama sādhanāt kathitaṃ yadityādi || 1 vāgamṛtaplutā tāvakīnavāgrūpapīyūṣe nimagnā brahmasāyujyajananaṃ yattvayā kathitaṃ prabho mantraḥ ko vā'tra vihito dhyānapūjādikañca kim ko hyanyastvāmṛte śambho bhavavyādhibhiṣagguruḥ uvāca parayā prītyā pārvatīṃ pārvatīpatiḥ tava sādhanato yena brahmasāyujyamaśnute dvitīyaślokagataiḥ padairanvayaḥ tvayā kathitaṃ tacca kīdṛśaṃ vartate etadapi veditumicchāmi tasya madīyasādhanasya | atra mama sādhane janmarūpasya vyādheścikitsakarājaḥ itītyādi | uvāca uttaramiti śeṣaḥ śṛṇvityanvayaḥ tvatto jātaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tvaṃ jagajjananī śive tvayaivotpāditaṃ bhadre tvadadhīnamidaṃ jagat tvaṃ jānāsi jagat sarvaṃ na tvāṃ jānāti kaścana dhūmāvatī tvaṃ bagalā bhairavī chinnamastakā sarvaśaktisvarūpā tvaṃ sarvadevamayī tanuḥ sākṣātparā'tyutkṛṣṭā prakṛtirasītyevamanvayaḥ kāryaḥ mahattattvamādiryasya tanmahadādi

tanuḥ taveti śeṣaḥ nirākārā'pi sākārā kastvāṃ veditumarhati dānavānāṃ vināśāya dhatse nānāvidhāstanūḥ tvameva viśvarakṣārthaṃ nānāśastrāstradhāriṇī kathitaṃ sarvatantreṣu bhāvāśca kathitāstrayaḥ vīrasādhanakarmāṇi pratyakṣāṇi kalau yuge tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sādhayet kulasādhanam brahmajñānayuto martyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ bhavati na ko'pītyarthaḥ nānāvidhāstanūreva darśayannāha caturbhujetyādi || 17 brahmajñāne samutpanne medhyāmedhyaṃ na vidyate kimastyamedhyaṃ tasyāgre sarvaṃ brahmeti jānataḥ tuṣṭāyāṃ tvayi deveśi sarveṣāṃ toṣaṇaṃ bhavet tvatto jātaṃ jagat sarvaṃ parabrahmasisṛkṣayā nimittamātraṃ tadbrahma sarvakāraṇakāraṇam sadaikarūpaṃ cinmātraṃ nirliptaṃ sarvavastuṣu satyaṃ jñānamanādyantamavāṅmanasagocaram ākṛtiśūnyatvāt vāṅmanasayorapyaviṣayabhūtam kāraṇaṃ nimittabhūtam karoṣi pāsi haṃsyante jagadetaccarācaram mahāsaṃhārasamaye kālaḥ sarvaṃ grasiṣyati mahākālasya kalanāt tvamādyā kālikā parā kālatvādādibhūtatvādādyā kālīti gīyate vācātītaṃ manogamyaṃ tvamekaivā'vaśiṣyase tvaṃ sarvādiranādistvaṃ kartrī hartrī ca pālikā

kāraṇam anto nāśaśca yasya tathābhūtam pralayakāle || 29 kāraṇasvarūpā atikrāntavāk | mano'gamyam manaso'pyaprāpyam yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tatphalaṃ tava sādhanāt vibhedāt kathitaṃ devi kutracidguptasādhanam bhaviṣyanti tariṣyanti mānuṣā gatakilviṣāḥ kulācāreṇa pūtātmā sākṣācchivamayo bhavet yoge'pi bhogavirahaḥ kaulastūbhayamaśnute ityādinā nānābhāvena ca | vibhedāt viśeṣāt | kutracit tantrādiṣu ya iti | yatra guptasādhane vyaktasādhane vā sākṣācchivamayaḥ sākṣācchivasvarūpaḥ ubhayamaśnute yogaṃ bhogañca labhate sarve devāśca devyaśca pūjitā nātra saṃśayaḥ tasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate kaulikārcanāt kulācāravihīnastu brāhmaṇaḥ śvapacādhamaḥ yasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa brahmajñānī naro bhavet sarvadharmottamāt kaulāt paro dharmo na vidyate vyaktībhaviṣyatyacirāt saṃvṛtte prabale kalau na sthāsyati vinā kaulān paśavo mānavā bhuvi na sthāsyati varārohe tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ eka ityādi | pūjitāḥ teneti śeṣaḥ || 40 śvapaca ityādi | atiricyate uttamatāvattvādviśiṣyate yasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇetyādi || 43

pravṛtte || 45 na sthāsyati śive śānte tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ bhaviṣyati kuleśāni tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ bhaviṣyanti mahāprājñe tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ garhiṣyanti ca bhartāraṃ tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ druhyanti gurumitrādīn tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ asamyakphalino vṛkṣāstadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ mithaḥ samprahariṣyanti tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ gūḍhapānaṃ cariṣyanti tadaiva pravalaḥ kaliḥ śānte he saṃyatacitte || 48 || surataraṅgiṇī gaṅgā || 53 || dhanakaṇehayā vittaleśākāṅkṣayā tadaiva pravalaḥ kalirjñātavyaḥ kalāvapi tathā kuryāt kulavartmānusārataḥ vyaktācārā dayāśīlā na hi tān bādhate kaliḥ anuraktāḥ svadāreṣu na hi tān bādhate kaliḥ kulasādhanasatyā ye na hi tān bādhate kaliḥ ye dadyuḥ satyavacase na hi tān bādhate kaliḥ kuladharmeṣu niṣṭhā ye na hi tān bādhate kaliḥ kurvanti kaulasevāṃ ye na hi tān vādhate kaliḥ sevante tvāṃ kulācārairna hi tān bādhate kaliḥ śeṣaḥ || 56 || nahi tān bādhate tānna pīḍayati gurvityādi | yuktāḥ saṅgatāḥ | anuraktāḥ anurāgavantaḥ madyamāṃsādīni ye kurvanti kulācārairna hi tān bādhate kaliḥ ye kurvanti kulācārairna hi tān bādhate kaliḥ

namaskurvanti ye bhaktyā na hi tān bādhate kaliḥ paropakāravratināṃ sādhūnāṃ kiṅkaraḥ kaliḥ satyapratijñakaulānāṃ śreyaḥ saṅkalpamātrataḥ nṛṇāmāsīt kalau puṇyaṃ kevalaṃ na tu duṣkṛtam paradrohaparā ye ca te narāḥ kalikiṅkarāḥ dveṣṭāraḥ kulaniṣṭhānāṃ te jñeyāḥ kalikiṅkarāḥ saṃkṣepāt kathitaṃ bhadre prītaye tava pārvati kulatattvam strīkusumādi | kuladravyam madyamāṃsādi vratamastyeṣāmiti paropakāravratinaḥ teṣām sthāsyatyekaṃ satyamātraṃ tasmāt satyamayo bhavet tadeva saphalaṃ karma satyaṃ jānīhi suvrate tasmāt sarvātmanā martyaḥ satyamekaṃ samāśrayet sayathīnaṃ tapo vyarthamūṣare vapanaṃ yathā satyamūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ satyāt parataro na hi kulācāro'pi satyena kartavyo vyaktabhāvataḥ tasmāt prakāśataḥ kuryāt kaulikaḥ kulasādhanam praśaṃsiṣyannāha prakaṭe'tretyādi || 73 hīyate hīnaṃ bhavati tyaktaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ yaduktaṃ kulatantreṣu na śastaṃ pravale kalau dvipādo dvāpare devi pādamātraṃ kalau yuge tasmāt satyaṃ samāśritya sarvakarmāṇi sādhayet tatrānṛtapraveśaścet kuto niḥśreyasaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ karma naraḥ kuryāt svasvavarṇāśramoditam vratodbāhau puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanantathā kuladharmasyetyādi

pādamātram dharmasyāvaśiṣyate iti śeṣaḥ luṣyate iti lopaḥ | tasmin karmaṇi ghañ mṛtakriyāṃ pitṛśrāddhaṃ kuryādāgamasammatam yātrāṃ gṛhapraveśañca navavastrādidhāraṇam gṛhārambhapratiṣṭhāñca devānāṃ sthāpanantathā ṛtumāsavarṣakṛtyaṃ nityaṃ naimittikañca yat mayoktena vidhānena tat sarvaṃ sādhayennaraḥ vinaṣṭaḥ sarvakarmabhyo viṣṭhāyāṃ sa bhavet kṛmiḥ yadā yat kriyate karma viparītāya tadbhavet aśraddhayā viśvāsābhāvena || 91 devatā kupitā tasya vighnastasya pade pade yo'nyamārgaiḥ kriyāṃ kuryāt sa mahāpātakī bhavet sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvaccandradivākarau kevalaṃ sūtravāho'sau caṇḍālādadhamo'pi saḥ veśyāgamanajaṃ pāpaṃ tasya puṃso dine dine pitaro'pi na cāśnanti yatastanmalapūyavat daive paitre kulācāre nādhikāro'sya jāyate bhavet saṃskārahīno bhavedityarthaḥ ihāmutra phalaṃ nāsti kāyakleśo dhanakṣayaḥ śrāddhaṃ tadviphalaṃ so'pi pitṛbhirnarakaṃ vrajet tasmānmartyaḥ prayatnena śāṅkaraṃ matamāśrayet aśāmbhavaṃ kṛtaṃ karma sarvaṃ devi nirarthakam śāmbhavācārahīnasya narakānnaiva niṣkṛtiḥ sādhanaṃ yanmaheśāni tadeva tava sādhanam niṣkṛtirnistāraḥ || 104

bheṣajaṃ kalirogāṇāṃ śrūyatāṅgadato mama caturthollāsaḥ tava śaktyā vayaṃ śaktāḥ sṛṣṭisthitilayādiṣu nānāprayāsasādhyāni varṇituṃ kena śakyate teṣāmarcāsādhanāni kathitāni yathāmati asya prasādāt kalyāṇi mayi te karuṇedṛśī pravṛttaḥ śrīsadāśiva uvāca tvamādyā parametyādi ākārāśca yeṣāṃ rūpāṇāṃ tāni kāruṇyaleśena dayāyā lavena | teṣāṃ tava rūpāṇām etattu ataḥparamucyamānantu | asya guptasādhanasya kathayāmi tava prītyai mama prāṇādhika priye tvatprāptimūlamacirāttava santoṣakāraṇam bahuprayāsāsaktānāmetadeva paraṃ dhanam sukhasādhyamabāhulyaṃ bhaktānāṃ phaladaṃ mahat yasya śravaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto'pi jāyate bījametat samuddhṛtya dvitīyamuddharet priye tṛtīyaṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi dīpasaṃsthaḥ prajāpatiḥ tat guptasādhanam || 5 etadeva ataḥparamucyamānaṃ guptasādhanameva tatra sādhane samuddhṛtya dvitīyaṃ bījamuddharet bījatrayānte parameśvari sambodhanaṃ padam sarvavidyāmayī devī vidyeyaṃ parameśvarī prajapet sādhakādhīśaḥ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye kāmavāgbhavatārādyā saptārṇā'ṣṭākṣarī tridhā

evantu pañcamantrā āsan punarādyatrayaṃ bījaṃ vahnijāyāṃ tato vadet vadhvādyā praṇavādyā cedeṣā saptadaśī dvidhā saṃkṣepādatra kathitā mantrāṇāṃ dvādaśa priye te sarve tava mantrāḥ syustvamādyā prakṛtiryataḥ tridhā jātā | etaistribhiḥ sahitā nava mantrā vabhūvuḥ pārvatīsambandhitve hetumāha tvamādyā prakṛtiryata iti || 19 kathayāmi tava prītyai tathā lokahitāya ca tasmāt kulācārarataḥ sādhayecchaktisādhanam śaktipūjāvidhāvādye pañcatattvaṃ prakīrtitam neṣṭasiddhirbhavettasya vighnastasya pade pade pañcatattvavihīnāyāṃ pūjāyāṃ na phalodbhavaḥ tasmādādau pravakṣyāmi prātaḥkṛtyaṃ yathocitam dhyāyecchirasi śulkābje dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ gurum tadeva sādhanamāha kulācāramityādibhiḥ varābhayakaraṃ śāntaṃ karuṇāmayavigraham smerānanaṃ suprasannaṃ sādhakābhīṣṭadāyakam pūjayitvā japenmantrī vāgbhavaṃ bījamuttamam tatastu praṇameddhīmān mantreṇā'nena sadgurum striyā āliṅgitavigrahamāśliṣṭaśarīram || 27 śeṣaḥ namaḥ sadgurave tubhyaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyine kuladharmaprakāśāya tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ pūrvavat pūjayitvā tāṃ mūlamantrajapañcaret mantreṇānena matimān praṇamediṣṭadevatām

ādyāyai kālikāyai te kartryai hartryai namonamaḥ tyaktvā mūtrapurīṣañca dantadhāvanamācaret dṛṣṭiṃ pradarśayituṃ śīlaṃ yasya tasmai || 31 mantramevāha | namaḥ sarveti || 35 ādāvapa upaspṛśya praviśet salile tataḥ sakṛt snātvā tathonmajya māntramācamanañcaret triraprāśyā'po dvirunmṛjya tvācamet kulasādhakaḥ mūlamantraṃ dvādaśadhā tasyopari japet priye abhiṣicya svamūrddhānaṃ saptacchidrāṇi rodhayet māntram dvādaśavārañjapediti dvitīyenānvayaḥ || 39 utthāya gātraṃ sammārjya pidadhyācchuddhavāsasī lalāṭe tilakaṃ kuryādgāyatryā baddhakuntalaḥ sandhyāṃ samācarenmantrī tāntrikīṃ śṛṇu kathyate ācamya pūrvavattoyaistīrthānyāvāhayecchive narmade sindhu kāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru hastadvayāṅgulibhī rodhayet ācchādayet paridadhyādityarthaḥ bindusaṃyutaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ tilakaṃ lalāṭe kuryāt mayā kathyate pūrvavadācamya toye jale tīrthānyāvāhayet āsattim āvāhya tīrthaṃ salile mūlaṃ dvādaśadhā japet madhyamānāmikāyogānmūloccāraṇapūrvakam vāmahaste samādāya chādayeddakṣapāṇinā

prajapya vedadhā toyaṃ dakṣahaste samānayet aṅkuśākhyā mahāmudrā trailokyākarṣaṇakṣameti vinikṣipet jalaṃ samādāya gṛhītvā dakṣapāṇinā'cchādayet dakṣahaste samānayet dehāntaḥkaluṣaṃ tena recayet piṅgalākhyayā trivāraṃ tāḍayan mantrī hastau prakṣālayettataḥ ācamyoktena mantreṇa sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet idamarghyaṃ tubhyamuktvā dadyāt svāhetyudīrayan prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne trirūpāṃ guṇabhedataḥ kṛṣṇājināmbaradharāṃ haṃsārūḍhāṃ śucismitām śarīrāntaḥpāpaṃ recayenniṣkarṣayet hastau prakṣālayeddhāvet nivedayeddadyāt mantreṇārghyaṃ nivedayedityarthaḥ || 54 śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇīṃ garuḍāsanām yuvatīṃ satataṃ dhyāyenmadhye mārtaṇḍamaṇḍale śuklāṃ śuklāmbaradharāṃ vṛṣāsanakṛtāśrayām vibhratīṃ karapadmaiśca vṛddhāṃ galitayauvanām prātaḥkāle dhyāyet | agre'pyevamevānvayaḥ kartavyaḥ madhyāhna iti | tāṃ gāyatrīm tathābhūtām tathābhūtām dhvastatāruṇyām datvā japettu gāyatrīṃ daśadhā śatadhā'pi vā

ādyāyai padamuccārya vidmahe tadanantaram eṣā tu tava gāyatrī mahāpāpapraṇāśinī tatastu tarpayedbhadre devarṣipitṛdevatāḥ śaktau tu praṇave māyāṃ namaḥsthāne dviṭhaṃ vadet daśavāraṃ śatavāraṃ vetyarthaḥ prītitaḥ dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyojayedityartha iti gāyatrījapādanantaraṃ tu sarvasvarūpāṃ ṅeyuktāṃ sāyudhā'pi tathā paṭhet ādyāyai kālikāyai ta idamarghyaṃ tato dviṭhaḥ yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā devyā vāmakare'rpayet tarpayāmi svāhetyanenādyāṃ kālīṃ tarpayediti jñāpitam idamarghyaṃ svāheti mantra āsīt || 66 natvā tīrthaṃ paṭhan stotraṃ devatādhyānatatparaḥ tato dvārasya purataḥ sāmānyārghyaṃ prakalpayet ādhāraśaktiṃ saṃpūjya tatrā'dhāraṃ niyojayet nikṣipya gandhaṃ puṣpañca tīrthānyāvāhayettataḥ pūjayitvā taddaśadhā māyābījena mantrayet sāmānyārghyaṃ prakalpayet racayet || 69 maṇḍale kamapyādhāraṃ niyojayet sthāpayet tīrthānyāvāhayet tatastajjalapuṣpaiśca pūjayed dvāradevatāḥ gaṅgāñca yamunāñcaiva lakṣmīṃ vāṇīṃ tato yajet smaran devyāḥ padāmbhojaṃ maṇḍapaṃ praviśet sudhīḥ māyābījena hrīmitibījena tajjalaṃ mantrayet

tathā ca tarjanīmadhyā dhenumudrā'mṛtapradeti mantreṇa vāṇīṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet pūjayet maṇḍapaṃ devīyajanamaṇḍapaṃ devīyajanamandiraṃ praviśet sāmānyārghyasya toyena prokṣayedyāgamandiram divyānutsārayedvighnānastrādbhiścāntarīkṣagān candanāgurukastūrīkarpūrairyāgamaṇḍapam vilikhya pūjayettatra kāmarūpāya hṛnmanuḥ kamalāsanāya namo mantreṇaivāsanaṃ yajet yāgamandiraṃ prokṣayet prasiñcet baddhavīrāsano mantrī vijayāṃ pariśodhayet amṛtavarṣiṇi tato'mṛtamākarṣaya dvidhā vaśamānaya ṭhadvandvaṃ saṃvidāśodhane manuḥ āvāhanyādimudrāñca dhenuyonī pradarśayet vijayāṃ bhaṅgām bhaṅgāyāḥ śodhane'yameva manuḥ proktaḥ || 83 tridhaiva tarpayeddevīṃ hṛdi mūlaṃ samuccaran svāhāntenaiva manunā juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhe kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā devīdhyānaparāyaṇaḥ antāṅgṛṣṭhakamuṣṭibhyāṃ tadeyaṃ sannirodhinīti vijayāṃ juhuyāt dadyāt vāme suvāsitaṃ toyaṃ kuladravyāṇi yāni ca vahnibījena deveśi vahneḥ prākāramācaret astreṇa gharṣayitvā tat prakṣipet karaśuddhaye astreṇa choṭikābhiśca bhūtaśuddhimathā'caret kālikāṃ namet

gharṣayitvā prakṣipet atha digbandhanādanantaraṃ bhūtaśuddhimācaret mano niveśya mūle ca huṅkāreṇaiva kuṇḍalīm svādhiṣṭhānaṃ samānīya tatvaṃ tatve niyojayet rasādijihvayā sārddhaṃ jalamagnau vilāpayet sparśāditvagyutaṃ vāyumākāśe pravilāpayet mahattatvañca prakṛtau tāṃ brahmaṇi vilāpayet niyojayet vilāpayet || 93 jalādikamapyagnyādāvevameva vilāpayet || 95 vilāpayet puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇañca raktaśmaśruvilocanam sarvapāpasvarūpañca sarvadā'dhomukhasthitam tena pāpātmakaṃ dehaṃ śoṣayet sādhakāgraṇīḥ catuḥṣaṣṭyā kumbhakena dahet pāparatāntanūm tathābhūtam || 98 pāpamātmani svasmin yasya evambhūtadehaṃ śoṣayet tanūṃ dahet dvātriṃśatā recakena plāvayedamṭāmbhasā utpannaṃ bhāvayeddehaṃ navīnaṃ devatāmayam tena divyāvalokena dṛḍhīkuryānnijāṃ tanūm so'haṃ mantreṇa taddehe devyāḥ prāṇān nidhāpayet samāhitamanāḥ kuryāt mātṛkānyāsamambike dagdhāṃ tanūṃ plāvayet dehaṃ bhāvayet cintayet tanūṃ dṛḍhīkuryāt

tatra dehe devyāḥ prāṇānāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kuryādityarthaḥ devatā mātṛkā devī bījaṃ vyañjanasaṃjñakam ṛṣinyāsaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ karāṅganyāsamācaret uṃ ūṃ madhye ṭavargantu eṃ aiṃ madhye tavargakam bindu sargāntarāle ca ṣaḍaṅge mantra īritaḥ vinyasya nyāsavidhinā dhyāyenmātṛsarasvatīm karāṅganyāsamācaret kuryāt || 107 hakṣau bhrūmadhyage padme kaṇṭhe ca ṣoḍaśa svarān ḍādiphāntān nābhideśe bādilāntāṃśca liṅgake ityantarmanasā nyasya mātṛkārṇān vahirnyaset yasyāstathābhūtām oṣṭhadantottamāṅgāsya doḥpat sandhyagrageṣu ca kakudyaṃśe ca hṛtpūrvaṃ pāṇipādayuge tataḥ itthaṃ lipiṃ pravinyasya prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret pūrayedātmano dehaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā tu kumbhayet dvātriṃśatā japan bījaṃ vāyuṃ dakṣeṇa recayet prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāyetthamṛṣinyāsaṃ samācaret gāyatryādīni chandāṃsi ādyā kālī tu devatā śiro vadanahṛdguhyapādasarvāṅgakeṣu ca ayantu vyāpakanyāso yathoktaphalasiddhidaḥ athavā mūlamantreṇa ṣaḍdīrgheṇa vinā priye namaḥsvāhāvaṣaṭ hūñca vauṣaṭ phaṭ kramaśaḥ sudhīḥ ṛṣinyāsakramaḥ || 122 mūlamantreṇaivā'ṅgakalpanā kartavyā śikhāyai vaṣaḍityuktaṃ kavacāya humīritam

ṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāyetthaṃ pīṭhanyāsaṃ samācaret sudhāmbudhiṃ maṇidvīpaṃ pārijātataruṃ tataḥ tatra padmāsanaṃ vīro vinyaset hṛdayāmbuje nyāsaṃ vidadhyāditi śeṣaḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni prati nyāsaṃ vidhāya pīṭhanyāsaṃ samācaret namaḥ iti || 129 dharmaṃ jñānaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ vairāgyaṃ kramato nyaset naṅpūrvāṇi ca tānyeva dharmādīni yathākramam keśarān karṇikāñcaiva patreṣu pīṭhanāyikāḥ nandinī nārasiṃhī ca vaiṣṇavītyaṣṭanāyikāḥ anaiśvaryāya namaḥ dakṣapārśve avairāgyāya namaḥ iti namaḥ iti | hṛdayāmbujasya patreṣu pīṭhanāyikā nyaset namaḥ nārasiṃhyai namaḥ vaiṣṇavyai namaḥ iti dalāgreṣu nyasedetān prāṇāyāmaṃ tataścaret hṛdi hastau samādhāya dhyāyeddevīṃ sanātanīm arūpaṃ tava yaddhyānamavāṅmanasagocaram agamyaṃ yogibhirgamyaṃ kṛcchrairbahuśamādibhiḥ prāṇāyāmañcaret sanātanīmādyantaśūnyāṃ devīṃ dhyāyet karmaṇi lyuṭ ādiryeṣāṃ te śamādayaḥ | bahavaśca te śamādayaḥ taiḥ sūkṣmadhyānaprabodhāya sthūladhyānaṃ vadāmi te guṇakriyānusāreṇa kriyate rūpakalpanā pūjayet parayā bhaktyā mānasairupacārakaiḥ manasa iti | śīghramiti pūrvānvayi

bravīṣītyata āha arūpāyā ityādi vikāsitamānanavaraṃ mukhaśreṣṭaṃ yasyāḥ tathābhūtām parayā bhaktyā mānasairupacārakairdevīṃ pūjayet pādyaṃ caraṇayordadyāt manastvarghyaṃ nivedayet ākāśatattvaṃ vasanaṃ gandhantu gandhatattvakam tejastattvantu dīpārthe naivedyañca sudhāmbudhim nṛtyamindriyakarmāṇi cāñcalyaṃ manasastathā amāyamanahaṅkāramarāgamamadaṃ tathā amātsaryamalobhañca daśa puṣpaṃ prakīrtitam evamagre'pyanvayaḥ teneti | tenāmṛtena sahasrāracyutena sudhāmbudhimamṛtasamudram || 145 caturthaṃ puṣpam iti pañcadaśaiḥ puṣpairbhāvarūpaiḥ prapūjayet mudrārāśiṃ subhaktañca ghṛtāktaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā kāmakrodhau vighnakṛtau valiṃ dattvā japaṃ caret mālā varṇamayī proktā kuṇḍalīsūtrayantritā evaṃ daśa puṣpaṃ prakīrtitam bhāvāḥ karmaṇyac | tadrūpaiḥ bhāvyamānairityarthaḥ ghṛtamiśritam stryaṅgaviśeṣadhāvanāmbhaḥ mālā'bhyantarajape proktā akārādilakārāntamanuloma iti smṛtaḥ viloma iti vikhyātaḥ kṣakāro merurucyate evamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā'nena samarpayet

gṛhāṇāntarjapaṃ mātarādye kāli namo'stu te ityantaryajanaṃ kṛtvā bahiḥpūjāṃ samārabhet parameśvari svāheti evameva japet | jape'yamanuloma iti smṛtaḥ iti vikhyātaḥ | kṣakāro mālāyā merurucyate ito'nantarameva vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa yasyāḥ tathābhūte || 156 yasya sthāpanamātreṇa devatā suprasīdati bhairavā api nṛtyanti prītyā siddhiṃ dadatyapi māyāgarbhaṃ trikoṇañca vṛttañca caturasrakam ṅentāmādhāraśaktiñca namaḥśabdāvasānikām maṃ vahnimaṇḍalaṃ ṅentaṃ daśakalātmane tataḥ astreṇa sthāpayettatra ādhāropari sādhakaḥ viśeṣārghyasyeti | tatra bahiḥpūjāsamārambhe || 158 nama iti mantreṇādhāraśaktimarcayedityarthaḥ || 160 namo'ntena yajet pātraṃ mūlenaiva prapūrayet gandhapuṣpe tatra dattvā pūjayedamunā'mbike ṣoḍaśānte kalāśabdādātmane nama ityapi sthāpayet || 162 mūlenaiva mantreṇā'rghyapātraṃ prapūrayet vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa tatraiva śaśimaṇḍalaṃ pūjayet ṣoḍaśakalātmane nama iti mantraḥ śaśimaṇḍalārcane jātaḥ dūrvāpuṣpaṃ sākṣatañca kṛtvā tatra nidhāpayet pūjayet gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ mūlaṃ dvādaśadhā japet tadambu prokṣaṇīpātre kiñcinnikṣipya sādhakaḥ pūjāsamāptiparyantamarghyapātraṃ na cālayet

yantrarājaṃ pravakṣyāmi samastapuruṣārthadam tayormadhye yugmayugmakramāt ṣoḍaśa kesarān viśeṣārghyasyāgrabhāge nidhāpayet sthāpayet mūleneti | tatra viśeṣārghyatoye | vibhāvya vicintya dhūpadīpāvapi pradarśayet | tadambu viśeṣārghyajalam prokṣaṇīpātraniḥkṣiptajalena dharmārthakāmamokṣadāyakamityarthaḥ caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ surekhaṃ sumanoharam svayambhukusumairyukte candanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ vilikhet yantrarājantu devatābhāvasiddhaye vaidurye kārayet yantraṃ kārukeṇa suśilpinā devatāprītiniṣpattaye yantrarājaṃ vilikhet || 174 vidrume vaidurye vā yantraṃ kārayet naśyanti duṣṭabhūtāni graharogabhayāni ca dātā bhartā yaśasvī ca bhavet yantraprasādataḥ sampūjya karṇikāmdhye pūjayenmūladevatām mantrasiddhirbhavennūnamicchāsiddhiḥ prajāyate nirmito'yaṃ sa vai yasmāt kalaśastena kathyate sthāpayet tasya duṣṭabhūtāni naśyantītyevamanvayaḥ || 177 pūjayet vidhānaṃ vaktumupakramate kalaśetyādi kalaśaṃ nirvakti kalāmityādinā pañcāṅgulimitaṃ mūlaṃ vidhānaṃ ghaṭanirmitau kārayeddevatāprītyai vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet tāmraṃ prītikaraṃ jñeyaṃ kāṃsyajaṃ puṣṭibarddhanam

mṛṇmayaṃ sarvakāryeṣu sudṛśyaṃ supariṣkṛtam tadbahirvṛttamālikhya caturasraṃ tato vahiḥ chidraśūnyam sauvarṇaṃ suvarṇajātaṃ kalaśamiti śeṣaḥ || 184 māyāmādhāraśaktiñca ṅenamo'ntāṃ samuddharet astreṇa kṣālitaṃ kumbhaṃ tatrā'dhāre niveśayet mūlaṃ samuccaran mantrī kāraṇena prapūrayet pūrvavat pūjayet vidvān devībhāvaparāyaṇaḥ bhūṣayitvā tu kalaśaṃ pañcīkaraṇamācaret namaḥ iti mantra ādhāradevatāyajane jātaḥ sādhakaḥ kāraṇena madyena kalaśaṃ prapūrayet saṃskāre iva || 190 hrī/ divyadṛṣṭyā saṃvīkṣya namasā'bhyukṣaṇaṃ caret praṇamya kalaśaṃ raktapuṣpaṃ dattvā viśodhayet kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām pañcīkaraṇamīritaṃ kathitam | viśodhayet madyamiti śeṣaḥ kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāmahaṃ nāśayāmītyanvayaḥ śukraśāpāttvayā vimucyatāṃ vimuktayā bhūyatām tena satyena te devi brahmahatyā vyapohatu gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat sudhādevyai namaḥ paścāt saptadhā brahmaśāpanut amṛtaṃ srāvayadvandvaṃ dviṭhānto manurīritaḥ brahmaśāpamocako bhavati ānandabhairavaṃ devamānandabhairavīṃ tathā

ānandabhairavaṃ ṅe'ntaṃ vaṣaḍanto manurmataḥ sudhādevyai vauṣaḍanto manurasyāḥ prapūjane dravyaṃ vibhāvya tasyorddhve mūlaṃ dvādaśadhā japet manurdviṭhāntaḥ svāhānta īritaḥ kathitaḥ sāvadhānaḥ san yajet vaṣaṭśabdānto mataḥ vakṣyati dvādaśavāraṃ mūlaṃ mantraṃ japet darśayeddhūpadīpau ca ghaṇṭāvādanapūrvakam vrate home vivāhe ca tathaivotsavakarmaṇi phaṭā'bhukṣya vāyuvahnibījābhyāṃ mantrayettridhā dhenvā vamamṛtīkṛtya mantrametamudīrayet māṃsaṃ me pavitrīkuru kuru tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam dhūpadīpau ca darśayet || tīrthasya madyasya || 204 bījābhyāṃ tridhā trivāraṃ mantrayet mantramudīrayeduccaret viṣṇoḥ padaṃ kuru mantreṇā'nena matimāṃstaṃ mīnamabhimantrayet urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya mā'mṛtāt divīva cakṣurātatam viṣṇoryat paramaṃ padam mūle tu śraddadhāno yaḥ kiṃ tasya dalaśākhayā tadeva devatāprītyai supraśastaṃ mayocyate sarvaṃ mūlena saṃśodhya mahādevyai nivedayet māṃsaśodhane kathitena mantreṇa | anenāntaroktena

tameva mantramāha tryambakaṃ yajāmaha iti sthitamandhānāmagocaraṃ sūryamiva || 211 satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamiti śaṅgaraśāsanam mahādevyai samarpaṇe viśiṣya kathyatāṃ nātha yadi te'sti kṛpā mayi saiva nānāvidhā proktā tālakharjūrasambhavā bahudheyaṃ samākhyātā praśastā devatārcane nātra jātivibhedo'sti śodhitā sarvasiddhidā śrīdevyuvāca yattvayetyādi darśayannāha tālakharjūretyādi | iyaṃ surā || 2 yeneti | āhṛtā ānītā | atra surāviṣaye tat sarvaṃ devatāprītyai bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ yadyadātmapriyaṃ dravyaṃ tattadiṣṭāya kalpayet strīpaśurna ca hantavyastatra śāmbhavaśāsanāt te'pi devyai pradātavyā yadi suṣṭhu vibharjitāḥ yavagodhūmajaṃ vā'pi ghṛtapakvaṃ manoramam bharjitānyanyabījāni adhamā parikīrtitā bhraṣṭadhānyādisambhavā lājādi || 9 sudhādāne devatāyai saṃjñaiṣāṃ śuddhirīritā niṣphalaṃ jāyate devi devatā na prasīdati cirarogī bhavenmantrī svalpāyurmriyate'cirāt svakīyā kevalā jñeyā sarvadoṣavivarjitā kathitaṃ tatpratinidhau kusīdaṃ parikīrtitam naiva dadyānmahādevyai dattvā vai nārakī bhavet māṃsādīnāṃ śuddhiriti saṃjñā īritā kathitā

vinā hetudānam surāsamarpaṇam kālamatītya svakīyā ātmīyā śaktiḥ kusumapratinidhau | kusīdam raktacandanam narakagāmitvamāha aśodhitānītyādinā abhiṣiñcet kāraṇena sāmānyārghyodakena vā namaḥśabdāvasāne ca imāṃ śaktimudīrayet pavitrīkuruśabdānte mama śaktiṃ kuru dviṭhaḥ śaktayo'nyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ nā'rhyāstāḍanakarmaṇi vṛttaṃ ṣaṭkoṇamālikhya caturasraṃ likhedvahiḥ śaktimiti śeṣaḥ | kāraṇena surayā jātaḥ || 18 svīyābhinnāḥ tāḍanakarmaṇi maithunakarmaṇi tato'pi bahiścaturasraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ likhet nijanāmādibījāḍhyaṃ pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ māyāmādhāraśaktiñca namo'ntena prapūjayet vṛttopari yajedvahneḥ kalāḥ svasvādimākṣaraiḥ kāmarūpaṃ pūjayedityarthaḥ ādhāradevatāṃ pūjayet suśrīḥ surūpā kapilā havyakavyavahā tathā sacaturthīnamo'ntena pūjyā vahneḥ kalā daśa avasāne namo dattvā pūjayedvahnimaṇḍalam kabhādivarṇabījena ṭhaḍāntena prapūjayet sudhūmrā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā namaḥ iti mantreṇādhāre vahnimaṇḍalamarcayedityarthaḥ

nāmamantreṇa prapūjayet namo'ntenā'rghyapātre tu pūjayet sūryamaṇḍalam tribhāgaṃ pūrayenmantrī kalaśasthena hetunā sacaturthīnamo'ntena kalāḥ somasya ṣoḍaśa sūryamaṇḍalaṃ pūjayet hetunā surayā'rghyapātrasya tribhāgaṃ pūrayet pūṛṇā pūrṇāmṛtā kāmadāyinyaḥ śaśinaḥ kalāḥ namo'ntena yajenmantrī pūrvavat somamaṇḍalam māyayā prakṣipet pātre tīrthamāvāhayedapi pūrṇāmṛtāṃ pūjayediti pātre prakṣipet tatraiva tīrthamapyāvāhayet dhenvā caivāmṛtīkṛtya chādayenmatsyamudrayā akhaṇḍādyaiḥ pañcamantrairmantrayettadanantaram svacchandasphuraṇāmatra nidhehi kularūpiṇi amṛtatvaṃ nidhehyasmin vastuni klinnarūpiṇi sudhātoyaṃ mantrayet mantritaṃ kuryāt visphūrtiṃ nidhehi sthāpaya | guṇe rāge drave rasa ityamaraḥ sthāpaya bhūtvā kulāmṛtākāraṃ mayi visphuraṇaṃ kuru āpūritaṃ mahāpātraṃ pīyūṣarasamāvaha parāhantāmaye vahnau homasvīkāralakṣaṇam vibhāvya pūjayeddhūpadīpāvapi ca darśayet visphūrtiṃ kuru sambhavo yatra tathābhūtaṃ pīyūṣarasamāvahā'naya juhuyādityarthaḥ

darśayet akṛtvā pāpabhāṅmantrī pūjā ca viphalā bhavet gurupātraṃ bhogapātraṃ śaktipātramataḥ param sāmānyārghyasya vidhinā pātrāṇāṃ sthāpanañcaret māṣapramāṇaṃ pātreṣu śuddhikhaṇḍaṃ niyojayet sarvatra tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt vidhireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ itīti | akṛtvā śrīpātrasaṃskāramiti śeṣaḥ tatrāha gurupātramityādi vidhinā pātrāṇi sthāpayet tatrāha sāmānyārghyasyetyādi māṃsādikhaṇḍaṃ pātreṣu niyojayet sthāpayet prakīrtitaḥ ānandabhairavaṃ devaṃ bhairavīñca pratarpayet vāgbhavādyasvasvanāmnā tadvadgurucatuṣṭayam ādyāṃ kālīṃ tarpayāmi nijabījapuraḥsaram śaktipātrāmṛtaistadvadaṅgāvaraṇatarpaṇam tarpayāmi svāhetyanenānandabhairavīñca pratarpayet santarpya kālikāmādyāṃ vaṭukebhyo baliṃ haret sampūjya sthāpayettatra sāmiṣānnaṃ sudhānvitam sampūjya pūrvabhāge ca vaṭukasya baliṃ haret tarpayedityarthaḥ || 51 vaṭukebhyo baliṃ haret dadyāt māṃsādisahitamannaṃ sthāpayet mantreṇa vaṭukasya baliṃ haret dadyāt p. 135) tatastu yāṃ yoginībhyaḥ svāhā yāmyāṃ haredvalim anena kṣetrapālāya baliṃ dadyāttu paścime

ṅe'ntaṃ gaṇapatiṃ coktvā vahnijāyāṃtato vadet madhye tathā sarvabhūtabaliṃ dadyād yathāvidhi sarvabhūtebhya ityuktvā hū/ phaṭ svāhā manurmataḥ yoginībhyo baliṃ haret paścime bhāge kṣetrapālāya baliṃ dadyāt maṇḍalasya madhye yathāvidhi vidhivat sarvabhūtavaliṃ dadyāt gṛhṇa devi mahābhāge śive kālāgnirūpiṇi cakrānuṣṭhānametattu tavāgre kathitaṃ śive puṣpaṃ gṛhītvā pāṇibhyāṃ karakacchapamudrayā nītvā svahṛdayāmbhoje dhyāyedādyāṃ parātparām validāne mataḥ jātaḥ | anenaiva śivāyai baliṃ dadyāt || 61 svahṛdayāmbhoje parātparāmādyāṃ kālīṃ dhyāyet || 63 dīpāddīpāntaramiva tatra puṣpe niyojya ca kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prārthayediṣṭadevatām yāvat tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi tāvat tvaṃ susthirā bhava ihāgaccha dvidhā proktvā iha tiṣṭha dvidhā punaḥ rudhyasva padamābhāṣya mama pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa ca itthamāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā devyāḥ prāṇān pratiṣṭhayet kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtveṣṭadevatāṃ prārthayet || 65 kiṃ prārthayettatrāha deveśītyādi prāṇā iti tataḥ pañcabījāni tadanantaram pañcabījānyamuṣyāśca sarvendriyāṇi kīrtayet vāṅmanonayanaghrāṇaśrotratvakpadato vadet prāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃtiṣṭhantu ṭhadvayam

saṃsthāpya vidhivat prāṇān kṛtāñjalipuṭo vadet āsanañcedamatra tvayā'syatāṃ parameśvari tataḥ sampūjayeddevīṃ ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ lelihānākhyamudreyaṃ jīvanyāse prakīrtiteti svāgatam devatāṅge ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ nyāsaḥ syāt sakalīkṛtiriti gandhapuṣpe dhūpadīpau naivedyācamane tathā prayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa pādyañcaraṇayordadyāt śirasyarghyaṃ nivedayet vaṃsvadheti samuccārya punarācamanīyakam tāneva ṣoḍaśopacārān darśayati pādyetyādinā amṛtaṃ madyam | prayojayet nivedayet śirasyarghyaṃ nivedayet punardevīmukhe ācamanīyakaṃ niyojayet nivedayāmi manunā dadyādetāni deśikaḥ namo'ntena ca mantreṇa vauṣaḍantena puṣpakam nivedayāmi mantreṇa utsṛjya tadanantaram sampūjya ghaṇṭāṃ vāmena vādayan dakṣiṇena tu dīpantu dṛṣṭiparyantaṃ daśadhā bhrāmayet puraḥ deśikaḥ sādhako dadyāt kālyai vauṣaḍiti mantreṇa devyai puṣpakaṃ dadyāt mūlaṃ samuccaran mantrī yantramadhye nivedayet gṛhāṇa śuddhisahitaṃ dehi me mokṣamavyayam tasyopari nyaset pātraṃ naivedyaparipūritam mūlena saptadhā'mantrya arghyādbhirvinivedayet

nivedayāmīṣṭadevyai juṣāṇedaṃ haviḥ śive ca samuccaran mantrī yantramadhye devyai nivedayet maṇḍalasyopari naivedyaparipūritaṃ pātraṃ nyaset sthāpayet tannaivedyamāmantryārghyādbhirarghyajalairdevyai nivedayet p. 143) tataḥ prāṇādimudrābhiḥ pañcabhiḥ prāśayeddhaviḥ darśayenmūlamantreṇa pānārthaṃ tīrthapūritam tataḥ śrīpātrasaṃsthenāmṛtena tarpayet tridhā pañca puṣpāñjalīndattvā mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ tavāvaraṇadevāṃśca pūjayāmi namo vadet siddhānnamityāmānnasyāpyupalakṣaṇam haviḥ prāśayet bhojayet prārthanāvākyamāsīt || 95 ṣaḍaṅgāni ca sampūjya gurupaṅktīḥ samarcayet parameṣṭhiguruñcaiva yajet kulagurūnimān tato'ṣṭadalamadhye tu pūjayedaṣṭanāyikāḥ nandinī nārasiṃhī ca kaumārītyaṣṭamātaraḥ parameṣṭiguruñcāpīmān kulagurūn kramato yajet gandhapuṣpādibhiraṣṭanāyikāḥ pūjayet pūjyā aṣṭanāyikā āha maṅgaletyādyekena p. 145) dalāgreṣu yajedaṣṭabhairavān sādhakottamaḥ kapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāro'ṣṭau ca bhairavāḥ teṣāmastrāṇi tadbāhye pūjayet tarpayettataḥ sarvopacāraiḥ sampūjya baliṃ dadyāt samāhitaḥ śallakī śaśako godhā kūrmaḥ khaḍgī daśa smṛtāḥ anyānapi paśūn dadyāt sādhakecchānusārataḥ

gandhapuṣpādibhiraṣṭabhairavān sādhakottamo yajet pūjyānaṣṭabhairavānāha asitāṅga ityādyekena indrādidaśadikpālāṃstarpayet samāhitaḥ sāvadhāno bhūtvā devyai baliṃ dadyāt praśastāḥ smṛtāḥ kintu sādhakecchānusārato'nyānapi paśūn devyai dadyāt arghyodakena samprokṣya dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtam gāyatrīṃ dakṣiṇe karṇe japet pāśavimocanīm viśvakarmaṇi ca padāt dhīmahīti padaṃ vadet eṣā tu paśugāyatrī paśupāśavimocanī tadagramadhyamūleṣu kramataḥ pūjayedimān mṛgādīnāmapyupalakṣaṇaṃ | pātho jalam || 107 iti gāyatrī jātā || 109 khaḍgāgramadhyamūleṣu umāmaheśvarau mūle pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ khaḍgāya nama ityantamanunā khaḍgapūjanam yathoktena vidhānena tubhyamastu samarpitam devībhāvaparo bhūtvā hanyāttīvraprahārataḥ sapiṇḍenātha vā chedyo nāripakṣaṃ niyojayet sādhakottamaḥ pūjayet khaḍgāya nama ityantamanunā khaḍgapūjanaṃ kuryāt vadettatrāha yathetyādi paśuhanane'ripakṣaṃ na niyojayet pravartayet || 115 sapradīpaśīrṣabalirnamo devyai nivedayet anyathā devatāprītirjāyate na kadācana

svadakṣiṇe vālukābhirmaṇḍalaṃ caturasrakam astreṇa tāḍayitvā ca tenaiva prokṣaṇaṃ caret sthaṇḍilāya nama iti yajet sādhakasattamaḥ iti mantreṇa kavoṣṇamīṣaduṣṇaṃ rudhiravaliṃ nivedayet evamiti | anyathā balividherabhāvāt maṇḍalasya prokṣaṇaṃ sekañcaret || 119 sthaṇḍilaṃ pūjayedityarthaḥ tisrastisro vidhātavyāstatra sampūjayedimān brahmavaivasvatendūṃśca uttarāgrāsu pūjayet bhūpuraṃ tadbahirvidvān vilikhedyantramuttamam māyāmādhāraśaktyādīn pratyekaṃ vā prapūjayet aṅguṣṭhe sakaniṣṭhe syādvitastirdvādaśoṅgula iti brahmayamacandrān pūjayet bhūpurañca vidvān vilikhet aiśvaryaṃ pūjayitvā tu pūrvādiṣu diśāṃ kramāt anaiśvaryaṃ yajenmantrī madhye'nantañca padmakam prāgādikeśareṣveṣu madhye caitāḥ prapūjayet sphuliṅginī ca rucirā jvalinīti tathā kramāt raṃ vahnerāsanāyeti namo'ntena prapūjayet pratyekameva prapūjayet yajet | yantrasya madhye'nantaṃ padmakañca yajet || 126 madhye ca krameṇaitāḥ prapūjayet madhye jvalinīṃ madhye pūjayet vāgīśvareṇa saṃyuktāṃ dhyātvā mantrī tadāsane mūlena vīkṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā phaṭā'vāhanamācaret

vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī ambiketi yathākramāt iti sthaṇḍilamāpūjya tanmadhye mūlarūpiṇīm vahnimuddhṛtya mūlānte kūrcamastraṃ samuccaran astreṇa vahniṃ saṃvīkṣya kūrcenaivāvaguṇṭhayet vāmetyādyarddhena prādakṣiṇyakrameṇāgniṃ bhrāmayan sthaṇḍilopari ātmano'bhimukhīkṛtya yoniyantre niyojayet caitanyāya namo vahneścaitanyaṃ paripūjayet trikoṇamaṇḍale niyojayet sthāpayet || 137 iti manurjātaḥ | anenaiva manunā vahneḥ caitanyaṃ paripūjayet prajvālayettato vahniṃ mantreṇānena mantravit hanadvayaṃ daha daha paca paceti tato vadet tataḥ kṛtāñjalirbhūtvā prakuryādagnivandanam suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukham sveṣṭanāmnā vahnināma kṛtvā'bhyarcanamācaret mantreṇa mantravit sādhako vahniṃ prajvālayeduddīpayet manurvahniprajvālane smṛtaḥ || 141 agnivandanamantramāha agniṃ prajvalitaṃ vande ityāti ihāvahāvahetyuktvā lohitākṣapadāntaram ityabhyarcya hiraṇyādisaptajihvāḥ prapūjayet ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pūjayedvahnestato mūrtīryajet sudhīḥ jātavedaprabhṛtayo mūrtayo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ padmādyaṣṭanidhīniṣṭvā yajedindrādidikpatīn vahnerhiraṇyādisaptajihvā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjayet || 145 vahnermūrtīḥ sudhīryajet

prakīrtitāḥ pūrvamuktāḥ kuśapatradvayaṃ nītvā ghṛtamadhye nidhāpayet madhye suṣumnāṃ sañcintya dakṣabhāgāt samāhitaḥ mantreṇānena juhuyāt praṇavānte'gnaye padam vāmanetre hunedvahneḥ o/ somāya dviṭho manuḥ indrādidikpatīn yajet ghṛtamadhye vāme dakṣiṇe nidhāpayet sthāpayet agnīṣomau sapraṇavau tūryadvivacanānvitau gṛhītvā namasā mantrī praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddharet bhūrbhuvaḥ svardviṭhāntena vyāhṛtyā homamācaret karmāṇi sādhaya svāhā tridhā'nenāhutīrharet kṛtvā svāhāntamanunā mūlena pañcaviṃśatīḥ ekādaśāhutīrhutvā mūlenaivāṅgadevatāḥ hutvā svakāmamuddiśya tilājyamadhumiśritaiḥ yathāśaktyāhutiṃ dadyānnāṣṭanyūnāṃ prakalpayet tasmāddevīṃ samānīya sthāpayet hṛdayāmbuje anena manunā tridhā vāratrayamāhutīrhareddadyāt samānīya hṛdayāmbuje sthāpayet kṛtadakṣiṇako mantrī acchidramavadhārayet hutaśeṣaṃ bhruvormadhye dhārayet sādhakottamaḥ homakarma samāpyaivaṃ sādhako japamācaret devatāgurumantrāṇāmaikyaṃ sambhāvayeddhiyā trayāṇāntejasā'tmānamekībhūtaṃ vicintayet | sambhāvayet samyak vicintayet aikyabhāvena

gurudevatāmūlamantrāṇām japtvā tu sādhakaḥ paścānmātṛkāpuṭitaṃ smaret prajapya saptadhā mantrī prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret māle māle mahābhāge sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇi iti sampūjya mālāṃ tāṃ śrīpātrasthāmṛtena ca aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā'pyathavā'ṣṭottaraṃ śatam neḍāgamaḥ prajapya mantrī prāṇāyāmaṃ pūrvavat samācaret kuryāt guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam iti mantreṇa matimān devyā vāmakarāmbuje tataḥ kṛtāñjalirbhūtvā stotrañca kavacaṃ paṭhet vilomārghyapradānena kuryādātmasamarpaṇam jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyante avasthāsu prakīrtayet hastābhyāṃ padataḥ padbhyāmudareṇa tataḥ param bhavatvante māṃ madīyaṃ sakalaṃ tadanantaram praṇavaṃ tatsadityuktvā kuryādātmasamarpaṇam māyābījaṃ samuccārya śrī ādye kālike vadet saṃhāramudrayā puṣpamāghrāya sthāpayet hṛdi hrī/ nirmālyapadañcoktvā vāsinyai nama ityapi naivedyaṃ vitaret paścāt gṛhṇīyāt śaktisādhakaḥ ekāsanopaviṣṭo vā pātraṃ kuryāt manoramam tolakatritayānnyūnaṃ svārṇaṃ rājatameva ca ādhāropari saṃsthāpya śuddhipātrasya dakṣiṇe svayaṃ vā bhrātṛputrairvā jyeṣṭhānukramataḥ sudhīḥ | yojanayā hrī/ nirmālyavāsinyai nama iti manurjātaḥ

śaktisādhakaḥ śaktisahitaḥ sādhakaḥ manoramaṃ ramyaṃ pātraṃ kuryāt tataḥ sāmayikaiḥ sārddhaṃ pānabhojanamācaret tato'tihṛṣṭamanasā samastaḥ kulasādhakaḥ mūlādhārādijihvāntāṃ cidrūpāṃ kulakuṇḍalīm parasparājñāmādāya juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhe sādhakānāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ pañcapātraṃ prakīrtitam atipānāt kulīnānāṃ siddhihāniḥ prajāyate pānabhojanamācaret tāvat pānaṃ prakurvīta paśupānamataḥ param sa pāpiṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ brūyādādyāṃ kālīṃ bhajāmyaham tathā tava prasāde'pi jātibhedaṃ vivarjayet lepāvanodanaṃ kuryādvastreṇa pāthasā'pi vā yantralepaṃ kūrcadeśe vihareddevavadbhuvi yāvaditi | cālayet ghūrṇayet evamiti | lepāvanodanam hastalepāpanayanam kūrcamastrībhruvormadhyamityamaraḥ saubhāgyamokṣajananaṃ brahmajñānaikasādhanam nyāsapūjāvidhānañca bāhyābhyantarabhedataḥ vinayāvanatā devī provāca śaṅkaraṃ prati kṛpayā kathitaṃ deva parāprakṛtisādhanam viśeṣataḥ kaliyuge jīvānāmāśu siddhidam sadāśivetyādi || 4 notthātumīhate svairaṃ bhūyaḥ prārthayate'cirāt stotrañca kavacaṃ deva tadidānīṃ prakāśaya

paṭhanāt śravaṇādyasya sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet akālamṛtyuharaṇaṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇam stavasyāsya prasādena tripurārirahaṃ śive dharmakāmārthamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ punarapyacirādatiśīghrameva tvadvāgamṛtaṃ prārthayate || 6 anuttamam na uttamaṃ yasmāttathābhūtam || 8 tripuro'suraviśeṣaḥ tasyāriḥ śatruḥ kamalā kalidarpaghnī kapardīśakṛpānvitā kapardinī karālāsyā karuṇāmṛtasāgarā kṛśānuḥ kapilā kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇānandavivarddhinī kādambinī kalādhārā kalikalmaṣanāśinī kumārībhojanānandā kumārīrūpadhāriṇī kadambapuṣpasantoṣā kadambapuṣpamālinī kādambarīpānaratā tathā kādambarīpriyā yuktā karālo danture tuṅge ityamaraḥ kamalāsanasantuṣṭā kamalāsanavāsinī kalahaṃsagatiḥ klaivyanāśinī kāmarūpiṇī kamanīyā kalpalatā kamanīyavibhūṣaṇā kāraṇāmṛtasantoṣā kāraṇānandasiddhidā kāraṇārṇavasammagnā kāraṇavratapālinī kastūrīpūjanaratā kastūrīpūjakapriyā karpūramālābharaṇā karpūracandanokṣitā karpūrasāgarasnātā karpūrasāgarālayā kulīnā kaulikārādhyā kaulikapriyakāriṇī

kāśīśvarī kaṣṭahartrī kāśīśavaradāyinī kāśīśvarakṛtāmodā kāśīśvaramanoramā kāñcanādrikṛtāgārā kāñcanācalakaumudī kumatighnī kulīnārtināśinī kulakāminī ityādyākālikādevyāḥ śatanāma prakīrtitam kakārakūṭaghaṭitaṃ kālīrūpasvarūpakam mantrasiddhirbhavedāśu tasya kālī prasīdati dhanavān kīrtimān bhūyāddānaśīlo dayānvitaḥ putrapautrasukhaiśvaryairmodate sādhako bhuvi caraṇayoryasyāḥ sā yasyāḥ sā || 31 kakārakūṭaghaṭitam kakārarāśisammilitam pūjayitvā mahākālīmādyāṃ tribhuvaneśvarīm nāsādhyaṃ vidyate tasya triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana samudra iva gāmbhīrye vale ca pavanopamaḥ rūpe mūrtidharaḥ kāmo yoṣitāṃ hṛdayaṅgamaḥ yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ puraskṛtya stotrametadudīrayet raṇe rājakule dyūte vivāde prāṇasaṅkaṭe dasyugraste grāmadāhe siṃhavyāghrāvṛte tathā jvaradāhe ciravyādhau mahārogādisaṅkule dustare salile vāpi pote vātavipadgate yaḥ paṭhecchatanāmāni dṛḍhabhaktisamanvitaḥ na pāpebhyo bhayaṃtasya na rogebhyo bhayaṃ kvacit tasya darśanamātreṇa palāyante vipadgaṇāḥ sa kartā jātidharmāṇāṃ jñātīnāṃ prabhureva saḥ

tannāmnā mānavāḥ sarve praṇamanti sasambhramāḥ ādyākālīsvarūpākhyaṃ śatanāma prakīrtitam puraskriyānvitaṃ stotraṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam paṭhedvā pāṭhayedvāpi śṛṇuyācchrāvayedapi sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt sasambhramāḥ sabhayāḥ sādarā vā || 50 ādyāyāḥ śrīkālikāyāḥ kavacaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam chando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca ādyā kālī prakīrtitā krī/ kīlakaṃ kāmyasiddhau viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ hṛdayaṃ krī/ parā śaktiḥ pāyāt kaṇṭhaṃ parātparā ghrāṇaṃ pātu mahāmāyā rasanāṃ sarvamaṅgalā oṣṭhādharau kṣamā rakṣet cibukaṃ cāruhāsinī dvau bāhū bāhudā rakṣet karau kaivalyadāyinī pārśve pāyādaparṇā me kaṭiṃ me kamaṭhāsanā śrīsadāśiva uvāca kathitamityādi || 55 ūrū rakṣatu kalyāṇī pādau me pātu pārvatī rakṣāhīnaṃtu yat sthānaṃ varjitaṃ kavacena ca iti te kathitaṃ divyaṃ trailokyavijayābhidham kavacaṃ kālikādevyā ādyāyāḥ paramādbhutam mantrasiddhirbhavedāśu kiṅkarāḥ kṣudrasiddhayaḥ vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ kāmī kāmānavāpnuyāt puraścaraṇasampannaṃ yathoktaphaladaṃ bhavet bhūrje vilikhya guṭikāṃ svarṇasthāṃ dhārayed yadi ityādibhiḥ || 67 varmaṇaḥ kavacasya || 69

tasyā'dyā kālikā vaśyā vāñchitārthaṃ prayacchati arogī cirajīvī syāt balavān dhāraṇakṣamaḥ vaśe tasya mahīpālā bhogamokṣau karasthitau kalikalmaṣayuktānāṃ niḥśreyasakaraṃ param adhunā śrotumicchāmi puraścaryāvidhiṃ vibho sa evā'dyākālikāyā mantrāṇāṃ vidhiriṣyate pūjā saṃkṣepataḥ kāryā puraścaraṇameva ca prayacchati dadāti || 71 nipuṇaḥ pravīṇaḥ || 73 śrīdevyuvāca kathitamityādi saṃkṣepapūjanaṃ bhadre tatrādau śṛṇu kathyate karaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kuryāt nyāsañca karadehayoḥ dhyānaṃ pūjāṃ japañceti saṃkṣepapūjane vidhiḥ tasmāccaturguṇajapāt puraścaryā vidhīyate pañcatattvaṃ samānīya pūjayitvā jaganmayīm bhojayitvā brahmaniṣṭhān puraścaraṇakṛdbhavet pratyahaṃ prajapenmantraṃ sahasraparisaṃkhyayā saṃkṣepapūjādikaraṇe hetumāha yato hīti saṃkṣepapūjanamevāha ācamyeyādibhiḥ sarvāṅgavyāpakanyāsam vidhīyate || 81 ayutam daśasahasram p. 176) vasusaṃkhyājapenaiva bhavenmantrapuraskriyā sadā sarvayuge devi kalikāle viśeṣataḥ prabale kalikāle tu rūpametajjagaddhitam

niyamāniyamenāpi japannādyāṃ prasādayet brahmajñānayuto martyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ ādyākālīsādhakānāṃ sādhanaṃ sukhasādhanam cittasaṃśuddhirevātra mantriṇāṃ phaladāyinī tāvat karma prakurvīta kulabhaktisamanvitaḥ ādau mantraṃ gurorvaktrād gṛhṇīyād brahmamantravat etadrūpam ādyāyāḥ kālyā rūpam brahmajñāne samutpanne kṛtyākṛtyaṃ na vidyate lakṣaṇaṃ pañcatattvasya śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ kathayāmi tava prītyai yathāvadavadhāraya kṣityaptejovāyavaśca kulamityabhidhīyate kulācāraḥ sa evādye dharmakāmārthamokṣadaḥ kimityādi kulamityabhidhīyate kathyate dharmakāmārthamokṣadaḥ kulācāro'bhidhīyate kṣīṇāghānāṃ sādhakānāṃ kulācāre matirbhavet tadādyācaraṇāmbhoje matisteṣāṃ prajāyate kulācāraratā bhūtvā pañcatattvaiḥ kuleśvarīm iha bhuktvā'khilān bhogān brajantyante nirāmayam ānandajanakaṃ yacca tadādyatattvalakṣaṇam vivādarogajananantyājyaṃ kaulaiḥ sadā priye buddhitejobalakaraṃ dvitīyatattvalakṣaṇam kulācāragatetyādibhiḥ || vidyāmenāma mantraūpām || 100 nirāmayam sarvopadravarahitaṃ mokṣapadam mahauṣadhamityādibhiḥ

tattvam ādyatattvam hariṇādayaśca te teṣām prajāvṛddhikarañcā'pi tṛtīyatattvalakṣaṇam āyurmūlaṃ trijagatāṃ caturthatattvalakṣaṇam anādyantajaganmūlaṃ śeṣatattvasya lakṣaṇam apastṛtīyaṃ jānīhi caturthaṃ pṛthivīṃ śive pañcamaṃ jagadādhārā viyadviddhi varānane ācāraṃ kuladharmasya jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ hitāya jagatāṃ mātā bhūyaḥ śaṅkaramabravīt dharmārthakāmadaṃ vighnaharaṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam tatra ye vihitācārāḥ kṛpayā vada tānapi ācārāścāpi varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ pṛthak pṛthak kimabravīdityapekṣāyāmāha śrutamityādi tatra varṇāśrameṣu brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ sāmānya eva ca teṣāmācāradharmāṃśca śṛṇuṣvādye vadāmi te kleśaprayāsāśaktānāṃ kuto dehapariśramaḥ gārhasthyo bhaikṣukaścaiva āśramau dvau kalau yuge vadāmi tvaṃ śṛṇuṣvetyanvayaḥ bhavedityarthaḥ dvāvevāśramau kalau staḥ nānyamārgaiḥ kriyāsiddhiḥ kadāpi gṛhamedhinām kalau nāstyeva tattvajñe yatastat śrautasaṃskṛtiḥ tadeva kathitaṃ bhadre sannyāsagrahaṇaṃ kalau ubhayatrāśrame devi sarveṣāmadhikāritā

viprāṇāmitareṣāñca karmaliṅgaṃ pṛthak pṛthak gṛhamedhinām gṛhasaṅgamavatāṃ gṛhasthānāmityarthaḥ saṃskāraḥ sannyāsagrahaṇaṃ kathitam brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāmeva vā tatrāha viprāṇāmityādi gārhasthyaṃ prathamaṃ kuryāt yathāvidhi maheśvari tadā sarvaṃ parityajya sannyāsāśramamācaret prauḍhe dharmyāṇi karmāṇi caturthe pravrajet sudhīḥ śiśuñca tanayaṃ hitvā nāvadhūtāśramaṃ vrajet yaḥ pravrajati hitvaitān sa mahāpātakī bhavet kalāvapi pṛthak pṛthagevāsti kamāśramamāśrāyettatrāha gārhasthyamityādi tattvajñāne brahmajñāne pravrajet saṃnyaset || 16 asantarpya svapitrādīn yo gacchedbhikṣukāśrame śaivena vartmanā kuryādeṣa dharmaḥ kalau yuge viprasya viprabhinnānāṃ saṃskārādīni me vada tadeva kathayāmyādau śṛṇu kaulini tattvataḥ yadyat karma prakurvīta tadbrahmaṇi samarpayet ityanvayaḥ brahmaṇi niṣṭhā yasya sa brahmaniṣṭhaḥ devatātithipūjāsu gṛhastho nirato bhavet matvā gṛhī niṣeveta sadā sarvaprayatnataḥ tava prītirbhaveddevi parabrahma prasīdati yuvayoḥ prīṇanaṃ yasmāt tasmāt kiṃ gṛhiṇāṃtapaḥ

tattatsamayamājñāya mātre pitre niyojayet pitrorājñānusārī syāt satputraḥ kulapāvanaḥ pitroragre na kurvīta yadīcchedātmano hitam vinā'jñayā nopaviśet saṃsthitaḥ pitṛśāsane yasmāt mātuḥ pituśca toṣaṇāt tattatsamayam āsanādisamarpaṇasamayam | niyojayet samarpayet sasambhramaḥ sādaraḥ sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sarvadharmavahiṣkṛtaḥ hitvā gṛhī na bhuñjīyāt prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairapi ihaiva lokagarhyo'sau paratra nārakī bhavet poṣayet svajanān bandhūneṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ svajanaiḥ śikṣitaḥ prītyā so'dhamastān parityajet prīṇayet satataṃ śaktyā dharmo hyeṣa sanātanaḥ brahmaniṣṭhaḥ satyasandho yo bhavedbhuvi mānavaḥ na tyajet ghorakaṣṭe'pi yadi sādhvī pativratā pitṛhelanam mātāpitrostiraskāram || 32 gurūn pitrādīn | lokagarhyaḥ jananindyaḥ || 34 svajanaiḥ bandhubhiḥ eṣāṃ jananyādīnām | prīṇayet jananyādīn toṣayet duṣṭena cetasā vidvānanyathā nārakī bhavet ayuktabhāṣaṇañcaiva striyaṃ śauryanna darśayet satataṃ toṣayeddārān nāpriyaṃ kvacidācaret na patnīṃ preṣayet prājñaḥ punnāmātyavivarjitām sarvo dharmaḥ kṛtastena bhavatīpriya eva saḥ tataḥ ṣoḍaśaparyantaṃ guṇān vidyāñca śikṣayet

tatastāṃstulyabhāvena matvā snehaṃ pradarśayet deyā varāya viduṣe dhanaratnasamanvitā duṣṭena cetasā vikṛtena manasā virale nirjanasthāne || 41 anyaniketane paragṛhe || 43 tataḥ caturbhyo varṣebhya ūrddhvam prerayet pravartayet | tān viṃśatyabdādhikān putrān jñātīn mitrāṇi bhṛtyāṃśca pālayettoṣayed gṛhī abhyāgatānudāsīnān gṛhasthaḥ paripālayet paśureva sa vijñeyaḥ sa pāpī lokagarhitaḥ āsaktimaśane vastre nātiriktaṃ sasācaret svaccho namraḥ śucirdakṣo yuktaḥ syāt sarvakarmasu jugupsitān na manyeta nāvamanyeta māninaḥ sahavāsena tarkaiśca viditvā viśvasettataḥ mitrāmitrabhinnān || 48 lokagarhitatvañca syādityāha yadītyādinā āsaktim āsaṅgam | atiriktam adhikam udyogavān śūraḥ vikrāntaḥ | nāvamanyeta na anādriyeta tarkaiḥ paryālocanaiḥ pradarśayedātmabhāvānnaiva dharmaṃ vilaṅghayet kṛtaṃ yadupakārāya dharmajño na prakāśayet guruṇā laghunā cāpi yaśasvī na vivādayet vyasanañcāsatāṃ saṅgaṃ mithyādrohaṃ parityajet tasmādavasthāṃ samayaṃ vīkṣya karma samācaret

mitavāṅmitahāsaḥ syānmānyāgre tu viśeṣataḥ apramatto dīrghadarśī mātrāsparśān vicārayet yatamānaḥ yatnaṃ kurvāṇaḥ || 58 kṣemaḥ tayoranuraktaḥ ātmautkarṣyaṃ tathā nindāṃ pareṣāṃ parivarjayet setuḥ pratiṣṭhito yena tena lokatrayaṃ jitam gāyanti yadyaśo lokāstena lokatrayaṃ jitam kāmakrodhau vaśe yasya tena lokatrayaṃ jitam dambhamātsaryahīno yastena lokatrayaṃ jitam dharmayuddhe mṛto vā'pi tena lokatrayaṃ jitam macchāsane hito yaśca tena lokatrayaṃ jitam kriyante yena karmāṇi tena lokatrayaṃ jitam brahmaṇyātmārpaṇaṃ yattat śaucamāntarikaṃ smṛtam sarvatra śatrumitrādau || 69 dehaśuddhirbhavedyena bahiḥśaucaṃ taducyate sarvaṃ pavitrajananaṃ svarṇadī kramataḥ priye vāso'jinatṛṇādīni mṛdvajjānīhi suvrate manaḥpūtaṃ bhavedyena gṛhasthastattadācaret bhojanānte male spṛṣṭe bahiḥśaucaṃ vidhīyate upāsanāyā bhedena pūjāṃ kuryād yathāvidhi jñānāt brahmeti tadvācyaṃ sandhyā bhavati vaidikī ityanvayaḥ | sarvam gaṅgājalādi vaidikī sandhyā bhavati arghyadānaṃ dineśāya gāyatrījapanaṃ tathā

japānāṃ niyamo bhadre sarvatrāhnikakarmaṇi āgamoktavidhau devi sarvasiddhistato bhavet sāyaṃ sūryāstasamayastrikālānāmayaṃ kramaḥ tvayaiva kathitā nātha samprāpte prabale kalau gāyatrījapanaṃ vaidikī sandhyā bhavati tataḥ āgamoktavidhitaḥ sūryasyodayo yatra sa sūryodayaḥ kālaḥ śrīdevyuvāca viprādītyādi niyojayasi tatsarvaṃ viśeṣādvaktumarhasi lokānāṃ bhogamokṣāya sarvakarmasu siddhidā tathaiva tāntrikī jñeyā praśastobhayakarmaṇi gāyatryāmadhikāro'sti nānyamantreṣu karhicit brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ sāvitrī kathitā kalau sandhyeyaṃ vaidikī proktā prāgevāhnikakarmaṇām satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyametanna saṃśayaḥ bījādyā vāgbhavādyā ai/ bījādyā sāvitrī gāyatrī kathitā sandhyā karaṇīyā proktā || 88 o/ tatsat brahma coccārya mokṣecchubhiranāturaiḥ gṛhyakaṃ vastujātañja svacchāt svacchaṃ praśasyate gṛhastho niyataṃ kuryānnaiva tiṣṭhennirudyamaḥ japaṃ dānaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ śreyasāṃ nilayo bhavet upavāsapratinidhāvekaṃ dānaṃ vidhīyate tatpātraṃ kevalaṃ jñeyo daridraḥ satkriyānvitaḥ caturdaśyaṣṭamī śuklā tathaivaikādaśī kuhūḥ vaidhotsavadinañcaiva puṇyakālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ

sasuccāryeyaṃ vaidikī tāntrikī ca sandhyā kartavyā gṛhyakaṃ vastujātam gṛhasambandhi sarvaṃ vastu prasiddhaṃ devatākṣetraṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ prakīrtitam narakāya bhavettīrthaṃ tīrthāya vrajatāṃ nṛṇām naiva vratānāṃ niyamo bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ vinā tasmāt sarvātmanā nārī patisevāṃ samācaret tadājñānucarī bhūtvā toṣayet patibāndhavān nāpriyaṃ manasā vāpi caredbhartuḥ pativratā yā prīṇayati bhartāraṃ saiva brahmapadaṃ labhet na cāṅgaṃ darśayedanyān bharturājñānusāriṇī atha strīdharmānāha na tīrthetyādibhiḥ saptabhiḥ sarvātmanā sarvaprayatnena vārddhakye patibandhūnāṃ na svatantrā bhavet kvacit nodvāhayet pitā bālāmajñātadharmaśāsanām bahūpakārakān gāśca māṃsādān rasavarjitān bhūmijātāni sarvāṇi bhojyāni svecchayā śive aśaktau kṣatriyaviśāṃ vṛttairnirvāhamācaret atrāśaktau vaṇigvṛttaṃ śūdravṛttamathāśrayet śūdrāṇāṃ parameśāni sevāvṛttiṃ vidhīyate svatantrā svādhīnā || 106 rasavarjitān āsvādaśūnyān || 108 atha brāhmaṇavṛttamāha adhyāpanamityādi saṃgrāmabhūmiśāsanarūpe sadvṛtte adhikāro'sti deveśi dehayātrāprasiddhaye nirmatsaro niṣkapaṭaḥ svavṛttau brāhmaṇo bhavet

sarvalokahitaiṣī syāt pakṣapātavinirmukhaḥ nīcaiḥ prasaktiṃ dambhañca sarvathā brāhmaṇastyajet mṛtyurjayo vā yuddheṣu rājanyānāṃ varānane rakṣannaṅgīkṛtaṃ dharmaṃ putravat pālayet prajāḥ mantribhiḥ saha kurvīta vicārya sarvathā nṛpaḥ sāmānyānāmityādinaikena dehādiviṣayakamamatāśūnyaḥ | śāntaḥ saṃyatacittaḥ svaniṣṭhabahumānyatvanimittakacittasamunnatim karaṇīyā yathāśāstraṃ sandhiṃ kuryād yathābalam upāyānugatāḥ sarvā jayakṣemavibhūtayaḥ dhīro vipattau dakṣaśca śīlavān sammitavyayī svasainyabhāvānveṣī syāt śikṣayedraṇakauśalam valānītān ripūn devi ripudāraśiśūnapi vitarettāni sainyebhyo yathāyogyavibhāgataḥ bahusainyādhipaṃ naikaṃ kuryādātmahite rataḥ balapūrvakamityarthaḥ || 120 virataḥ viraktaḥ | dhīro dhairyavān | dakṣo'nalasaḥ saṃskāre || 123 sāmyaṃ krīḍopahāsañca nīcaiḥ saha vivarjayet bahumāno'pi nirdambho dhīro daṇḍaprasādayoḥ evaṃ svajanabhṛtyānāṃ bhāvān paśyennarādhipaḥ sahasā naiva kartavyaṃ svāminā tattvadarśinā pālanīyāḥ sadoṣāścet daṇḍyā rājñā yathāvidhi jvarābhibhūtān vṛddhāṃśca rakṣayet pitṛvannṛpaḥ yenopāyena lokānāṃ dehayātrā prasiddhati

nirdambho bhūrisammānanimittakacittasamunnatiśūnyo bhavet prajānāmabhiprāyān ceṣṭā vā dambhāt rājyādinimittakāccittautsukyāt || 130 mṛtabāndhavān mṛtā bāndhavā yeṣāṃ tathābhūtān pramādavyasanālasyaṃ miyyāśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet parasparāṅgīkaraṇaṃ krayasiddhistato bhavet rogavibhrāntabuddhīnāmasiddhau dānavikrayau viparyaye tadguṇānāmanyathā bhavati krayaḥ varṣātīte'pi tatkreyamanyathā kartumarhati ataḥ kuleśi tatkreyo na siddhenmama śāsanāt yuktaścaturtho dhātūnāmaṣṭamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ yadyadaṅgīkṛtaṃ martyaistatkāryaṃ śāstrasammatam sarvātmanā sarvaprakāreṇa adṛṣṭānām vastūnām | viparyaye vaiparītye || 137 tatkreyaḥ mānavavapuḥkreyaḥ apramatto nirālasyaḥ sevāvṛttau bhavennaraḥ mānyāstadbāndhavā bhṛtyairihāmutra sukhepsubhiḥ sabhītiḥ sarvadā tiṣṭhet prabhorājñāṃ pratīkṣayan bharturglānikaraṃ yacca gopayedatiyatnataḥ tatsannidhāvasadbhāṣaṃ krīḍāṃ hāsyaṃ parityajet viviktaśayyāṃ hāsyañca tābhiḥ saha vivarjayet upānadbhūṣaṇaṃ śastraṃ nātmārthaṃ viniyojayet prāgalbhyaṃ prauḍhavādañca sāmyācāraṃ vivarjayet rahaḥśayanam | tābhiḥ svāmigṛhakiṅkarībhiḥ || 147 prāgalbhyam dhārṣṭyam

kurvīran bhairavīcakrāttattvacakrādṛte śive tathā'dāne ca pāne ca varṇabhedo na vidyate tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kṛpayā vaktumarhasi viśeṣapūjāsamaye tatkāryaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ yathāsamayamāsādya kuryāccakramidaṃ śubham ārādhitā yena devī tūrṇaṃ yacchati vāñchitam aśanam bhojanam | ṛte vinā ubhayatra bhairavīcakre tattvacakre ca śrīdevyuvāca kimidamityādi tatkulapūjāvidhāvuktaṃ cakrānuṣṭhānam || 153 yacchati dadāti kāmādyenāstrabījena saṃśodhyopaviśettataḥ trikoṇañcaturasrañca maṇḍalaṃ racayet sudhīḥ phalapallavasaṃyuktaṃ sindūratilakānvitam praṇavena tu saṃsthāpya dhūpadīpau pradarśayet saṃkṣepapūjāvidhinā tatra pūjāṃ samācaret gurvādinavapātrāṇāṃ nātra sthāpanamiṣyate tadvahiścaturasrañcatuṣkoṇañca maṇḍalaṃ racayet sādhako dhūpadīpau taṃ pradarśayet || 158 samācaret kuryāt || 160 prokṣayedastramantreṇa divyadṛṣṭyā'valokayet ānandabhairavīṃ devīṃ ānandabhairavaṃ tathā cāruhāsāmṛtābhāṣollasadvadanapaṅkajām vicitravasanāṃ dhyāyet varābhayakarāmbujām ityānandamayīṃ dhyātvā smaredānandabhairavam

prokṣayet jalena siñcet divyadṛṣṭyā'valokayecca devaṃ vicintayet dakṣeṇa śuddhiguṭikāṃ dadhataṃ smarāmi saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ śodhayet kāraṇaṃ tataḥ aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā japan hetuṃ viśodhayet ādyatattvapratinidhau vidheyaṃ madhuratrayam cintayāmi śodhayet kulārcako hetuṃ madyaṃ viśodhayet || 169 alirūpamidaṃ mattvā devatāyai nivedayet tadrūpeṇa na jānanti śaktiṃ sāmānyabuddhayaḥ dhyānaṃ devyāḥ padāmbhoje sveṣṭamantrajapastathā pratyekaṃ śatadhā'nena manunā cābhimantrayet nivedya pūrvavat kālyai pānabhojanamācaret | idaṃ madhurayatram śaktiṃ striyam vidheyam tathā sveṣṭamantrasya japo vidheyaḥ svāheti manunā'bhimantrayet śodhayedityarthaḥ pūrvavadeva pānabhojanamācaret tavāgre kathitaṃ bhadre sārātsāraṃ parātparam sarvathā sādhakendreṇa kartavyaḥ śaivavartmanā parastrīgāmināṃ pāpaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ nivṛtte bhairavīcakre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak cakramadhyagatā vīrā mama rūpā narākhyayā yena kenā'hṛtaṃ dravyaṃ cakre'smin viniyojayet

vīreṇa paśunā vāpi cakramadhyagataṃ śuci bibhītāste palāyante vīrāṇāṃ brahmatejasā idantvityādi || 176 pariṇayam vivāham || 178 atra bhairavīcakre śrutvātra bhairavīcakraṃ dūraṃ gacchanti sādhvasam sendrāmaragaṇāḥ sarve tatrāgacchanti sādaram tridaśā yatra vāñchanti tava naivedyamuttamam āmaṃ pakvaṃ yadānītaṃ vīrahastārpitaṃ śuci mucyante paśupāśebhyaḥ kalikalmaṣadūṣitāḥ sarvatra sarvadā vīraḥ sādhayet kulasādhanam niṣṭhīvanamadhovāyuṃ varṇabhedaṃ vivarjayet nindakān kulaśāstrāṇāṃ cakrāddūrataraṃ tyajet kuladharmāt paribhraṣṭo vīro'pi narakaṃ vrajet sādhvasaṃ sabhayaṃ tatra cakrasthāne || 185 kuladharmāśritā ye vai pūjyāste devavat sadā sa yāti ghoranirayamapi vedāntapāragaḥ sākṣācchivasvarūpāṇāṃ pāpaśaṅkā bhavet kutaḥ tāvattu śāmbhavācārāṃścareyuḥ śivaśāsanāt lokayātrāprasiddhyarthaṃ kuryuḥ karma pṛthak pṛthak cakramadhye sakṛt japtvā tat phalaṃ labhate sudhīḥ sakṛdetat prakurvāṇaḥ sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate nityaṃ samācaran martyo brahmanirvāṇamāpnuyāt careyuḥ kuryuḥ || 196

muṇḍāsanāt citāsanācca yat phalaṃ labhate || 198 ihāmutra sukhāvāptyai kulamārgo hi nāparaḥ gopanāt kuladharmasya kaulo'pi nārakī bhavet tattvacakraṃ kuleśāni sāmprataṃ vacmi tat śṛṇu nātrādhikāraḥ sarveṣāṃ brahmajñān sādhakān vinā śuddhāntaḥkaraṇāḥ śāntāḥ sarvaprāṇihite ratāḥ satyasaṅkalpakā brāhmāsta evātrā'dhikāriṇaḥ teṣāṃ tattvavidāṃ puṃsāṃ tattvacakre'dhikāritā yeṣāmutpadyate devi ta eva tattvacakriṇaḥ atra cakrarāje tattvacakre śāntāḥ rāgadveṣādiśūnyāḥ bhāvo bhāvanā vicintanetyarthaḥ sarvatra brahmabhāvena sādhayet tattvasādhanam brahmajñaiḥ sādhakaiḥ sārddhaṃ tattvacakraṃ samārabhet vicitrāsanamānīya kalpayedvimalāsanam āsādayettu tattvāni sthāpayedagrataḥ śive sarvatattveṣu cakreśa imaṃ mantramudīrayet brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhinā tattvasādhanam tattvacakrasādhanam || 209 atha tattvacakrasya vidhānamāha ramye ityādibhiḥ mantramudīrayet mantramevāha brahmārpaṇamiti p. 212) saptadhā vā tridhā japtvā tāni sarvāṇi śodhayet brahmajñaiḥ sādhakaiḥ sārddhaṃ vidadhyāt pānabhojanam na deśakālaniyamo na pātraniyamastathā

kulabhedaṃ varṇabhedaṃ te gacchantyadhamāṃ gatim tattvacakramanuṣṭheyaṃ dharmakāmārthamuktaye saṃnyāsavihitāt dharmān kṛpayā vaktumarhasi vidhinā yena kartavyastat sarvaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam tāni madyādīni śodhayet brāhmeṇa manunā o/ saccidekaṃ brahmeti mantreṇa gṛhasthānāmityādi vidhānam sāmpratamidānīm adhyātmavidyānipuṇaḥ saṃnyāsāśramamāśrayet tyaktvā'samarthān bandhūṃśca pravrajannārakī bhavet kulāvadhūtasaṃskāre pañcānāmadhikāritā nirmamo nilayādgacchenniṣkāmo vijitendriyaḥ prītyā'numatimanvicchet gṛhājjigamiṣurjanaḥ grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nirapekṣo gṛhādiyāt kulāvadhūtaṃ brahmajñaṃ gatvā saṃprārthayedidam gṛhādiviṣayamamatāśūnyaḥ nilayāt gṛhāt anumatimanvicchet anujñāmādadyāt nirapekṣaḥ niṣpṛhaḥ | iyāt gacchet paramānandanirvṛttaḥ paramānande nimagnaḥ prasādaṃ kuru me nātha saṃnyāsagrahaṇaṃ prati śāntaṃ vivekinaṃ vīkṣya dvitīyāśramamādiśet ṛṇatrayavimuktyarthaṃ devarṣīnarcayet pitṝn ṛṣayaḥ sanakādyāśca devabrahmarṣayastathā atra ye pitaraḥ pūjyā vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tānapi mātāmahādayo'pyevaṃ mātāmahyādayo'pi ca

yat prārthayet tadāha gṛhāśrame ityādinā śāntam uparatacittam devān ṛṣīn pitṝścārcayet pūjayet devarṣayo nāradādayo brahmarṣayo bhṛgvādayaśca pūjyāḥ atra saṃnyāsakarmaṇi pramātāmahīvṛddhapramātāmahyośca grahaṇam mātāmahān pratīcyāñca pūjayennyāsakarmaṇi devādīn kramatastatrā'vāhya pūjāṃ samācaret kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prārthayet pitṛdevatāḥ guṇātītapade yūyamanṛṇīkurutā'cirāt ṛṇatrayavinirmukta ātmaśrāddhaṃ prakalpayet mātāmahānmātāmahaprabhṛtīn yajet pūjayet kuryāt yūyamanṛṇī kūruta || 238 ātmanyātmārpaṇārthāya kuryādātmakriyāṃ sudhīḥ āvāhyā'tmapitṝn devi dadyāt piṇḍaṃ samarcayan piṇḍārthamāstareddarbhānudagagrān svakarmaṇi yuyukṣuścittaśuddhyarthamimaṃ mantraṃ śataṃ japet ūrvārukamiva bandhanān mṛtyormukṣīya mā'mṛtāt saṃsthāpya kalaśaṃ tatra guruḥ pūjāṃ samārabhet ātmakriyāṃ kuryāt tathābhūtān darbhānāstaret || 242 tameva mantramāha hrī/ tryambakamityādikam śiṣyasyeṣṭadevatāyāḥ pūjāṃ guruḥ samārabhet vidhāya pūjāṃ brahmajño vahnisthāpanamācaret

dattvā śiṣyaṃ samāhūya sākalyaṃ hāvayettu tam prāṇāpānau samānaścodānavyānau ca vāyavaḥ pṛthivī salilaṃ vahnirvāyurākāśameva ca tato vākpāṇipādāśca pāyūpasthau tataḥ param śiṣyaṃ samāhūya tena sākalyamagnau hāvayet prāṇetyādyarddhena ityantena kiñcidadhikena sapādadvayena mano buddhiśca cittañcāhaṅkāro dehajāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāṇīndriyakarmāṇi prāṇakarmāṇi yāni ca hrī/ jyotirahaṃ virajā vipāpmā bhūyāsamityapi hutvā'gnau niṣkriyo dehaṃ mṛtavaccintayettataḥ havanīyāni | tato dehajāḥ kriyāḥ hotavyāḥ || 250 prāṇakarmāṇi tānyapi havanīyāni sarvatra yojanā tato dehaṃ mṛtavaccintayet smaraṃstat paramaṃ brahma yajñasūtraṃ samuddharet vahnijāyāṃ samuccārya ghṛtāktamanale kṣipet chitvā śikhāṃ kare kṛtvā ghṛtamadhye niyojayet dīyate pāvake sthānaṃ gaccha devi namo'stu te tasmin susaṃskṛte vahnau śikhāhomaṃ samācaret skandhaṃ nayet ghṛtāktaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ yajñasūtramanale'gnau kṣipet kṛtvāṣṭamadhye niyojayet sthāpayet sarvāṇyāśramakarmāṇi nivasanti śikhopari śikhāsūtraparityāgāddehī brahmamayo bhavet

śūdrāṇāmitareṣāñca śikhāṃ hutvaiva saṃskriyā gururutthāpya taṃ śiṣyaṃ dakṣakarṇe vadedidam nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ svabhāvena sukhaṃ cara brahmamayo brahmasvarūpaḥ varṇasaṅkarāṇām || 262 ahamityasyāderlopastvārṣaḥ ātmasvarūpaṃ taṃ matvā praṇamecchirasā guruḥ tvameva tat tattvameva viśvarūpa namo'stu te svamantreṇa śikhācchedāt saṃnyāsagrahaṇaṃ bhavet svecchācāraparāṇāṃ tu pratyavāyo na vidyate viharet svecchayā śiṣyaḥ sākṣād brahmamayo bhuvi vismarannāmarūpāṇi dhyāyannātmānamātmani śirasā praṇamet namastubhyamityādikam saṃnyāsagrahaṇaṃ bhavet brahmajñānetyādi nirdvandvastatsvarūpaḥ nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ saṃnyāsī viharet kṣitau sukhaduḥkhasamo dhīro jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ sadānandaḥ śuciḥ śānto nirapekṣo nirākulaḥ vigatāmarṣabhīrdānto niḥsaṅkalpo nirudyamaḥ śītavātātapasahaḥ samo mānāpamānayoḥ kvacidapyanāsaktaḥ spṛhā yasya saḥ nirākulaḥ ākulatāśūnyaḥ

svadehanirvāhārthavyāpāraśūnyaḥ mānāpamānayorapi samaḥ harṣaviṣādaśūnya ityarthaḥ nistraiguṇyo nirvikalpo nirlobhaḥ syādasañcayī ātmāśritastathā deho jānannevaṃ sukhī bhavet ātmā sākṣī vinirlipto jñātvaivaṃ mokṣabhāg bhavet retastyāgamasūyāñca saṃnyāsī parivarjayet sarvaṃ brahmeti jānīyāt parivrāṭ sarvakarmasu deśaṃ kālaṃ tathā pātramaśnīyādavicārayan tattadvastusañcayābhāvavān eva dehaḥ pratiṣṭhati evaṃ jānan saṃnyāsī sukhī bhavet jñātvaiva saṃnyāsī mokṣabhāg bhavet avadhūto nayet kālaṃ svecchācāraparāyaṇaḥ sampūjya gandhapuṣpādyairnikhanedvāpsu majjayet svabhāvājjāyate devi pravṛttiḥ karmasaṅkule śreyastadeva jānantu yatraiva dṛḍhaniścayāḥ nāmarūpaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tadarthaṃ kalpitaṃ mayā kurvan kalpaśataṃ karma na bhavenmuktibhāg janaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ matvā gṛhasthastaṃ prapūjayet tattvavicāraṇaiḥ brahmatattvavivecanaiḥ jaleṣu karmasamūhe anurāgavantaḥ | tadeva arcādikarmaiva tīrthavratatapodānasarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet saṃskārān sarvavarṇānāṃ śṛṇuṣva gadato mama nāsaṃskṛto'dhikārī syād daive paitre ca karmaṇi

kartavyā sarvathā yatnairihāmutra hitepsubhiḥ cūḍopanayanodvāhāḥ saṃskārāḥ kathitā daśa santītyāha jīvaseka ityādinā sārddhadvayena teṣāṃ navaiva saṃskārā dvijātīnāṃ daśa smṛtāḥ kāmyānyapi varārohe kuryācchāmbhavavartmanā puraiva brahmarūpeṇa tānyuktāni mayā priye viprādivarṇabhedena kramānmantrāśca darśitāḥ praṇavādyāṃstu tān mantrān prayogeṣu niyojayet māyādyaiḥ sarvakarmāṇi kuryuḥ śaṅkaraśāsanāt sarve mantrā mayaivoktāḥ prayogo yugabhedataḥ teṣāṃ hitāya kalyāṇi kuladharmo nirūpitaḥ saṃskārādikriyāsteṣāṃ saṃkṣepeṇāpi vacmi te brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānām || 5 tasmādādau pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tāṃ devavandite hastamātrapramāṇena sthaṇḍilaṃ racayet sudhīḥ kūrcenābhyukṣya tāḥ sarvā vahninā vahnimāharet ānīya vahniṃ tatpārśve sthāpayedvāgbhavaṃ smaran hrī/ kravyādebhyo namaḥ svāhā kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet uddhṛtya tāsu rekhāsu māyādyāṃ vyāhṛtiṃ smaran tām kuśaṇḍikām vahnimāharet ānayet san tatpārśve sthaṇḍilasya pārśve sthāpayet diśi parityajet svakarmavihitaṃ nāma kṛtvā dhyāyeddhanañjayam ajārūḍhaṃ śaktidharaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam

dhyātvaivaṃ prāñjalirbhūtvā'vāhayeddhavyavāhanam adhvaraṃ rakṣa rakṣeti namaḥ svāhā tato vadet dhyāyet || 19 tathābhūtam namaḥ svāheti mantro jātaḥ yathopacāraiḥ sampūjya sapta jihvāḥ prapūjayet lelāyamāneti ca sapta jihvāḥ uttarāntaṃ maheśāni tridhā prokṣaṇamācaret tridhā paryukṣaṇaṃ kuryāttato yajñīyavastunaḥ jihvāḥ prapūjayet saptajihvāḥ prokṣaṇamācaret tridhaiva paryukṣaṇaṃ kuryāt udaksaṃsthairuttarāgraiḥ prāgagrairanyadiksthitaiḥ vāmāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kalpitāsanāt ityuktvāgnerdakṣiṇasyāṃ nikṣipedutkarādinā sīdāmīti vadan brahmā viśettatrottarāmukhaḥ sampūjya gandhapuṣpādyairbrahmāṇaṃ prārthayedidam māñca yajñapatiṃ pāhi karmasākṣinnamo'stu te prāgagrairdarbhaiḥ kuśaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ paristaredācchādayet kuśapatramagnerdakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi nikṣipet || 29 viśet tamevedaṃ prārthayet gopāya rakṣa tatra darbhamayaṃ vipraṃ kalpayet yajñasiddhaye

tāvadbhavadbhiḥ sthātavyamiti prārthya namettataḥ tridhā paryukṣya vahniñca triḥ prokṣya tadanantaram sthaṇḍilasyottare darbhānudagagrān paristaret sodakaṃ prokṣaṇīpātramājyasthālīsamitkuśān brahmābhāve sati yajñasiddhaye darbhamayaṃ vipraṃ kalpayet kuśān āstaret || 36 āsādayettānyāha sodakamityādinā divyadṛṣṭyā prokṣaṇena saṃskṛtya tadanantaram hrī/ viṣṇave dviṭhāntena pradadyādāhutitrayam vāyavyādagnikoṇāntaṃ juhuyādājyadhārayā nairṛtādīśakoṇāntaṃ juhuyādājyadhārayā agniṃ somaṃ agnīṣomau samullikhya yathākramāt mantreṇa viṣṇumuddiśyāhutitrayaṃ pradadyāt || 39 koṇamārabhyāgnikoṇāntaṃ ghṛtadhārayā juhuyāt juhuyāt hutvā vidheyakarmoktaṃ homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ āhutitrayadānāntaṃ dhārāhomaṃ pracakṣate samāpya prakṛtaṃ karma sviṣṭakṛddhomamācaret sviṣṭikṛtā vyāhṛtibhiḥ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate asmin karmaṇi deveśa pramādādbhramato'pi vā ṛtusaṃskārādau karmaṇyuktaṃ homaṃ kuryāt || 43 sviṣṭakṛddhomaṃ śobhanābhīṣṭakārakaṃ homamācaret māyādyenāmunā devi svāhāntenāhutiṃ hunet anena havanaṃ kuryāt māyayā vahnijāyayā karmaṇo'sya parabrahmannayuktaṃ vihitañca yat

māyādivahnijāyāntairbhūrbhuvaḥ svariti tribhiḥ ityamunā mantreṇāhutiṃ hunet dadyāt || 48 ityanena mantreṇa havanaṃ kuryāt hutvāgnau yajamānena dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ budhaḥ abhiṣekavidhānādāvevameva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ phalāni samyak yacchantu vahnikāntāvadhirmanuḥ phalatāmbūlasahitāhutiṃ dadyāddhutāśane prokṣaṇīpātratoyena kuśaiḥ sammārjayecchiraḥ svayañcedityādiślokastu spaṣṭārthaḥ svāhāntaḥ proktaḥ phalatāmbūlasahitāhutiṃ hutāśane'gnau dadyāt prokṣaṇīpātretyādibhiḥ āpo rakṣantu māṃ nityamāpo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ityābhyāṃ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā bhūmau bindūn vinikṣipet āpo durbhitriyāsteṣāṃ santu bhakṣantu tānapi hitvā kṛtāñjalirbhūtvā prārthayeddhavyavāhanam ārogyaṃ teja āyuṣyaṃ dehi me havyavāhana iti prārthya vītihotraṃ visṛjedamunā śive tasyeyādeśaḥ mārjanaṃ kṛtvā bhūmau kuśairbindūn viniḥkṣipen havyavāhanamagniṃ prārthayet dhāraṇāvatīṃ dhiyam | prajñām sārāsāravivekanaipuṇyam vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa tameva visṛjet svāṃ yoniṃ gaccha yajñeśa pūrayāsmanmanoratham datvā dadhnā'hutiṃ vahniṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ vicālayet

tatastu tilakaṃ kuryāt sruvasaṃlagnabhasmanā lalāṭe tilakaṃ kuryāt mantreṇānena yājñikaḥ marutāṃ brahmaṇaścaiva vasurudraprajāpateḥ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi vahnimanenaiva mantreṇa vicālayet || 64 brahmaṇe ityādistu spaṣṭārthaḥ tilakaṃ kuryāt prasādata ityasya yojanā kartavyā svaśaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt homaprakṛtakarmaṇoḥ prayojyā śubhakarmādau yatnataḥ kulasādhakaiḥ siddhyarthaṃ karmaṇānteṣāṃ carukarma nigadyate carusthālī prakartavyā tāmrī vā mṛttikodbhavā kṛtvā karma carusthālīmānayedātmasammukhe pavitrakuśamekañca sthālīmadhye niyojayet dakṣiṇāṃ yajñasādhakāya brāhmaṇāya dadyāt || 69 kulāgamaḥ carukarmaivāha carusthālītyādibhiḥ kṛtvā carusthālīmātmasammukhe deśe ānayet sthālīmadhye niyojayet sthāpayet yasmin karmaṇi ye devāḥ pūjanīyāḥ surārcite gṛhṇāmi nirvapāmīti prokṣāmīti kramādvadan pratyekañcaturo muṣṭīn devamuddiśya taṇḍulān supacet saṃskṛte vahnau sāvadhānena suvrate supakvaṃ komalaṃ jñātvā dadyāt tatra ghṛtasruvam pākavidhānataścaruṃ supacet ghṛtasruvaṃ ghṛtapūrṇasruvaṃ dadyāt
