punastridhā ghṛtaṃ dattvā sthālīmācchādayet kuśaiḥ kiñciccaruṃ samādāya jānuhomaṃ samācaret yatra ye vihitā devāstanmantrairāhutīrhunet prāyaścittātmakaṃ hutvā kuryāt karmasamāpanam vidheyaḥ śubhakarmādau karmasaṃsiddhihetave tatrādāvṛtusaṃskāraḥ kathyate kramataḥ śṛṇu dattvā kuśaiḥ sthālīmācchādayet jñātavyaḥ devānāṃ mantrairāhutīrhuneddadyāt brahmā durgā gaṇeśaśca grahā dikpatayastathā tatastu mātṛkāḥ pūjyā gauryādyāḥ ṣoḍaśa kramāt ātmano devatā caiva tathaiva kuladevatā vivāhavratayajñānāṃ sarvābhīṣṭaṃ prakalpyatām āyāntu mātaraḥ sarvā yajñotsavasamṛddhaye sapta vā pañca vā bindūn dadyāt sindūracandanaiḥ pañcadevān samarcayedityapekṣāyāmāha brahmetyādi gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ prapūjayet gaurītyādinā sārddhena āyāntu mātaraḥ sarvā ityādi || 89 ghṛtadhārāmavicchinnāṃ dattvā tatra vasuṃ yajet homadravyāṇi saṃskṛtya paceccarumanuttamam samāpya dhārāhomāntaṃ kṛtyamārtavamārabhet pradāyaikāhutiṃ dadyādimaṃ mantramudīrayan sindūracandanairdadyāt devaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet

yasmādevaṃbhūtaṃ caruṃ pacet vakṣyamāṇaṃ mantramudīrayan san ekāhutiṃ dadyāt āṃsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te sūryaṃ prajāpatiṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyāyannāhutimutsṛjet garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajau svāhāntamanunā'nena dadyādāhutimuttamām uktvā dhyātvā raviṃ viṣṇuṃ juhuyāt saṃskṛte'nale dīpayatu viṣṇuñca dhyātvā saṃkṛte'nale juhuyāt svāhāntenā'munā viṣṇuṃ dhyāyannāhutimāharet sutamādhehi ṭhadvandvamuktvā vahnau havistyajet punaḥ kāmañca māyāñca paṭhitvā'syāḥ śiraḥ spṛśet śiraścālabhya hastābhyāṃ badhvāḥ kroḍāñcale patiḥ tataḥ sviṣṭikṛtaṃ hutvā prāyaścittyā samāpayet dhyāyaṃstamevoddiśyāhutimāharedvahnau dadyāt ṭhadvandvaṃ svāhā klī/ hrīmiti mantraṃ paṭhitvā asyā bhāryāyāḥ śiraḥ spṛśet bhāskarārghyapradānācca dampatyoḥ śodhanaṃ bhavet ārtavaṃ kathitaṃ karma garbhādhānamatho śṛṇu sadanābhyantaraṃ gatvā dhyātvā devaṃ prajāpatim āvayoḥ suprajāyai tvaṃ śayye śubhakarī bhava vāmena pāṇinā'liṅgya sthāne sthāne manuṃ japet ārtavaṃ karmeti śeṣaḥ || 104 pradoṣasamaye rātryārambhasamaye || 106 śayye śubhakarī bhaveti mantraṃ paṭhet || 108

sthāne sthāne manuṃ japet kaṇṭhe ramāṃ viṃśatidhā stanadvandve śataṃ śatam japtvā yonau karaṃ dattvā kāmena saha vāgbhavam vikāśya māyayā yoniṃ striyaṃ gacchet sutāptaye nābheradhastāt citkuṇḍe raktikāyāṃ prapātayet śukrasekāntare vidvānimaṃ mantramudīrayet śataṃ japet striyaṃ gacchet || 112 raktikāyāṃ nāḍyāṃ bījaṃ prapātayet || 114 vāyunā diggarbhavatī tathā garbhavatī bhava tṛtīye garbhamāse tu caret puṃsavanaṃ gṛhī gauryādimātṛkāścaiva vasordhārāṃ prakalpayet dhārāhomāntamāpādya kuryāt puṃsavanakriyām prājāpatyaścarustatra candranāmā hutāśanaḥ patiḥ pṛcchet striyaṃ bhadre kiṃ tvaṃ pivasi triḥkṛtam prasṛtīṃstrīn pivennārī yavamāṣayutaṃ dadhi tatra puṃsavanakriyāyām patistriḥkṛtaṃ trivāraṃ striyaṃ pṛcchet saṃsthāpya vāmabhāge tāṃ caruhomaṃ samācaret ye garbhavighnakartāro ye ca garbhavināśakāḥ tān sarvān nāśaya dvandvaṃ garbharakṣāṃ kuru dviṭhaḥ dattvā bhāryāhṛdi spṛṣṭvā māyāṃ lakṣmīṃ śataṃ japet samācaret prajāpatiñca dhyāyan dvādaśāhutīḥ pradadyāt || 124 lakṣmīṃ hrī/ śrīmiti mantraṃ śatavāraṃ japet

tatastu pañcame māsi dadyāt pañcāmṛtaṃ striyai pañcāmṛtamidaṃ proktaṃ dehaśuddhau vidhīyate ekīkṛtyā'mṛtānyatra prāśayeddayitāṃ patiḥ yāvanna jāyate'patyaṃ tāvat sīmantanakriyā viṣṇave bhāsvate dhātre vahnijāyāṃ samuccaran saptadhā havanaṃ kuryāt somamuddiśya mānavaḥ samāpayet puṃsavanaṃ karmeti śeṣaḥ samāṃśakam tulyabhāgam bhāryām atra pañcame māsi prāśayet || 130 dhyātvā pratyekato dadyādāhutīḥ pañcadhā śive sīmantādvaddhakeśāntaḥ keśapāśe niveśayet śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ vidhiṃ dhyāyan māyābījaṃ samuccaran suprasūtā bhava prītā prasādādviśvakarmaṇaḥ tataḥ samāpayet karma sviṣṭikṛddhavanādibhiḥ pūrvoktavidhinā dhīro dhārāhomaṃ samāpayet viśvān devāṃśca brahmāṇamuddiśya tadanantaram vāgbhavaṃ śatadhā japtvā prāśayettanayaṃ pitā āyurvarco balaṃ medhā varddhatāṃ te sadā śiśo kṛtopanayane putre tena nāmnā samāhvayet nālachedaṃ tato dhātrī kuryādutsāhapūrvakam prāgeva nāḍikāchedāddaivīṃ paitrīṃ kriyāñcaret spaṣṭārthaḥ || 139 dakṣahastānāmikayāṅgulyā madhusarpistanayaṃ prāśayet ṣaṣṭhe vā cāṣṭame māsi nāma kuryāt prakāśataḥ bhartuḥ pārśvaṃ samāgatya prāṅmukhaṃ sthāpayet sutam

jāhnavī yamunā revā supavitrā sarasvatī ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu dharmakāmārthasiddhaye mahe raṇāya cakṣuṣe jātakarmaivameva kartavyam pārśvaṃ samāgatya sutaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ sthāpayet sahiraṇyakuśodakaiḥ śiśoḥ mūrdhnyabhiṣiñcet || 148 ūśatīriva mātaraḥ āpo janayathā ca naḥ kṛtvā sampādya dhārāntaṃ dadyāt pañcāhutīḥ sudhīḥ | cakṣuṣe iti us pratyayāntāccaturthī janayathā iti chandasi dīrghaḥ | jinvatha iti chandasi siddham || 151 karma ca sampādya sudhīḥ pitā pañcāhutīrdadyāt brahmaṇe cāhutiṃ dadyādvahnau pārthivasaṃjñake svalpākṣaraṃ sukhoccāryaṃ śubhaṃ nāma vicakṣaṇaḥ tataḥ samāpayet karma kṛtvā sviṣṭikṛdādikam nāmānnaprāśanaṃ cūḍāṃ kuryāddhīmānamantrakam caturthe māsi ṣaṣṭhe vā kuryānniṣkramaṇaṃ śiśoḥ saṃsthāpya purato vidvānimaṃ mantramudīrayet śiśoḥ śubhaṃ prakurvantu rakṣantu pathi sarvadā agnaye ityādi bahirniṣkrāmayedbālaṃ sānandaiḥ svajanaiḥ saha gatvā'dhvani kiyaddūraṃ śiśuṃ sūryaṃ nirīkṣayet paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam arghyaṃ dattvā dineśāya svajanān bhojayet pitā pitṛbhrātā pitā vāpi kuryādannāśanakriyām

evaṃ dhārāntakarmāṇi sampādya vidhivat pitā agnimuddiśya prathamāṃ dvitīyāṃ vāsavaṃ smaran brahmāṇañca samuddiśya pañcamīmāhutiṃ tyajet bahirniṣkrāmayet bālaṃ sūryaṃ nirīkṣayeddarśayet annaprāśanakriyāvidhimāha pūrvavadityādibhiḥ pañcāhutīrdadyādityapekṣāyāmāha agnimityādi || 167 kroḍe nidhāya tanayaṃ prāśayet pāyasāmṛtam tato'nnavyañjanādīnāṃ dattvā kiñcit śiśormukhe ityannaprāśanaṃ proktaṃ cūḍāvidhimataḥ śṛṇu cūḍākarma śiśoḥ kuryādbālasaṃskārasiddhaye satyāgneruttare deśe vṛṣagomayapūritam kavoṣṇaṃ salilaṃ cāpi kṣuramekaṃ suśāṇitam prāśayet bhojayet samāpayet || 170 saṃsthāpya jananīkroḍe kavoṣṇasalilaiśca taiḥ māyayā kuśapatrābhyāṃ juṣṭimekāṃ prakalpayet chittvā tu juṣṭikāmūlaṃ mātṛhaste niveśayet śarāve sthāpayet juṣṭiṃ nāpitāya pitā vadet prajāpatiṃ samuddiśya pradadyādāhutitrayam bījena kuśapatrābhyāmekāṃ juṣṭiṃ prakalpayet || 175 chittvā mātṛhaste juṣṭikāṃ niveśayet sthāpayet śiśujanako vadet vastrālaṅkāramālyena bhūṣayitvā'gnisannidhau prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ pitā

rājatyā lauhamayyā vā karṇavedhaṃ prakalpayet śāntyādidakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā cūḍākarma samāpayet śūdrasāmānyajātīnāṃ sarvametadamantrakam kartavyaṃ pañcabhirvarṇairekaṃ niṣkramaṇaṃ vinā pāvake'gnāvāhutitrayaṃ pradadyāt sviṣṭikṛtaṃ homamācaret kuryāt || 180 yasmin kṛte dvijanmāno daivapaitrādhikāriṇaḥ ṣoḍaśābdādhiko nopanetavyo niṣkriyo'pi saḥ gauryādimātṛkāścaiva vasudhārāṃ prakalpayet kuśaṇḍikoktavidhinā dhārāhomāntamācaret śikhāṃ vinā kṛtakṣauraṃ kṣaumāmbaravibhūṣitam samīpe cātmano vāme saṃsthāpya vimalāsane athetyādi | dvijātīnām brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānām daivapitryakriyāvihīno'pi bhavati devān brahmādīn || 188 brahmacaryaṃ karomīti gurave vinivedayet kāṣāyavāsasī dadyāt dīrghāyuṣṭvāya varcase tūṣṇīṃ ca mekhalāṃ dadyāt kāṣāyāmbaradhāriṇe ityuktvā mekhalā baddhvā maunī tiṣṭhet guroḥ puraḥ pālāśamathavā dadyāt kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhavam kāṣāyavāsasī kaṣāyeṇa rakte vastre dadyāt śiśave tūṣṇīmeva dadyāt mekhalāṃ baddhvā maunī san guroḥ purastiṣṭhet || 195 abhiṣicya tatastoyaiḥ pūrayedvālakāñjalim taccakṣuriti mantreṇa darśayedbhāskaraṃ guruḥ

juṣasvaikamanā vatsa mama vāco'stu te śivam śiṣyastvamukaśarmā'haṃ bhavantamabhivādaye daṇḍamapi śiśave dadyāt pūrayet jātaḥ vrate ityādi | juṣasva mama vrataṃ sevasva | śivaṃ kalyāṇam bhavantamabhivādaye iti brūyāt śiṣyaḥ sāvahito brūyādbhavato brahmacāryaham ityuktvā sadguruḥ paścāddevebhyastaṃ samarpayet samarpayāmi te sarve rakṣantu tvāṃ nirantaram guruṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya svāsane punarāviśet pañcadevān samuddiśya dadyāt pañcāhutīḥ priye brūyāt paścāt taṃ śiṣyaṃ devebhyaḥ samarpayet vahniṃ guruñca pradakṣiṇīkṛtya punaḥ svāsane āviśet pañcāhutīrdadyāt p. 264) prajāpatistathā śakro viṣṇurbrahmā śivastathā anuktamantre sarvatra vidhireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ indrādidaśadikpālā bhāskarādinavagrahāḥ ko vā'śramaste tanaya brūhi kiṃ te manogatam karotu māmāśramiṇaṃ brahmavidyopadeśataḥ prajāpatirityādyarddhena anuktamantre ityādi gururbrahmacaryābhimānina māṇavakaṃ bālakaṃ pṛcchet upadeśena māmāśramiṇaṃ bhavān karotviti prārthayet

vyāhṛtitrayamuccārya sāvitrīṃ śrāvayedguruḥ adhiṣṭhātrī tu sāvitrī mokṣārthe viniyogitā bhargaḥ padānte devasya dhīmahīti padaṃ vadet punaḥ praṇavamuccārya sāvitryarthaṃ gururvadet gāyatrīṃ śrāvayet ṛṣinyāsaṃ vidhāya sāvitryā japo vidheyaḥ pātā hartā ca saṃsraṣṭā yo devaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ato viśvamayaṃ brahma vācyaṃ vyāhṛtibhistribhiḥ jagadrūpasya savituḥ saṃsraṣṭurdīvyato vibhoḥ dhyāyema tat paraṃ satyaṃ sarvavyāpi sanātanam dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu prerayedviniyojayet śiṣyaṃ niyojayeddevi gṛhasthāśramakarmasu śāmbhavoditamārgeṇa devān pitṝn samarcaya prāptā gṛhasthāśramitā taduktaṃ karma kalpaya sadguruḥ śiṣyaṃ gṛhasthāśramakarmasu niyojayet pravartayet devān pitṝṃśca samarcaya samyak pūjaya taduktaṃ karma kalpaya kuru gṛhāṇa pādukāchatraṃ gandhamālyānulepanam yajñasūtraṃ mekhalāñca daṇḍaṃ bhikṣākaraṇḍakam śuddhopavītayugalaṃ paridhāyāmbare śubhe tato gṛhasthāśramiṇaṃ śiṣyametadvadedguruḥ svādhyāyā'śramakarmāṇi yathādharmeṇa sādhaya māyādipraṇavāntena bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayeṇa ca gandhamālyānulepanamapi gṛhāṇa vadedityapekṣāyāmāha jitendriya ityādi

dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ bhadre vratakarma samāpayet udvāhaḥ pitṛto vāpi svato'pi sidhyati priye vasordhārāṃ kalpayitvā vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ samācaret chāyāmaṇḍapamānīya upaveśya varāsane ācamya svastimṛddhiñca kathayedbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha athodvāhakriyāvidhimāha vivāhāhnītyādibhiḥ varāt praśnottaraṃ nītvā pādyādyairvaramarcayet pādayorarpayet pādyaṃ śirasyarghyaṃ nivedayet divyābharaṇaratnāni yajñasūtraṃ samarpayet samarpayāmi vākyena madhuparkaṃ kare'rpayet dakṣāṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ prāṇāhutyuktamantrakaiḥ vācayet || 233 samarpayedityarthaḥ dakṣiṇe haste samarpayet madhuparkaṃ samarpyaivaṃ punarācāmayedvaram smṛtvā viṣṇuṃ tatsaditi māsapakṣatithīstataḥ gotrapravaranāmāni pratyekaṃ prapitāmahāt dvitīyāntaṃ varaṃ brūyāt gotrapravaranāmabhiḥ dātuṃ bhavantamityuktvā vṛṇe'hamiti kīrtayet madhuparkaṃ samarpya punarvaramācāmayet || 239 varo brūyāt yathājñānaṃ karavāṇi taduttaram vastrāntareṇa saṃcchādya sthāpayedvarasammukham varasya dakṣiṇe pāṇau kanyāpāṇiṃ niyojayet dattvā'rcayitvā tanayāṃ varāya viduṣe'rpayet sthāpayet

dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ niyojayet sthāpayet dhīmate varāyārpayet dadyāt ātmanaḥ kāmamuddiśya caturthyantaṃ varaṃ vadet sācchādanāṃ prajāpatidevatākāmudīrayan varaḥ svastīti svīkuryāt sampradātā varaṃ vadet vartitavyaṃ varo bāḍhamuktvā kāmastutiṃ paṭhet kāmena tvāṃ pragṛhṇāmi kāmaḥ pūrṇo'stu cāvayoḥ pūrṇamastu śivañcāstu dharmaṃ pālayataṃ yuvām parasparaśubhālokaṃ kārayedvarakanyayoḥ jāmātre dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādacchidramavadhārayet bhṛśapratijñayorbāḍhamityamaraḥ kāmena tvāmahaṃ pragṛhṇāmi āvayoḥ kāmaḥ pūrṇo'stu vadedityapekṣāyāmāha prajāpatiprasādenetyādi kārayet kṛtamidaṃ śubhavivāhakarmā'cchidramastu ityavadhārayet kuśaṇḍikoktavidhinā vahnisthāpanamācaret dhārānta karma sampādya dadyāt pañcāhutīrvaraḥ dhyātvaikaikaṃ samuddiśya juhuyāt saṃskṛte'nale gārhasthyaṃ karma dharmeṇa yathāvadanuśīlaya prajāpatiṃ samuddiśya dadyāt vedāhutīrvadhūḥ yugmaṃ yugmaṃ samuddiśya tristridhā havanaṃ caret rātreḥ parasmin dine vā || atra vivāhakarmaṇi || 257 pañcāhutīrdadyādityapekṣāyāmāha śivamityādi pāṇiṃ gṛhṇāmi subhage ityādi vedāhutīścatasra āhutīrdadyāt

trivāraṃ havanaṃ caret kuryāt niśāyāṃ cet tadā strībhiḥ paśyed dhruvamarundhatīm sviṣṭikṛddhomataḥ pūrṇāhutyantena samāpayet kuladharmānusāreṇa gotrabhinnāsapiṇḍayā tadanujñāṃ vinā brāhmavivāhaṃ nācaret punaḥ śaivodbhavānyapatyāni dāyārhāṇi bhavanti na yathāvibhavamācchādaṃ grāsañca parameśvari cakrasya niyamenaiko dvitīyo jīvanāvadhi paśyet apatye ātmaje ātmajāyāṃ vā dhanabhājino janāt || 268 parasparecchayodvāhaṃ kuryādvīraḥ samāhitaḥ āvayoḥ śāmbhavodvāhe bhavadbhiranumanyatām aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā praṇamet kālikāṃ parām akaitavena cittena patibhāvena māṃ vṛṇu suśraddadhānā deveśi karau dadyāt karopari samāhitaḥ sāvadhānaḥ san vīra udvāhaṃ kuryāt || 270 vīraḥ paramāmuttamāṃ kālikāṃ praṇamet māṃ vṛṇviti tāṃ ramaṇīṃ vadet karau dadyāt tadā cakrasthitāḥ kaulā brūyuḥ svastīti sādaram bagalā kamalā nityā yuvāṃ rakṣantu bhairavī tatastau praṇatau vidvān śrāvayedvāgbhavaṃ ramām śāmbhavoktavidhānena kulīnābhyāṃ kuleśvari asapiṇḍāṃ bhartṛhīnāmudvahecchambhuśāsanāt

apatyārthī ṛtuṃ dṛṣṭvā cakrātīte tu tāṃ tyajet kaulāḥ sādaraṃ yathā syāttathā svastīti brūyurvadeyuḥ abhiṣiñcedityapekṣāyāmāha rājarājeśvarītyādi vāgbhavaṃ aimiti ramāṃ śrīmiti ca bījaṃ śrāvayet apatyārthī vīraḥ dvitoyamṛtuṃ dṛṣṭvā tyajet samācaredvilomena tattu māmānyajātivat bhojyapradānaṃ kaulānāṃ bhojanaṃ vihitaṃ bhavet saṅkṣepāya hitārthāya śaivadharme nirūpitam dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prabhurbhavati nānyathā vṛddhiśrāddhavidhiṃ deva kṛpayā me prakāśaya kuśaṇḍikāvidhānañca vṛddhiśrāddhañca śaṅkara matprītaye maheśāna jīvānāṃ maṅgalāya ca yatra yadvihitaṃ bhadre saviśeṣaṃ prakīrtitam anyatra yadvidhātavyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva varānane brūhi || 1 || 2 jīvasekādityādi | jīvasekājjīvasekamārabhya || 4 gṛhārāmavratādīnāṃ pratiṣṭhākarmasu priye vasordhārā ca kartavyā vṛddhiśrāddhakuśaṇḍike devatāpitṛtṛptyarthaṃ bhojyamekaṃ samutsṛjet bhaktyā striyā vidhātavyā ṛtvijā kamalānane jāmātartvigdaivapitre śastāḥ pratinidhau śive vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ pravakṣyāmi tattvataḥ śṛṇu kālike gaṅgāṃ yajñeśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ vāstvīśaṃ bhūpatiṃ yajet vāpītyādi | devapratikṛteḥ devatāpratimāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī | samutsṛjet strīti śeṣaḥ

kaścit tatrāha putra ityādi || 10 bhūpatiṃ bhūmisvāminaṃ puruṣañca kramato yajet pūjayet pañcabhirnavabhirvā'pi saptabhistribhireva vā sārddhadvayāvartanena ūrddhvāgrairacayed dvijān ekoddiṣṭe tu kathita eka eva dvijaḥ śive kauberābhimukhān kṛtvā snāpayedamunā sudhīḥ śaṃyorabhisravantu naḥ tatastu gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ pūjayet kuśabhūsurān viprān racayet || 13 ityapekṣāyāmāha vṛddhiśrāddhe ityādi kṛtvā'munā vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa snāpayet ityādyam ṣaṭpātrāṇi sadarbhāṇi sthāpayettulasītilaiḥ pūrvāsyāvuttaramukhān ṣaḍviprānupaveśayet piturmātāmahasyāpi pakṣau dvau viddhi pārvati śrāddhe nāmnyābhyudayike samullekhyā varānane tulasītilaiśca yuktāni ṣaṭpātrāṇi sthāpayet ṣaḍviprānupaveśayet nāndīmukhyaḥ samullekhyāḥ vāmāvartena dakṣārayaḥ pitṛkarmāṇi sādhayet laṅghanānmātṛmātṝṇāṃ śrāddhaṃ tadviphalaṃ bhavet tatrādau daivapakṣe tu vākyaṃ śṛṇu śucismite tattatkarmābhyudayārthamuktvā sādhakasattamaḥ dakṣiṇamukhaḥ san pitṛkarmāṇi sādhayet pitrādīnāmapyupalakṣaṇam

anujñāvākyaṃ kalpayet mātāmahānāṃ ca mātāmahyādīnāmapi priye viśveṣāñcaiva devānāṃ śrāddhaṃ padamudīrayet kariṣye parameśānītyanujñāvākyamīritam tathā mātāmahasyāpi pakṣe'nujñā prakīrtitā iti | mātāmahapakṣe'pyevamevānujñāvākyaṃ prakalpanīyam p. 286) tato japedbrahmavidyāṃ gāyatrīṃ daśadhā śive namo'stu puṣṭyai svāhāyai nityameva bhavantviti va/ hū/ phaḍiti mantreṇa śrāddhadravyāṇi śodhayet ityuktvā bhājane tasmiṃstulasīdalasaṃyutam viprebhyo jalagaṇḍūṣaṃ datvā dadyāt kuśāsanam tataḥ anujñāvākyakalpanādanantaram || 31 śrāddhadravyāṇi śodhayet mātṝrmātāmahāṃścāpi tathā mātāmahīḥ śive pitṛtrayaṃ tathā mātṛtrayaṃ mātāmahatrayam pātrāṇāṃ pātanapraśnaṃ kuryāddaivakramāt śive dve dve ca maṇḍale kuryāt tadvatpakṣadvayorapi pānārthapāthasānnāni krameṇa pariveśayet prati kuryāt || 37 maṇḍale kuryāt daivādikramataḥ pariveśayet saṃprokṣyānnāni sarvāṇi viśvān devāṃstathā pitṝn nivedya devīṃ gāyatrīṃ devatābhyastridhā paṭhet śeṣānnapiṇḍayoḥ praśnau kuryādādye tataḥ param dvijāt prāptottaraḥ piṇḍān racayeddvādaśa priye

āstarennairṛte darbhān maṇḍale yavasaṃyutān agnidagdhāśca ye ke'pi vyālavyāghrahatāśca ye maddattapiṇḍatoyābhyāṃ te yāntu tṛptimakṣayām devatābhyastridhā japtvā maṇḍalāni prakalpayet vilvaphalatulyān dvādaśa piṇḍān racayet kuśānāstaredācchādayet dve dve ca maṇḍale devi racayet pitṛtaḥ kramāt ūrddhve mūle ca madhye ca trīṃstrīn piṇḍānnivedayet svadhayā vitaret piṇḍaṃ yavamādhvīkasaṃyutam piṇḍānnivedayet dadyāt prīṇayet karalepena naikoddiṣṭeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ devatābhyastridhā japtvā piṇḍān sampūjayettataḥ vṛddhapramātāmahyai ca piṇḍaṃ dadyādityarthaḥ vidhirlepabhājipitṛprīṇanavidhirnāsti gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ piṇḍān sampūjayet vibhāvya praṇameddhīmānimaṃ mantramudīrayan svargaḥ pitā me tattṛptau tṛptamastyakhilaṃ jagat tato nirmālyamādāya prārthayedāśiṣaḥ pitṝn vedāḥ santatayo nityaṃ varddhantāṃ bāndhavā mama yācitāraḥ sadā santu mā ca yācāmi kañcana tathaiva dakṣiṇāṃ kuryāt pakṣeṣu triṣu tattvavit tameva mantramāha pitā me ityādyam dṛṣṭvā vahniṃ raviṃ vipramidaṃ pṛcchet kṛtāñjaliḥ dvijo vadet samyageva sāṅgaṃ jātaṃ vidhānataḥ pātrīyānnāni piṇḍāṃśca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet

vṛddhiśrāddhamidaṃ proktaṃ nityasaṃskārakarmaṇi śrāddhe parvaṇi kartavye pārvaṇatvena kīrtayet dakṣiṇāṃ kuryāt san vipramidaṃ pṛcchet samyageva sāṅgaṃ jātamiti dvijo vadet vākyena || 62 kīrtayeduccārayet pārvaṇena vidhānena śrāddhametadudīrayet namo'ntapuṣṭyāyityatra svadhāyai padamuccaret tasyorddhvatanamullikhya śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ teṣu prīteṣu deveśi śrāddhayajñaphalaṃ labhet mātuḥ śrāddhaṃ vinā patnyāstathā nāndīmukhaṃ vinā ekameva samuddiśyā'nujñāvākyaṃ prakalpayet yavasthāne tilā deyāḥ sarvamanyacca pūrvavat vidhānenaitacchrāddhamityudīrayet ūrddhvatanam ūrddhvabhavam || 67 śrāddhaṃ vinā anyaśrāddhādhikāritā nāstītyanvayaḥ ekoddiṣṭe śrāddhe || 70 mṛtaṃ samullikhet pretaṃ vākye dāne'nnapiṇḍayoḥ pretasyānne ca piṇḍe ca matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ niyojayet pretaśrāddhaṃ vijānīhi tadeva kulanāyike kulācārānusāreṇa mānavo'śaucamācaret śūdrasāmānyayordevi māsenāśaucakalpanā samullikheduccārayet | pretaśrāddhe'yaṃ viśeṣo vijñeyaḥ ekamuddiśyetyādi | niyojayet samarpayet

aśaucāntāt aśaucasyānto yatrāsti tadaśaucāntaṃ tasmāt kuryāt śūdrasāmānyavarṇayorupanayanasthāne vivāho jñeyaḥ śṛṇvato'pi gatāśauce sapiṇḍasya mṛtiṃ śive ṛte kulārcanādādye tathā prārabdhakarmaṇaḥ bhartrā saha kuleśāni na dahet kulakāminīm mohādbhartuścitārohāt bhavennarakagāminī pravāhayedvā nikhaneddāhayedvāpi kālike kulīnānāṃ samīpe vā maraṇaṃ śastamambike parityajati yaḥ prāṇān sa svarūpe pratiṣṭhati trirātrāśaucamiṣyate karmaṇyaśucirjano'dhikārī na syāt uttarābhimukhaṃ kṛtvā śāyayettaṃ citopari dattvā piṇḍaṃ pretamukhe dahedvahnimanuṃ smaran yavagodhūmacūrṇairvā dhātrīphalasamaṃ priye tadabhāve'nyaputrādau jyeṣṭhānukramato bhavet mṛtapretatvamuktyarthamutsṛjettilakāñcanam śavaṃ śāyayet mṛtapretatvavimuktyarthaṃ tilakāñcanamutsṛjet bhojyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dadyāt pretasvargāya satsutaḥ yad yat pretapriyaṃ dravyaṃ tat svargāya samutsṛjet svarṇenālaṅkṛtaṃ kṛtvā tyajet tatsvaravāptaye brahmajñān brāhmaṇān kaulān kṣudhitānapi bhojayet bubhukṣitān bhojayitvā pretatvaṃ mocayet pituḥ varṣe varṣe mṛtatithau dadyādannaṃ gatāsave

sarvasiddhimavāpnoti mānavaḥ kaulikārcanāt sampūrṇakāryasiddhiḥ syādekayā kaulikārcayā pretasvargāya dadyāt || 89 tatsvaravāptaye pretasvargāvāptaye || 91 bubhukṣitān kṣudhitān asitāṃ pañcamīṃ yāvat vidhireṣa śivoditaḥ karmāṇyaparihāryāṇi karmārthī kartumarhati sampūjyā'dyāṃ pañcatattvaiḥ kuryādetāni kaulikaḥ dhyāyan devīṃ smaranmantraṃ natvā gacched yathāmati tattatkalpoktavidhinā dhyānapūjāṃ samācaret kaulārcanaṃ dakṣiṇāñca kṛtvā karma samāpayet uddeśyamarcayeddevaṃ sāmānyo vidhirīritaḥ kaulikaḥ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tasmāt kaulaṃ sadārcayet vasanti kaulike dehe kinna syāt kaulikārcanāt dhanyo mānyaḥ puṇyatamaḥ sa deśaḥ prārthate suraiḥ puṇyapāpavihīnasya prabhāvaṃ vetti ko bhuvi śikṣayan lokayātrāñca kaulo viharati kṣitau vidhānamabhiṣekasya kṛpayā śrāvayasva mām guptabhāvena kurvanto narā mokṣaṃ yayuḥ purā naktaṃ vā divase kuryāt saprakāśābhiṣecanam pūrṇābhiṣekāt kaulaḥ syāt cakrādhīśaḥ kulārcakaḥ yathāśaktyupacāreṇa vighneśaṃ pūjayedguruḥ pūrṇābhiṣiktakaulasyetyādi naktaṃ rātrau || 111 vighneśam gaṇapatim

tadā'bhiṣiktakaulena saṃskāraṃ sādhayet priye khāntārṇaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ bījamasya prakīrtitam kartavyakarmaṇo vighnaśāntyarthe viniyogitā prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhyāyed gaṇapatiṃ śive saṃskāraṃ naraḥ sādhayet gakārarūpamakṣaram asya vighneśasya bījaṃ prakīrtitam iti ṛṣinyāsaṃ vidadhyāt mantreṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā gaṇapatiṃ dhyāyet tīvrā ca jvālinī nandā bhogadā kāmarūpiṇī pūrvādito'rcayitvaitāḥ pūjayet kamalāsanam tathābhūtam abhyarcya taccaturdikṣu gaṇeśaṃ gaṇanāyakam ekadantaṃ raktatuṇḍaṃ lambodaragajānanau mahodarañca vikaṭaṃ dhūmrābhaṃ vighnanāśanam teṣāmastrāṇi sampūjya vighnarājaṃ visarjayet bhojayecca pañcatattvairbrahmajñān kulasādhakān vākyena vighnarājaṃ visarjayet vidhinā adhivāsanamācaret kuryāt utsṛjet kaulatṛptyarthaṃ bhojyañcaikamapi priye arcayitvā mātṛgaṇān vasudhārāṃ prakalpayet tato gatvā guroḥ pārśvaṃ praṇamya prārthayedidam tvatpādāmbhoruhachāyāṃ dehi mūrdhni kṛpānidhe nirvighnaṃ karmaṇaḥ siddhimupaimi tvatprasādataḥ manorathamayī siddhirjāyatāṃ śivaśāsanāt āyurlakṣmīvalārogyāvāptyai saṅkalpamācaret

kāraṇaiḥ śuddhisahitairabhyarcya vṛṇuyād gurum citradhvajapatākābhiḥ phalapallavaśobhite ghṛtapradīpāvalibhistamoleśavivarjite vyajanaiścāmarairbarhairdarpaṇādyairalaṅkṛte racayenmṛṇmayīṃ tatra cūrṇairakṣatasambhavaiḥ kariṣye iti saṅkalpamācaret kuryāt vastrādibhirvṛṇuyāt citradhvajapatākābhiśca śobhite maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ vidadyāt śrīgurustataḥ kṛtvā pūrvoktamantreṇa pañcatattvāni śodhayet svārṇaṃ vā rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ ghaṭameva vā sthāpayedbrahmabījena sindūreṇā'ṅkayet śriyā mūlamantratrijāpena pūrayet kāraṇena tam navaratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā ghaṭamadhye viniḥkṣipet śyāmalairharidvarṇaiḥ || 137 pūrvoktamantreṇa madyādīni pañcatattvāni śodhayet sindūreṇā'ṅkayecca || 140 pallavaṃ tanmukhe dadyāt vāgbhavena kṛpānidhiḥ rāmāṃ māyāṃ samuccārya sthāpayet pallavopari śaktau raktaṃ śive viṣṇau śvetavāsaḥ prakīrtitam niḥkṣipya pañcatattvāni navapātrāṇi vinyaset śrīpātrantu mahāśaṅkhaṃ tāmrāṇyanyāni kalpayet ghaṭamadhye navaratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā viniḥkṣipet || 142 tanmukhe ghaṭamukhe | vāgbhavena aimiti mantreṇa sthāpayet

grīvāṃ badhnīyādityapekṣāyāmāha śaktau raktamityādi navapātrāṇi vinyaset sthāpayet rājatamityādi | mahāśaṅkhaṃ narakapālam || 148 śaktyā prakalpayet pātraṃ mahādevyāḥ prapūjane tatastvamṛtasampūrṇaghaṭamabhyarcayet sudhīḥ pīṭhadevān pūjayitvā ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret svaśaktyā pūjayediṣṭāṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet puṣpacandanavāsobhirarcayet sadguruḥ śive pūrṇābhiṣekasaṃskāre bhavadbhiranumanyatām śiṣyo bhavatu pūrṇaste paratattvaparāyaṇaḥ pratarpayet pūrvoktena tattanmantreṇa pūrvoktamantreṇa sarvabhūtabaliṃ haret dadyāt || 151 sādhayitvā || 153 paratattvaparāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahmatatparaḥ kāmaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ japtvā cālayedvimalaṃ ghaṭam tvattoyapallavaiḥ siktaḥ śiṣyo brahmarato'stu me mantrairetairvakṣyamāṇairabhiṣiñcet kṛpānvitaḥ śubhapūrṇābhiṣekārthe viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ vakṣyamāṇamantreṇa vimalaṃ ghaṭaṃ cālayet ghaṭacālanamantramevāha uttiṣṭhetyādyam ṛṣinyāso vidhātavyaḥ durgālakṣmībhavānyastvāmabhiṣiñcantu mātaraḥ etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu vagalā varadā śivā indrāṇī vāruṇī raudrī tvā'bhiṣiñcantu śaktayaḥ

śraddhā kāntirdayā śāntirabhiṣiñcantu te sadā ugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā tvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvadā rāmo bhārgavarāmastvāmabhiṣiñcantu vāriṇā kapālī bhīṣaṇaśca tvāmabhiṣiñcantu vāriṇā vipracittā mahogrā tvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvadā tvā tvām dhanadaśca maheśānaḥ siñcantu tvāṃ digīśvarāḥ rāhuḥ ketuḥ sanakṣatrā abhiṣiñcantu te grahāḥ ṛturmāso hāyanastvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvadā samudrāstvā'bhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇā taravaḥ kalpavṛkṣādyāḥ siñcantu tvāṃ mahīdharāḥ pūrṇābhiṣekasantuṣṭāstvā'bhiṣiñcantu pāthasā vinaśyantvabhiṣekena paramabrahmatejasā sūryasutā sūryaputrī yamunā patatriṇaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ || 174 vinaśyantvabhiṣekeṇa kālībījena tāḍitāḥ vidrutāste vinaśyantu ramābījena tāḍitāḥ manovākkāyajā doṣāḥ vinaśyantvabhiṣecanāt abhiṣekeṇa pūrṇena pūrṇāḥ santu manorathāḥ paśormukhāllabdhamantraṃ punaḥ saṃśrāvayed guruḥ dadyādānandanāthāntamākhyānaṃ kauliko guruḥ pañcatattvopacāreṇa gurumabhyarcayettataḥ gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā yajet kaulān śivātmakān śucaḥ śokāḥ || 176

tvametaddinamārabhyā'mukānandanāthākhyo'sīti || 182 śrīguroścaraṇau spṛṣṭvā bhaktyā natvedamarthayet parāmṛtapradānena pūrayā'smanmanoratham sacchiṣyāya vinītāya dadāmi paramāmṛtam kṛtārthaṃ kuru sacchiṣyaṃ dehyamuṣmai kulāmṛtam saśuddhikaṃ pānapātraṃ śiṣyahaste samarpayet svasya śiṣyasya kaulānāṃ kūrce ca tilakaṃ nyaset cakrānuṣṭhānavidhinā vidadhyāt pānabhojanam brahmajñānaikajananaṃ śivatvaphalasādhanam atha vāpyekarātrañca kuryāt pūrṇābhiṣecanam gurave dattvā śivātmakān śivasvarūpān kaulān yajet arthayet yācet navarātre vidhātavyaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam trirātre caikarātre ca padmamaṣṭadalaṃ priye sthāpanīyā nava ghaṭāḥ pañcābje pañcasaṅkhyakāḥ aṅgāvaraṇadevāṃśca kesarādiṣu pūjayet darśanāt sparśanād ghrāṇād dravyaśuddhirvidhīyate kauladharmāśritaḥ sādhuḥ pūjanīyo'tiyatnataḥ vaiṣṇave vaiṣṇavaḥ saure sauro gururudāhṛtaḥ ataḥ sarvātmanā dhīmān kaulād dīkṣāṃ samācaret uddhṛtya puruṣān sarvāṃste yānti paramāṃ gatim vīrāllabdhamanurvīraḥ kaulādbhavati brahmavit sveṣṭapūjāvidhāveva na tu cakreśvaro bhavet steyī mahāpātakinastatsaṃsargī ca pañcamaḥ ye nindanti durātmānaste gacchantyadhamāṃ gatim

māṃsāsthicarvaṇānandāḥ surākauladviṣāṃ nṛṇām tān garhayanto narakānniṣkṛtiṃ yānti na kvacit brahmaikaniṣṭhakaulasya tyāgānuṣṭhānayoḥ samam viśvārcayā tadarcā syāt yataḥ sarvaṃ tadanvitam garhayantaḥ nindantaḥ || 208 pṛthaktvena yajanto'pi tat prayānti viśanti ca jñeyaḥ sa eva satkaulo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ karmasamūhānuraktāḥ | tat paraṃ brahma || 211 aparṇā parayā prītyā papraccha śaṅkaraṃ prati kathitāḥ kṛpayā mahyaṃ sarvajñena tvayā prabho kṛpayā mahyaṃ māmuddiśya kathitā uktāḥ nāstikāḥ saṃśayātmānaḥ sadendriyasukhaiṣiṇaḥ teṣāṃ kā gatirīśāna viśeṣādvaktumarhasi tvaṃ jagajjananī durgā janmasaṃsāramocanī yātrābhyupāyayoriti koṣaḥ tvayaiva dhāryate devi viśvametaccarācaram tvaṃ viyattvamahaṅkārastvaṃ mahattattvarūpiṇī indriyāṇi manobuddhirviśveṣāṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ sthitiḥ nigamāgamatantrāṇi sarvaśāstramayī śivā eva duḥkhena gamyate jñāyate yā sā durgā durjñeyā ca tvam jaṅgamasthāvarametadviśvaṃ tvayaiva dhāryate cāhaṅkāraḥ | mahattattvarūpiṇī ca tvameva gatiḥ sthitiśca tadrūpā ca tvameva mahodarī mahāmāyā mahāraudrī maheśvarī tathāpi pṛcchasi prājñe prītaye kathayāmi te

jānanto'pi hitaṃ mattāḥ pāpairāśu sukhapradaiḥ mahaiśvaryaviśiṣṭā ca tvam kriyābhyāṃ sambadhyate teṣāṃ niḥśreyasārthāya kartavyaṃ yattaducyate nṝṇāṃ janayataḥ pāpaṃ kleśaśokāmayapradam tadeva pāpaṃ dvividhaṃ jānīhi kulanāyike anyasmānmucyate martyaḥ prāyaścittyā samādhinā muktaye yat kartavyaṃ vidheyaṃ taducyate || 12 duḥkhaśokavyādhipradāyakaṃ pāpaṃ janayataḥ utpādayataḥ pūrvoktaṃ pāpaṃ dvividhaṃ dviprakārakaṃ jānīhi pratīhi narakānna nivartante ihāmutra vigarhitāḥ yallaṅghanānmaheśāni rājā yātyadhamāṃ gatim śāsane ca tathā nyāye samadṛṣṭyā'valokayet upavāsaiśca dānaistān paritoṣya viśudhyati prāyaścittena samādhinā cittavṛttinirodhena ca mucyate vininditāḥ santaste narakānna nivartante tatraiva tiṣṭhantītyarthaḥ gatiṃ yāti tyaktvā rājyaṃ vanaṃ prāpya tapasā'tmānamuddharet na laghuṃ gurupāpeṣu vinā hetuṃ viparyaye pāpebhyo nirbhaye śasto laghupāpe gururdamaḥ pāpādbhīrau praśastaḥ syād gurupāpe laghurdamaḥ pāpatāratabhyādupavāsadānayostāratamyaṃ boddhavyam tyaktvā vanaṃ prāpya tapasā'tmānamuddharet śodhayet vidadhyāt laghupāpe'pi gururdamaḥ śastaḥ

laghurdamaḥ praśastaḥ bahumānyo'pi daṇḍyaḥ syādvacobhiravanībhṛtā yo na kuryānmahīpālaḥ sa mahāpātakī bhavet na tyajet svāminaṃ bhāryā vinā tānatipāpinaḥ saṃrakṣeyuḥ prajā yatnairanyathā yāntyadhogatim gantāro jñānato ye ca mahāgurunighātakāḥ mahīpālo na kuryāt sa mahāpātakī bhavet tyājyā evetyarthaḥ rājyādikamarakṣantyastā adhogatiṃ yānti viśvāsaghātino lokā atipātakinaḥ smṛtāḥ tāsāmapi sakāmānāṃ tadeva vihitaṃ śive pitāmahasya vanitāṃ tathā mātāmahasya ca bhāgineyīṃ prabhoḥ patnīṃ tanayāñca kumārikām viśvāsaghātino lokāḥ te'tipātakinaḥ smṛtāḥ || 29 maraṇameva damanaṃ vihitam gṛhānniryāpaṇaṃ caiva pāpādasmādvimuktaye sarvasvaharaṇaṃ keśavapanaṃ gacchato damaḥ brāhmeṇa vāpi śaivena jñātvā tāstatkṣaṇaṃ tyajet damastasya dhanādānaṃ māsaikaṃ kaṇabhojanam vivāho bhavet tadā jñātvā tāḥ strīstatkṣaṇameva tyajet kaṇabhojanaṃ ca damo jñeyaḥ brāhmaṇīṃ gacchatāṃ jñānālliṅgacchedo damaḥ smṛtaḥ vīrastrīgāmināṃ tāsāmevameva damo vidhiḥ daṇḍastasya dhanādānaṃ trimāsaṃ kaṇabhojanam balātkāragatā bhāryā tyājyā pālyā bhavet śive

liṅgacchedo damo daṇḍaḥ smṛtaḥ pūrvakāddhāñaḥ upasarge dhoḥ kiriti karmaṇi kiḥ kaṇabhojanaṃ ca daṇḍo bhavati sarvathā hi parityājyā syāccet paragatā sakṛt śuddhirbhavati deveśi trirātraṃ kaṇabhojanāt vadha eva vidhātavyo bhūbhṛtā śambhuśāsanāt vadhastasya vidhātavyo na kṣantavyaḥ kadāpi saḥ cettadā sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa parityājyā syāt kaṇabhojanācchuddhirbhavati śambhuśāsanādvadha eva vidhātavyaḥ tā eva dārā vijñeyā anyāḥ sarvāḥ parastriyaḥ pariṣvajyopavāsena viśudhyed dviguṇakramāt uktopavāsavidhinā svātmānaṃ pariśodhayet hasan gurutaraṃ martyaḥ śudhyed dvirupavāsataḥ anyāstadbhinnāḥ sarvāḥ parastriyo vijñeyāḥ aṣṭabhistaiḥ śuddhiḥ ātmānaṃ pariśodhayet śudhyet trirātramaśanaṃ tyaktvā śuddho bhavati mānavaḥ nṛpastadā tāṃ tajjāraṃ śāsyāt śāstrānusārataḥ tyaktvā tāṃ poṣayed grāsaistiṣṭheccet patiśāsane nighnan vanitayā jāraṃ vadhārho naiva bhūbhṛtaḥ dehamanobrahmasvabhāvadhṛtibuddhiṣvi ti koṣaḥ śāstrānusārataḥ pūrvoktavidhānataḥ śāsyāt laṅgheta tadā grāsaiḥ kavalaiḥ poṣayet

prayāṇādbhāṣaṇāttatra tyāgārhā syāt kulāṅganā abhāve pitṛbandhūnāṃ tiṣṭhantī dāyamarhati paryaṅgaṃ raktavāsaśca vidhavā parivarjayet devavratā nayet kālaṃ vaidhavyaṃ dharmamāśritā prayāṇādbhāṣaṇācca kulāṅganāpi tyāgārhā syāt pitṛbandhūnāṃ vaśe tiṣṭhantī satī strī dāyamarhati vastraṃ ca parivarjayet kṣipedityarthaḥ niyataṃ pālane tasya mātṛbandhuḥ praśasyate mātuḥ pituḥ sodarāśca vijñeyāḥ mātṛbāndhavāḥ pituḥ pituḥ sodarāśca vijñeyāḥ pitṛbāndhavāḥ patyuḥ pituḥ sodarāśca vijñeyāḥ patibāndhavāḥ ayogyasūnave putrahīnamātāmahāya ca praśasyate piturmātāmahasya sodarāśca mātṛbāndhavā vijñeyāḥ sodarāśca pitṛbāndhavā vijñeyāḥ patyuḥpituḥ śvaśurasya sodarāśca patibāndhavā vijñeyāḥ dāpayennṛpatiḥ puṃsā yathāvibhavamambike tryahaṃ santāḍayan raktaṃ pātayan sapta vāsarān vadannupoṣya saptāhaṃ viśudhyecchivaśāsanāt jānannudvāhayet bhūyo vidhireṣaḥ śivoditaḥ puṃsā dāpayet || 62 tyajet | tasyā raktaṃ pātayan sapta vāsarānaśanaṃ tyajet viśudhyet śamerḍha iti ḍhaḥ

sāpyudvāhyā punaḥ pitrā śaivadharmeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ prasūte tanayaṃ yogyaṃ na sā patnī na saḥ sutaḥ tadupāyakṛtaṃ tāñca yātayettivratāḍanaiḥ tatprayoktuśca tasyāśca pātakaṃ syādbadhodbhavam vidhirayaṃ śaivadharmeṣu nirūpitaḥ yātayet pīḍayet manuṣyavadhajanyaṃ pātakaṃ syāt vadhastasya vidhātavyaḥ sarvathā dharaṇībhṛtā draviṇādānatastīvratāḍanaistaṃ viśodhayet ajñānavadhināṃ daṇḍo vihitastasya pāpinaḥ nihatya parameśāni na pāpārho bhavennaraḥ vadho vidhātavyaḥ | tata eva tasya śuddhirnānyatheti bhāvaḥ dravyaharaṇatastīvratāḍanaiśca viśodhayet daṇḍaḥ sa vihitaḥ kṣetradārāpahārī ca ṣaḍete ātatāyinaḥ || iti prahāre ca praharaṇaṃ nṛṣu pāpaṃ cikīrṣuṣu dhanādānāddhastadāhāt kramatastaṃ viśodhayet prahartā daṇḍanīyaḥ syād vadhārho na hi bhūbhṛtaḥ raho hitaiṣiṇo bhṛtyān bhedakānnṛpasainyayoḥ praharaṇaṃ vidhātavyam hastadāhādrājā viśodhayet syāt hatvā narapatistvetān naiva kilviṣabhāg bhavet bhartureva vadhastatra praharturna śivājñayā dhanadaṇḍena vā kāyadamenā'sya viśodhanam

dūṣakān kuladharmāṇāṃ śāsyādrājā vigarhitān hatvā narapatiḥ kilviṣabhāknaiva bhavet || 78 tasyaiva vadha iti sūcitam vā viśodhanaṃ bhavet dūṣakāṃśca vigarhitānninditānetān rājā śāsyāt vivādayantaṃ lokāṃśca deśānniryāpayennṛpaḥ deśānniryāpayedrājā patitān duṣkṛtātmanaḥ yathāpavādaṃ te śāsyā dharmajñena mahībhṛtā nṛpatirdāpayettena janāyā'niṣṭabhāgine deśānniryāpayenniṣkāśayet saptamī ca laghuśāsanaṃ vidheyamityarthaḥ tatsammitaṃ dhanaṃ nṛpatirdāpayet karasya bāhvośchedo vā kāryo mūlyaṃ vicārayan balenā'pahṛtāṃ nṝṇāṃ steyivadvihito damaḥ viśodhayettaṃ pakṣaikaṃ saptāhaṃ vā'śayan kaṇam yajñairvrataistapodānaiḥ prāyaścittairna niṣkṛtiḥ bāhvośchedaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ nṝṇāṃ steyivaddamo vihitaḥ bhojayannṛpo viśodhayet pāpavināśakairetairniṣkṛtirduṣkṛtān suktirna syāt śāsyāttāṃstīvradaṇḍena deśānniryāpayennṛpaḥ abhāve dvāvapi śive prasiddhau yadi dhārmikau parasparamayuktañced agrāhyaṃ sākṣiṇāṃ vacaḥ mūkānāmeḍamūkānāṃ śirasā'ṅgīkṛtirlipiḥ

tān nṛpastīvradaṇḍena śāsyāttathā deśānniryāpayet bhavetāṃ tadā dvāvapi sākṣiṇau pramāṇaṃ syātām syāt pramāṇaṃ syāt viśeṣādvyavahāreṣu na vinaśyecciraṃ yataḥ daṇḍastasya vidhātavyo dvipādyaṃ kūṭasākṣiṇaḥ svīyārthe tatpramāṇaṃ syādvacaso bahusākṣiṇām tathā'nṛtaṃ samāśritya pātakānyakhilānyapi tāḍanāddamanādrājā na pāpārhaḥ śivājñayā yataściraṃ bahukālaṃ lipirna vinaśyecciraṃ tiṣṭhedityarthaḥ dvipādyaṃ dviguṇo daṇḍo rājñā vidhātavyaḥ syāt gaṅgātoyaṃ devamūrtiṃ kulaśāstraṃ kulāmṛtam tatrā'nṛtaṃ vadan martyaḥ kalpāntaṃ narakaṃ vrajet tat kāryaṃ sarvathā martyaiḥ svīkṛtaṃ śapathena yat bhrameṇāpi tamullaṅghya dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇāśanaiḥ rājā śivājñayā pāpārhaḥ pāpabhāk na syāt || 98 kalpaparyantaṃ narakaṃ vrajet narakānnarakāntaraṃ gacchet tasyaivā'vaśyakṛtyatvamiti dhvanitam śudhyet mokṣāya śreyase na syāt kaule pāpāya kevalam jananī bhogamokṣāṇāṃ nāśinī vipadāṃ rujām sarvasiddhipradā jñānabuddhividyāvivardhinī sevyate sarvadā devairādye svābhīṣṭasiddhaye pibanti madirāṃ martyā amartyā eva te kṣitau

kuladharma iti bhāvaḥ vipattīnāṃ rujāṃ rogāṇāṃ ca nāśinī setyadhyāhāralabhye || 106 na jāne pañcatatvānāṃ sevanāt kiṃ phalaṃ bhavet nṝṇāṃ vināśayet sarvaṃ buddhimāyuryaśo dhanam buddhirvinaśyati prāyo lokānāṃ mattacetasām svāniṣṭaṃ ca parāniṣṭaṃ jāyate'smāt pade pade atyāsaktajanān kāyadhanadaṇḍena śodhayet madirāṃ pibanti te kṣitau pṛthivyāmamartyā devā eva bhavanti buddhimāyuryaśodhanamityādi sarvaṃ vināśayet buddhiḥ prāyo vinaśyati kāyadhanadaṇḍena śodhayet || 112 deśakālavibhedena buddhibhraṃśo bhavennṝṇām skhaladvākpāṇipāddṛgbhiratipānaṃ vicārayet devatāgurumaryādollaṅghino bhayarūpiṇaḥ dahejjihvāṃ haredarthān tāḍayettaṃ ca pārthivaḥ tamugraṃ yātayedrājā draviṇaṃ cāharettataḥ vicaladbhirvacohastapādanetrairatipānaṃ vicārayet vilakṣayet tamugraṃ raudraṃ rājā yātayet tato draviṇaṃ ca āharet dhanādānena taṃ śāsyāt prajāprītikaro nṛpaḥ paśureva sa mantavyaḥ kuladharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ tyājyo bhavati kaulānāṃ daṇḍanīyo'pi bhūbhṛtaḥ śudhyeyurbhāryayā sārdhaṃ pañcāhaṃ kaṇabhojanāt bhuktvā'pyaśodhitaṃ māṃsamupavāsadvayaṃ caret mattaṃ prajāprītikaro nṛpo dhanādānena śāsyāt

paśureva mantavyaḥ yataḥ sa kuladharmādbahiṣkṛtaḥ kaulānāṃ tyājyo bhūbhṛto daṇḍanīyo'pi bhavati bhāryayā sārdhaṃ pañcāhaṃ kaṇabhojanācchudhyeyuḥ upavāsadvayaṃ caret kuryāt avaidhaṃ pañcamaṃ kurvan rājño daṇḍena śudhyati upoṣya pakṣaṃ śuddhaḥ syāt prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam attvā śudhyennaraḥ pāpādupavāsaistribhiḥ priye khādannannaṃ viśuddhaḥ syāt pakṣamekamupoṣitaḥ śudhyenmāsopavāsenā'jñānāt pakṣopavāsataḥ śudhyati prāyaścittaṃ smṛtam narastribhirupavāsaiḥ pāpāt śudhyet pakṣamekamupoṣitaḥ san viśuddhaḥ syāt dinatrayopavāsena viśuddhaḥ syānmamājñayā vīrahastārpitaṃ vāpi tadaśnannaiva pāpabhāk niṣiddhenā'danenāpi rakṣan prāṇānna pātakī alakṣite'pi duṣyāṇāṃ bhakṣyadoṣo na vidyate bhuñjīta tadā pakṣopavāsataḥ śudhyet pāpabhāk naiva bhavet na hanyāddevatārthe'pi hatvā ca pātakī bhavet ajñānādācaredardhaṃ vrataṃ śaṅkaraśāsanāt na kṣārayogaṃ vasane yāvanna vratamācaret māsaṃ bhaikṣānnamaśnīyāt kṛcchravratamidaṃ śive teṣāmavijñāne'pi bhakṣyadoṣo na vidyate pātakī bhavet

śaṅkaraśāsanādardhaṃ vratamācaret kuryāt vasane vastre kṣārayogaṃ ca na kuryāt bhojayitvā vimuktaḥ syād jñānagovadhapātakāt bāhujādyā viśudhyeyuḥ pādanyūnakramāt priye upavāsaistribhiḥ śudhyenmānavaḥ kṛtakilviṣaḥ mayūraśukahaṃsāṃśca sajyotiraśanaṃ tyajet jñānagovadhapātakājjano vimuktaḥ syāt pādapādanyūnaṃ vrataṃ karaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ mānavastribhirupavāsaiḥ śudhyet jyotirnā bhāskare'gnau ca klībaṃ bhadyota dṛṣṭiṣviti rudraḥ nirasthijīvino hatvā manastāpena śuddhyati na pāpārho bhaveddevi rājño dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ kṛtāyāṃ vaidhahiṃsāyāṃ naraḥ pāpairna lipyate aśucau devatāsparśe gāyatrījapamācaret nirasthijīvino'sthirahitajantūn hatvā manastāpena śudhyati kṛtāyāṃ satyāṃ naraḥ pāpairna lipyate nindannetān vadan krūraṃ śudhyet pañcopavāsataḥ sārdhadvayopavāsena mukto bhavati pātakāt niṣiddhakaulikācāraṃ deśaṃ śāstramapi tyajet kuladharmātpatedbhūyaḥ śudhyet pūrṇābhiṣekataḥ aśucāvaśauce devatāsparśe ca gāyatrījapamācaret śudhyet mānavastyajet upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścitte vidhīyate mānavaḥ prāṇarakṣārthaṃ na bhraśyedupavāsataḥ

tadā pratyupavāsañca bhojayeddvādaśa dvijān ayuktaṃ karma kurvāṇo manastāpairviśudhyati pūrṇābhiṣekataḥ śudhyet prāyaścitte sa vidhīyate kriyate patet | ekāñjalitoyapānādupavāso na vinaśyediti tattvam dvādaśa dvijān brāhmaṇān bhojayet naro manastāpairviśudhyati naśyanti japanāddevyāḥ sāvitryāḥ kaulabhojanāt yoṣitāṃ tu viśeṣo'yaṃ patireko mahāguruḥ svarṇadānena pūtāḥ syurdaive paitrye'dhikāriṇaḥ gṛhaṃ viśodhayeddhomairvyāhṛtyā śatasaṃkhyakaiḥ bhojanācca naśyanti yoṣitāṃ strīṇāntu patireko mahāguruḥ smṛto'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ daive paitrye ca karmaṇi adhikāriṇaḥ syuḥ śatasaṃkhyakairhomairviśodhayet uddhṛtya kuṇapaṃ tebhyastatastān pariśodhayet pūrṇaistrisaptakumbhaistān plāvayediti śodhanam sapaṅkaṃ salilaṃ sarvamuddhṛtyāplāvayettu tān śatakumbhajaloddhārairabhiṣekeṇa śodhayet apeyasalilāsteṣāṃ pratiṣṭhāmapi nācaret pariśodhayet śodhanaṃ ayaṃ śodhanaprakāraḥ tānāplāvayet śodhayet dinamekaṃ nirāhāraḥ śudhyet pañcāmṛtāśanāt

dūṣakaṃ kuladharmāṇāṃ madyapāñca kulastriyam paśyan sūryaṃ smaran viṣṇuṃ sacelaḥ snānamācaret nīcavṛttiṃ caranto'pi śudhyeyustridinavratāt smarannaraḥ sacelaḥ savastraḥ snānamācaret || 163 kurvanto dvijātayo brāhmaṇāstridinavratāt śudhyeyuḥ vāritārthapravaktā'pi pañcāhamaśanaṃ tyajet tathaiva kulaśāstrāṇi śudhyedekopavāsataḥ kūṭenārthaṃ kalpayantaḥ patitā yāntyadhogatim smṛtam doṣabhāgitvamiti dhvanitam ihāmutrārthadaṃ dharmyaṃ pāvanaṃ hitakārakam yān rakṣan pravidanrājā svacchandaṃ pālayet prajāḥ mithaste vivadiṣyanti gurusvajanabandhubhiḥ pāpāśrayā bhaviṣyanti hiṃsayā ca jihīrṣayā niyojyate yamāśritya na bhraśyeyuḥ śubhānnarāḥ svairaṃ prajāḥ pālayedrakṣet tathaiva vibhajeddāyān nṛṇāṃ sambandhabhedataḥ tatraudvāhikasambandhādaparo balavattaraḥ adha ūrdhvakramādatra pumān mukhyataraḥ smṛtaḥ vibhaktān kuryāt | dāyo dāne dhane puṃsi vācyaliṅgastu dātari jñeyaḥ anena vidhinā dhīrā vibhajeyuḥ kramāddhanam bhāryāyāmapi dāyārhaḥ putra eva na cāparaḥ jyeṣṭhe rājyādhikāritvaṃ tattu vaṃśānusārataḥ mukhyataraḥ pradhānataraḥ smṛtaḥ

kramādvibhajeyurvaṇṭayeyuḥ pituścordhvabhavatvenā'jyāyastvāddāyārhatvaṃ netyarthaḥ tasmin sthite vibhāgārhaṃ na bhavet paitṛkaṃ vasu tebhyastaddhanamāhṛtya pitṝṇaṃ dāpayennṛpaḥ ṛṇenāpi tathā baddhaḥ svayameva na cāparaḥ draviṇaṃ vibhajya sarve gṛhṇīyuriti bhāvaḥ vaṇṭanayogyaṃ na bhavet nṛpo rājā pitṝṇaṃ tātasambandhi ṛṇaṃ tairdāpayet na cāparastadanyaḥ kaścana baddho bhavet aṃśinaḥ prāptumarhanti svaṃ svamaṃśaṃ vibhāgataḥ teṣāmasammatau rājā samadṛṣṭyāṃśamācaret mūlyaṃ vā tadupasvatvamaṃśināṃ vibhajennṛpaḥ punarvibhajya taddravyamaprāptāṃśāya dāpayet labdhumarhanti yogyā bhavanti śeṣe iti ṣaṣṭhī punarvivādayaṃstatra śāsyo bhavati bhūbhṛtaḥ pautra eva dhanārhaḥ syādadhastājjanmagauravāt janmataḥ sannikarṣeṇa pitaivā'sya dhanaṃ haret mṛtasya pautro dhanabhāk yato mukhyataraḥ pumān dravyaṃ vibhajya nṛpo dāyādairdāpayet gauravādgurutvāddhetoḥ pautra eva dhanārho dhanayogyaḥ syāt ato'tra gīyate lokaiḥ putrarūpaḥ svayaṃ pitā aputrasya haredrikthaṃ patyurdehārdhahāriṇī naiva dātuṃ na vikretuṃ samarthā svadhanaṃ vinā putrarūpa iti gīyate śabdyate

rikthamṛkthaṃ dhanaṃ vasvityamaraḥ vinā | svakīyaṃ tu dhanaṃ dātuṃ vikretuṃ śaknotītyarthaḥ svakṛtyopārjitaṃ yacca strīdhanaṃ tat prakīrtitam tadāsannataro rikthamadha ūrdhvakramādharet tadabhāve pitṛbandhostiṣṭhantī dāyamarhati labhate jīvanaṃ mātraṃ bharturvibhavahāriṇaḥ jano haret | etattu sāmānyata uktaṃ viśeṣatastvagre vakṣyate bhajeran svāmino vittaṃ samāṃśena śucismite punaḥ svāmipadaṃ gatvā dhanaṃ duhitaraṃ vrajet tanmṛtau svāminaṃ prāpya śvaśurāttatsutāmiyāt ityamaraḥ samāṃśena tulyabhāgena bhajeran severan gacchediti sūcayāñcakre tasyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ putreṇa bhartrā śvaśuragambhavet jananyapi tathā'pnoti patihīnā bhavedyadi mṛtau jananyāstaṃ prāpya pitrā gacchedvimātaram yenaivā'dhastanaṃ prāptaṃ tenaivordhvaṃ tadā vrajet etacca bhartṛduhitrādibhrātrīyaparyantābhāve boddhavyam tatputrāṇāñcā'sattve boddhavyam patihīnā svāmirahitā bhavet tadā tajjananyapyāpnoti prāpya pitrā vimātaraṃ gacchet patyau sthite'napatyāyā mṛtau pitṛvyamāśrayet ataḥ satyāṃ sodarāyāṃ vaimātreyo dhanaṃ haret vaimātreyagataṃ vittaṃ vaimātreyānvayo bhajet tadapatyagāmitaivetyasūsucat

bhaginyāṃ satyāmapi vaimātreyo vimātṛjo dhanaṃ haret vaimātreyānvayo vimātṛjasantatirbhajet seveta dhanaṃ pitṛgatatvena vibhajetāṃ samāṃśinau yatra yadbādhitaṃ vittaṃ tanmṛtāvaparaṃ vrajet udvāhayantyo'nūḍhāṃ tu pituḥ sādhāraṇairdhanaiḥ anyattu draviṇaṃ yasmādāptaṃ tatpadamāśrayet gṛhṇīyātāmityarthaḥ tuśabdena vivāhyamānā'pi pitṛdravyaṃ vibhajet puṇyantu tadupasvatvairna śaktā dānavikraye pitāmahagataṃ rikthaṃ tatputreṇa snuṣāṃ vrajet adhobhavānāṃ mukhyatvāt bhrātaiva dhanabhāg bhavet yasmājjanādāptaṃ labdhaṃ tatpadamāśrayedbhajet teṣāṃ dāne vikraye ca śaktā samarthā na bhavet pitāmahasyātmajena snuṣāṃ putrapatnīṃ vrajet bhajedityarthaḥ dhanaṃ pitṛpadaṃ gatvā prayāturbhrātaraṃ bhajet duhitrapatyaṃ dhanabhāg dhanaṃ yasmādadhomukham puṃso mukhyataratvena dhanahārī bhavet pitā pretasya dhanahārī syāt pituḥ sambandhagauravāt syādato duhitrapatyameva dhanabhāg bhavet dhanahārī syāt svārthe'ṇ ato'tra sannikṛṣṭo'pi mātulo nāpnuyāddhanam pitāmahasya draviṇāt svapiturdāyamarhati pitāmahadhanaṃ saumyā hareccenmṛtamātṛkā

vitte pitṛgate devi pautrī tatrā'dhikāriṇī draviṇāt dravyāt svapiturdāyaṃ prāptumarhati gṛhṇīyāt ūrdhvagāmidhane śreṣṭhaḥ pumānūrdhvodbhavo bhavet pretasya vibhavaṃ hartuṃ naiva śaknoti tatpitā pūrvoktavidhinā rikthaṃ mātāmahakulaṃ bhajet adha ūrdhvakrameṇaivaṃ pumāṃsaṃ striyamāśrayet adhastājjanmagauravāt pautrī tatra pitṛgate vitte'dhikāriṇī syāt śreṣṭho bhavet yathākramaṃ tā eva pretadhanaṃ hartuṃ śaknuvantītyarthaḥ mātāmahakulaṃ bhajet seveta mṛtasya śaivītanayo na piturdāyabhāg bhavet grāsamācchādanaṃ bhadre svaḥprayāturyathā dhanam saumyāñcennādhikāro'syāḥ pitrādīnāṃ dhane priye yathāvibhavaṃ grāsamācchādanaṃ ca labheran prāpnuyuḥ numāgamaśchāndasaḥ krodhādvā lobhato vāpi sa bhavellokagarhitaḥ hareyuḥ kramato vittaṃ mṛtasya śivaśāsanāt sodakā daśamāntāḥ syustataḥ kevalagotrajāḥ yaḥ sa pitā lokagarhito lokanindito bhavet tadabhāve vedādhyāpakaḥ tadasattve tu rājā ceti karmaṇyadhikaraṇe ceti karmaṇi pañcamī avibhaktavidhānena bhajeraṃstaddhanaṃ punaḥ mṛte'pi tasya dāyādāstādṛgvibhavabhāginaḥ dadyuḥ piṇḍaṃ ta evā'sya śaivabhāryāsutaṃ vinā

dhanabhāgitvasambandhāt trirātraṃ vihitaṃ tathā punaravibhaktavidhānena dāyādā bhajeran mṛte'pi maraṇe'pi te dāyādāstādṛgvibhavabhāgino bhaveyuḥ copalakṣaṇam śravaṇāccheṣadivasairviśuddhyeyurdvijādayaḥ pūrṇe trirātraṃ vihitaṃ na cet saṃvatsarāt param trirātramaśuciḥ putrastathā bhartuḥ pativratā vihitam | lokaḥ syādbhuvane jane ityamaraḥ tasmāt | karaṇādhikaraṇayośca ityadhikaraṇe lyuṭ maraṇaviṣayakamidaṃ vacanam gurvaśaucena martyānāṃ śuddhistatra vidhīyate vyāpyavyāpakayormadhye garīyo vyāpakaṃ smṛtam pūrvāśaucena śuddhiḥ syādaghavṛddhyā dinadvayam strī trirātramaśuciḥ syāt martyānāṃ śuddhirvidhīyate gurutaraṃ smṛtam tatrāpyevamevāvagantavyam jātepariṇaye pitrormṛtau tryahamudāhṛtam tathā gṛhītṛgotreṇa dattaputrasya gotritā svagotranāmānyullikhya saṃskuryāt svajanaiḥ saha tryahaṃ tridinamaśaucamudāhṛtam gotritā gotravattā syāt saṃskāraṃ kuryāt ādātrordattake tadvadyato'sya pitarau hi tau pañcavarṣādhiko bālo dattako na praśasyate

utpādakaḥ pitṛvyaḥ syāt sarvakarmasu kālike saṃrakṣenniyamāṃstasya tadbandhūn paritoṣayet syātāmatastaddhana piṇḍayostasyā'dhikāritetyarthaḥ bāloḥ asau dattako na praśasyate nā'śaucaṃ maraṇe teṣāṃ naiva dāyādhikāritā mahāpātakināñcāpi mṛtau nā'śaucamācaret pālayedrakṣayedrājā yāvaddvādaśavatsaram bandhūnapi paritoṣayet kuryāt rakṣayet trirātrānte tatsutādyaiḥ pretatvaṃ parimocayet vibhajya nṛpatirdadyādanyathā pātakī bhavet tasyaiva nṛpatiḥ pātā yato bhūpaḥ prajāprabhuḥ tasyaiva dārāḥ putrāśca dhanaṃ tasyaiva nānyathā teṣāṃ pretatvañca taireva parimocayet pātakī bhavet bhavet | nisvastu durvidho dīno daridro durgato'pi saḥ ityamaraḥ svajanāyā'thavā'nyasmai dāyādānumatiṃ vinā asthāvaraṃ paitṛkaṃ ca svecchayā dātumarhati janake ca jananyāṃ vā bhrātaryevaṃ svasaryapi asthāvaraṃ paitṛkañca dātuṃ sarvaṃ kṣamo bhavet etatsarvamanyathā na bhavet pādasya pūraṇe'pyuktaṃ navasvartheṣu cāvyayam dātumarhati puṃsā tadanyathā kartuṃ putrādyairnaiva śakyate

na prabhuḥ punarādātuṃ dharmo hyasya yataḥ prabhuḥ svayaṃ vā tatpratinidhirdharmārthaṃ viniyojayet yāvat | tat dhanaṃ putrādyairanyathākartuṃ naiva śakyate dhanasya | hīti niścitau | dharmaḥ prabhuḥ svāmī mukhyasyābhāve tatsadṛśo ya upādīyate sa pratinidhiḥ dadyāt snehena taccānyo nānyathā kartumarhati dadātyanyaiśca dāyādaiḥ pratiroddhuṃ na śakyate pitrye samāṃśā dāyādā na lābhārhā vinā'rjakam dāyādānāṃ taddhanebhya uddhartā dvyaṃśamarhati tadā'nyairdāyādaiḥ pratiroddhuṃ vārayituṃ na śakyate lābhārhāstu na syuḥ | kintvarjaka evaiko lābhārha ityarthaḥ śarīrantu pituryasmāt kinna syāt paitṛkaṃ vasu sarvaṃ tat pitṛsaṃkrāntaṃ tadā svopārjitaṃ kutaḥ svopārjitaṃ tadeva syāt sa tatsvāmī na cāparaḥ labhanta ityarthaḥ paitṛkameva bhavet dhanasya prabhurna cāparo'rjakabhinnaḥ vāmī mātāmahān kareṇāpi praharannaiva dāyabhāk hatānāmanyadāyādā bhaveyurdhanabhāginaḥ yāvajjivanamarhanti na te syurdāyabhāginaḥ nṛpastatsvāmine prāptrā dāpayet suvicārayan dāyabhāgitvaṃ na bhavediti sūcitam hanturbhinnā dāyādā dhanabhāgino bhaveyuḥ na syuḥ prāptā tatra bhavet svāmī daśamāṃśaṃ nṛpe'rpayet

yogye kretari vikretuṃ na śaktaḥ sthāvarādhipaḥ tayorabhāve suhṛdo vikretricchā garīyasī prāptadhanasyāpi pataye prāptrā puṃsā dāpayen kṛtīti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī ṣyañ tanmūlyaṃ cet samīpastho rāti kretā na cāparaḥ sannidhisthastadā'nyasmai gṛhī śakto'tivikraye śravaṇādeva tanmūlyaṃ dattvā'sau prāptumarhati vikretumicchettasmai eva vikīṇīteti bhāvaḥ bhavet kintu samīpastha eva mūlyaṃ dattvā krīṇīyādityarthaḥ mūlyaṃ dattvāpi nāpnoti sthāvaraṃ sannidhisthitaḥ anādiṣṭo'pi tāṃ bhūmiṃ sampannāṃ kartumarhati dattvā daśāṃśaṃ bhuñjīyāt bhūmisvāmī yato nṛpaḥ nārhatīti sūcitam dattvāpi sthāvaradhanaṃ nāpnoti na labhate āraṇyā araṇyāṇṇa iti ṇaḥ parāniṣṭakare deśe na gṛhaṃ kartumarhati pānādhikāriṇaḥ sarve secane'ntikavāsinaḥ na siñceyurjalaṃ tasmādapi sannidhivartinaḥ tathā'nirṇītavittānāmasiddhau nyāsavikrayau bhuñcīta dūravartināntu kā vārtā tanmūlyaṃ dāpayettena svāmine sarvarthā nṛpaḥ vyavahāre kṛte tatra dhārtā sampoṣayet paśūn niyamena vinā kālalābhayoranyathā bhavet

syātām tanmūlyaṃ nṛpeṇa na dāpayitavyamiti sūcayāmāsa dhārtetyatrārdhadhātukasyeḍūlāderiti neḍāgamaḥ mṛte pitari sarveṣāmaṃśināṃ sammatiṃ vinā nṛpastadanyathā kartuṃ kṣamo bhavati pārvati dānaṃ tathaiva kanyāyā brāhmohvāhaḥ sakṛt sakṛt phalam ityamaraḥ phalārthaṃ naiva yojayet tadvikrayaṇamanyathā kartuṃ nṛpo narādhipaḥ kṣamo bhavati śaivavidhibhistu punarudvāho bhavatyeveti sūcayāmbabhūve naikakanyaḥ sutāṃ śaivodvāhe pitṛhitaḥ pumān yadvidadhyāt pratinidhistanniyantuḥ kṛtirbhavet niyoktṛkṛtadoṣeṇa vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ yadyadaṅgīkṛtaṃ lokaistatkāryaṃ dharmasammatam yataḥ pitṛbhyo hito'to na dadyādityarthaḥ vidhirvidhānam tatpātṝn pāti viśveśastasmāllokahito bhavet svīkṛtaṃ sarvathā lokānāmakaraṇīyamiti dhvanitam tribhuvanajanamātā pārvatī prādda bhaktyā sūkṣmātisūkṣmabhūtāyāḥ kathaṃ rūpanirūpaṇam etanme saṃśayaṃ deva viśeṣācchettumarhasi dṛḍhamānasā sā mahākālī | etat etam guṇakriyānusāreṇa rūpaṃ devyāḥ prakalpitam praviśanti tathā kālyāṃ sarvabhūtāni śailaje

hitāyāḥ prāptayogānāṃ varṇaḥ kṛṣṇo nirūpitaḥ amṛtatvāllalāṭe'syāḥ śaśicihnaṃ nirūpitam sampaśyati yatastasmāt kalpitaṃ nayanatrayam prakalpitaṃ na tu vāstavamiti puraiva kathitam labdhajñānarūpamokṣopāyānām || 5 nirūpitaṃ kathitam kālikam kālasambhavam tadraktasaṅgho deveśyāḥ vāsorūpeṇa bhāṣitam preraṇaṃ svasvakāryeṣu varaścābhayamīritam ato hi kathitaṃ bhadre raktapadmāsanasthitā paśyantī cinmayī devī sarvasākṣisvarūpiṇī kalpitāni hitārthāya bhaktānāmalpamedhasām tasyānurūpato mūrtiṃ mṛṇmayīṃ vā śilāmayīm dantena | tadraktasaṅghaḥ sarvasattvarudhirasamūhaḥ ityarthaḥ viṣṭabhya avalambya kālikam kālasambhavaṃ jagat | cinmayī jñānasvarūpā sthāpayettatra deveśīṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tasya jāyate kartavyā tadaśeṣeṇa kṛpayā me prakāśyatām pratiṣṭhā sūcitā pūrvaṃ gaditā na viśeṣataḥ kathyatāṃ parameśāna kṛpayā yadi rocate kathayāmi tava snehāt samāhitamanāḥ śṛṇu akāmānāṃ padaṃ mokṣaḥ kāmināṃ phalamucyate sa tallokamavāpnoti bhogānapi tadudbhavān apinā phalam

dārupāṣāṇadhātūnāṃ kramāddaśaguṇādhikam saṃskuryādutsṛjedvāpi tasya puṇyaṃ niśāmaya varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sa vaseddevaveśmani tato'yutaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śilāgehapradānataḥ sukhaṃ surālayaṃ prāpya modate svarnivāsibhiḥ bhuṅkte manoramān bhogān manaso yānabhīpsitān nivaseyuḥ śataṃ varṣānambhasāṃ pratiśīkaram pratiśīkaram pratyambukaṇam sa tena rakṣito nityaṃ talloke nivasecciram dāruje taddaśaguṇaṃ śilāje taddaśādhikam datte phalamavāpnoti kramāt śataguṇādhikam garuḍaṃ kaiśave gehe pradadyāt sādhakottamaḥ caturaṅghrirvajranakho mahāsiṃhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ bṛhatkakut kṛṣṇapucchaḥ śyāmaskandho vṛṣaḥ smṛtaḥ pādasaṅkocasaṃviṣṭaḥ pakṣayuktaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ rintikā pittalam || 31 tathābhūtaḥ | caturaṅghriḥ catuṣpāt nīlakṣuraḥ manuṣyamukhaḥ dhvajadaṇḍastu kartavyo dvātriṃśaddhastasammitaḥ veṣṭito raktavastreṇa koṭau cakrasamanvitaḥ śobhamānā dhvajāgre yā patākā sā prakīrtitā pānaprāśanatāmbūlabhājanāni patadgraham sa tallokaṃ samāsādya tattatkoṭiguṇaṃ labhet niṣkāmānāntu nirvāṇaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam

devatānāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ vāstudaityaṃ prapūjayet dhvajadaṇḍa ityādinā sārdhena | koṭau agrabhāge || 36 dhvajadaṇḍāgrabhāge pātraviśeṣam vighnaṃ tasyā'caredvāstuḥ parivāragaṇaiḥ saha koṭarākṣo lambakarṇo dīrghajaṅgho mahodaraḥ ete parikarā vāstoḥ pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi yatra vāstuṃ prapūjayet vāyvīśakoṇayormadhye hastamātrapramāṇataḥ īśānādagniparyantamaparāṃ racayettathā dattvā rekhe catuṣkoṇamekaṃ maṇḍalamālikhet yathā tatra bhaveddevi matsyapucchacatuṣṭayam kauberād yāmyaparyantaṃ dadyādrekhādvayaṃ sudhīḥ karṇākarṇiprayogeṇa nyasedrekhācatuṣṭayam pañcavarṇena cūrṇena racayedyantramuttamam caturdalaṃ pītaraktakarṇikaṃ raktakesaram koṇasūtre pātayitvā caturdhā vibhajet vibhaktaṃ kuryāt rekhādvayaṃ dadyāt rekhādvayamuttarasmāddakṣiṇāvadhi ca rekhādvayaṃ nyaset maṇḍalamālikhedityapekṣāyāmāha pañcavarṇenetyādi yatheṣṭaṃ pūrayet padmasandhisthānāni varṇakaiḥ śvetakṛṣṇapītaraktaiścaturvarṇaiḥ prapūrayet vāmāvartena devānāṃ pūjanaṃ teṣu sādhayet īśādidvādaśe koṣṭhe kapilāsyādidānavān yathāśaktyā'hutiṃ dattvā vāstuyajñaṃ samāpayet

yāṃ sādhayannaraḥ kvāpi vāstuvighnairna bādhyate dhyānaṃ na gaditaṃ nātha tadidānīṃ prakāśaya śrīdevyuvāca maṇḍalamityādinā yasyānuśīlanāt sadyo naśyanti sakalāpadaḥ trilocanaṃ karālāsyaṃ hārakuṇḍalaśobhitam gadātriśūlaparaśukhaṭvāṅgaṃ dadhataṃ karaiḥ śatrūṇāmantakaṃ sākṣādudyadādityasannibham mārībhaye rogabhaye ḍākinyādibhaye tathā dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayedvāstuṃ parivārasamanvitam yathā vāstuḥ pūjanīyaḥ proktakarmasu suvrate brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca vāṇī lakṣmīśca śaṅkarī evaṃ prārthitaḥ san śrīsadāśiva uvāca dhyānamityādi vāstordhyānamevāha caturbhujamityādinā sārdhatrayeṇa lomaśam bahulomaviśiṣṭam pitaro yadyatṛptāḥ syuḥ karmasveteṣu kālike ato maheśi yatnena proktasaṃskārakarmasu grahayantraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvaśāntividhāyakam tritrikoṇairlikhedyantraṃ tadvahirvṛttamālikhet caturdvārānvitaṃ kuryāt bhūpuraṃ sumanoharam vṛttaṃ viracayedekaṃ prādeśaparimāṇakam rakṣovāruṇayormadhye cāparaṃ kalpayettathā sendrāḥ indrādidaśadikpatisahitāḥ | yacchanti dadati madhyatrikoṇadvau pārśvau savyadakṣiṇabhedataḥ aṣṭadikpativarṇena parṇānyaṣṭau prapūrayet puro bahiḥsthe dve vṛtte devi prādeśasammite

sandhisthānāni yantrasya svecchayā raṃjayet sudhīḥ yaddvāre'vasthitā ye ca tatkramaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam paścāt pracaṇḍayordaṇḍau pūjayedaṃśumālinaḥ āgneye maṅgalaṃ yāmye budhaṃ nairṛtakoṇake varṇena viśiṣṭaiścūrṇairaṣṭau parṇāni patrāṇi prapūrayet rāhuṃ ketuṃ yajet candraṃ paritastārakāgaṇān rāhuketū vicitrābhau grahavarṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ cintayecchaśinaṃ dānamudrāmṛtakarāmbujam dhyāyet somātmajaṃ bālaṃ bhālalolitakuntalam evaṃ daityaguruñcāpi kāṇaṃ khañjaṃ śanaiścaram paritaḥ sarvataḥ ityādinā sārdhena | sūraḥ sūryaḥ śaśinaṃ candraṃ vicintayet kuntalāḥ keśā yasya tathābhūtam || 87 svaiḥ svairdhyānairgrahāniṣṭvā yajedindrādidikpatīn sahasrākṣaṃ yajedādau pītakauṣeyavāsasam raktābhaṃ chāgavāhasthaṃ śaktihastaṃ hutāśanam nirṛtiṃ khaḍgahastañca śyāmalaṃ vājivāhanam dhyāyet kṛṣṇatviṣaṃ vāyuṃ mṛgasthañcāṅkuśāyudham stutaṃ yakṣagaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ pāśāṅkuśakarāmbujam vyāghracarmāmbaradharaṃ pūrṇendusadṛśaprabham iṣṭvā pūjayitvā kālam yamam | lulāpastham mahiṣastham ūrdhvādhovṛttayorarcyau tato'rcyā dvāradevatāḥ yāmyadvāre paścime ca vṛkāśvānandadurjayāḥ

uttaradvārapāścaite sarve śastrāstrapāṇayaḥ śrūyatāṃ brahmaṇo dhyānamanantasyāpi suvrate haṃsārūḍho varābhītimālāpustakapāṇikaḥ sahasrapāṇivadano dhyeyo'nantaḥ surāsuraiḥ vāstvādikramato hyeṣāṃ mantrānapi śṛṇu priye brahmaṇo dhyānamevāha raktotpalanibha ityādinā || 99 eṣām vāstvādīnāmanantāntānām bhūṣito nādabindubhyāṃ vāstumantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ vahnijāyāṃ tato dattvā sūryamantraṃ samuddharet amṛtaṃ plāvaya dvandaṃ svāhā somamanurmataḥ svāhāvasāno mantro'yaṃ maṅgalasya prakīrtitaḥ vāstumantra uddhṛta āsīt somamanurmataḥ svāhānto'yaṃ maṅgalasya mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ pūrayā'nte vahnikāntāmeṣa somātmaje manuḥ abhīṣṭaṃ yaccha yaccheti svāhāmantro bṛhaspateḥ mārtaṇḍasūnave paścāt namo mantraḥ śanaiścare rāhave nama ityeṣa rāhormanurudāhṛtaḥ somātmaje budhe manurmataḥ abhīṣṭaṃ yaccha yaccha svāheti bṛhaspatermantro mataḥ kathitaḥ mataḥ p. 416) krū/ hra/ krai/ ketave svāhā ketormantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ indrādyanantadikpānāṃ daśamantrāḥ samīritāḥ anuktamantre sarvatra vidhireṣa śivoditaḥ

svāhānte'pi tathāmantre na dadyādvahnivallabhām teṣāṃ varṇānurūpeṇa nānyathā prītaye bhavet puṣpairuccāvacairyadvā samidbhirhomamācaret pratiṣṭhāyāṃ lohitākṣaḥ śatruhā krūrakarmaṇi ityeṣa rāhormanurudāhṛtaḥ kathitaḥ || 111 dikpānāṃ daśamantrāḥ samīritāḥ kathitāḥ || 113 vahnivallabhām svāheti padam teṣāṃ grahādīnām samidbhiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ grahayāgaṃ prakurvāṇo vācchitārthamavāpnuyāt vāstoryāge grahāṇāñca tadvadeva vidhīyate tantreṇa tatra devārcā pitṛśrāddhāgnisaṃskriyāḥ vāhanāsanayānāni vāso'laṅkaraṇāni ca asaṃskṛtāni devāya na pradadyuḥ phalepsavaḥ vidhivākyānusāreṇa sampūrṇasukṛtāptaye sampradānābhidhāñcoktvā dattvā samyak phalaṃ labhet kathyante prokṣaṇe mantrāḥ prayojyā brahmavidyayā saṃpradānābhidhāṃ sampradānanāmadheyam brahmavidyayā gāyatryā saha prokṣaṇe tava tṛpyantu jalabhūcarakhecarāḥ tvāṃ prokṣayāmi toyena prītaye bhava sarvadā iṣṭhakādisamudbhūta vaktavyantviṣṭakāmaye yacchantu me'khilān kāmān prokṣitāstīrthavāribhiḥ mayā saṃprokṣitaḥ seto yathoktaphalado bhava dadāsīha tathā svarge saṃkramo me pradīyatām

sa eva śākhisaṃskāre prayoktavyo manīṣibhiḥ varuṇadevatāka vāseya vāsāya hita śākhādyairiti sarvasādhāraṇadravyaprokṣaṇe viniyojayet anyatraivā'rghyatoyena kuśāgreṇa viśodhayet pūjito'laṅkṛto vāho deyo bhavati daivate pūjyo viṣṇurjagatpātā sarvātmā sarvadṛgvibhuḥ kramo na darśito yena mānavaḥ karma sādhayet na yacchanti phalaṃ samyak nṝṇāṃ karmānujīvinām brahmavidyayā gāyatryā sarvadṛk sakalapadārthadraṣṭā | vibhuḥ vyāpakaḥ vividhānītyādinā || 138 niḥśreyasantallokānāṃ phalavyāpṛtacetasām vāstuyāgakramāddevi kathayāmyavadhīyatām kṛtvā paurvāhnikaṃ karma guruṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yajet kṛtasaṅkalpako mantrī gaṇeśādīn samarcayet nānālaṅkārayuktaṃ bhajata gaṇapatiṃ raktapadmopaviṣṭam brahmāṇañca tato vāṇīṃ viṣṇuṃ lakṣmīṃ samarcayet yeṣāṃ te teṣām anuṣṭhānam sādhanam pūrve'hnītyādibhiḥ || 142 ghṛtadhārāsvapi vasūniṣṭvā kuryāt pitṛkriyām nirmāya pūjayettatra vāstudaityaṃ gaṇaiḥ saha dhārāhomāntamācarya vāstuhomaṃ samārabhet

tathā pūjitadevebhyo dattvā karma samāpayet anenaiva grahāṇāñca yajño'pi vihitaḥ priye saṅkalpānantaraṃ kāryaṃ vāstvarcanamiti kramaḥ grahāṇāṃ yantramantrau ca dhyānaṃ prāgeva kīrtitam atha prastutakṛtyānāmucyate kūpasaṃskriyā iṣṭvā pūjayitvā || 146 ācarya vidhāya tasmai vāstudaityāya maṇḍale kalaśe vāpi śālagrāme yathāmati śivo durgā grahāścāpi pūjyā dikpatayastathā prādhānyaṃ varuṇasyātra sa hi pūjyo viśeṣataḥ vidhivat saṃskṛte vahnau vāruṇaṃ homamācaret pūrṇāhutyantakṛtyena homakarma samāpayet uktaprokṣaṇamantreṇa prokṣayet kūpamuttamam sarvabhūtaprīṇanāyotsṛjet kūpajalāśayam suprīyantāṃ sarvabhūtā nabhobhūtoyavāsinaḥ tṛpyantu sarvabhūtāni snānapānāvagāhanaiḥ ye ca kecidvipadyante svasvakarmavipākataḥ kūpasaṃskārakramamevāha saṃkalpamityādibhiḥ || 154 tatastu dakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā kṛtaśāntyādikakriyaḥ jalāśayapratiṣṭhāsu sarvatraiṣa kramaḥ śive taḍāgādau ca kartavyā nāgastambhajalecarāḥ kāryā dhātumayāścaite kartṛvittānusārataḥ rājatau makarau kūrmamithunaṃ tāmrarintikam sāgarañca samutsṛjya prārthayannāgamarcayet

kartavyāḥ ityapekṣāyāmāha mīnamaṇḍūketyādinā kulīraḥ karkaṭaḥ śaṅkhaḥ pāthasāṃ rakṣakā ime smṛtvā praṇavagāyatryau ghaṭamadhye viniḥkṣipet tatrottiṣṭhati yo nāgastaṃ kuryāttoyarakṣakam saralaṃ dārujaṃ tailairukṣitañca haridrayā tatra hrīśrīkṣamāśāntisahitaṃ nāgamarcayet nāgāḥ pāthasāṃ jalānāṃ rakṣakā bhavantītyanvayaḥ ghaṭamadhye viniḥkṣipet uttiṣṭhati taṃ nāgaṃ toyarakṣakaṃ kuryāt hrīśrīkṣamāśāntisahitaṃ nāgamarcayet || 173 stambhamenamadhiṣṭhāya jalarakṣāṃ kuruṣva me samāropya taḍāgañca kartā kuryāt pradakṣiṇam tajjalaṃ tatra niḥkṣipya śiṣṭaṃ karma samāpayet vāstvādivasupūjāntaṃ paitraṃ karma ca kūpavat prājāpatyañca havanaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ jalarakṣāṃ kuruṣva ṣaṣṭyā vā ityanenāvyayībhāvaḥ tatra taḍāge niḥkṣipya śiṣṭamavaśeṣaṃ karma samāpayet atra gṛhasaṃskāre īśānābhimukho bhūtvā prārthayedvihitāñjaliḥ asmākaṃ śubhavāsāya sarvathā sukhado bhava viprān kulīnān dīnāṃśca bhojayedātmaśaktitaḥ devatrākṛtagehasya vidhānaṃ śṛṇu śailaje devatāsannidhiṃ gatvā prārthayedvihitāñjaliḥ

āgatya janmasāphalyaṃ kuru me karuṇānidhe bhūtvā vihitāñjaliḥ san gṛhaṃ prārthayet devatādhīnakṛtagṛhasya dānasya vidhānaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu vihitāñjaliḥ san devatāṃ prārthayet yat prārthayettadāha uttiṣṭhetyādinā upasthāpya gṛhadvāri purato vāhanaṃ nyaset ropayenmandireśāne sapatākaṃ dhvajaṃ sudhīḥ śobhayitvā gṛhaṃ samyak chādayeddivyavāsasā snāpayedvihitairdravyaistatkramaṃ vacmi te śṛṇu dugdhena snāpayāmi tvāṃ māteva paripālaya dadhnā tvāṃ snāpayāmyadya bhavatāpaharo bhava sthāpayet sapatākaṃ patākāsahitaṃ dhvajaṃ ropayet || 187 dravyairdevasnāpanasya kramam devaṃ snāpayet madhunā snāpitaḥ prīto māmānandamayaṃ kuru snānaṃ te kalpayāmīśa māmarogaṃ sadā kuru deveśa śarkarātoyaiḥ snāto me yaccha vāñchitam nārikelodakaiḥ snānaṃ kalpayāmi namo'stu te kuru iti samuccaran kartā madhunā devaṃ snāpayet āyuḥśukravardhakena tejasā tejovardhakena iti ca samudīrayan kartā śarkarātoyairdevaṃ snāpayet p. 429) gāyatryā mūlamantreṇa snāpayedikṣujaiḥ rasaiḥ susnāto bhava suprīto bhuktimuktī prayaccha me gṛhābhyantaramānīya sthāpayedāsanopari

śālagrāmaśilāyāṃ vā snāpayitvā prapūjayet iti samuccaran kartā nārikelajalairdevaṃ snāpayet kāśmīram kuṅkumam gṛhābhyantaramānīya ca jagatpatiṃ devamāsanopari sthāpayet prapūjayet aṣṭabhiḥ kalaśairyadvā pañcabhiḥ saptabhiryathā sarvatrāgamakṛtyeṣu sa eva vihito ghaṭaḥ tatropacārān vakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi parātpare madhuparkastathācamyaṃ snānīyaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇe devārcanāsu nirdiṣṭā upacārāśca ṣoḍaśa gandhādipañcakaṃ caite upacārā daśa smṛtāḥ pañcopacārāḥ kathitā devatāyāḥ prapūjane snāpayet || 200 mahādevam mahāntaṃ devam | tatra devayajane sampūjya gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ dravyākhyānaṃ samullikhet sacaturthīṃ samuccārya tyāgārthaṃ vacanaṃ paṭhet anena vidhinā vidvān dravyaṃ dadyāddivaukase arpaṇaṃ kāraṇādīnāṃ sarvameva pradarśitam āsanādyupacārāṇāṃ pradāne viniyojayet kalpayāmyupaveśārthamāsanaṃ te namo namaḥ namo namo'stu anena mantreṇa devāyā'sanaṃ dadyāt kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā svāgataṃ prārthayettataḥ susvāgataṃ svāgataṃ me tasmai te paramātmane svāgataṃ yattvayā tanme tapasāṃ phalamāgatam vihitaṃ pādyamādāya mantramenamudīrayet

tatpādābjaprokṣaṇārthaṃ pādyante kalpayāmyaham svāgataṃ susvāgatamiti svāgataṃ bhaktyā devaṃ prārthayet svāgataṃ susvāgatam tasmai paramātmane te tubhyaṃ namaḥ mama tapasāmapi phalamāgatam pādyamādāya gṛhītvā etaṃ mantramudīrayedvadet samarpayāmi imaṃ mantramudīrya devāya pādyaṃ dadyāt tasmai sarvātmabhūtāya ānandārghyaṃ samarpaye prokṣitārcitamādāya mantreṇā'nena cārpayet tasmai mukhāravindāya ācāmaṃ kalpayāmi te madhuparkaṃ samādāya bhaktyā'nena samarpayet madhuparkaṃ dadāmyadya prasīda parameśvara tasmiṃste vadanāmbhoje punarācamanīyakam devāya arpayet mantreṇā'camanīyaṃ devatāmukhe dadyāt mantreṇa devāya samarpayet tameva mantramāha tāpatrayavināśārthamiti ācamanīyaṃ dadyāt nidhāya devapurato mantramenamudīrayet tasmai te jagadādhāra snānārthaṃ toyamarpaye anyadravyapradānānte dadyāttoyaṃ sakṛt sakṛt dhṛtvā karābhyāmuttolya paṭhedenaṃ manuṃ sudhīḥ vāsasī paridhānāya kalpayāmi namo'stu te prokṣyā'rcayitvā devāya dadyādenaṃ samuccaran māyāvigrahabhūṣārthaṃ bhūṣaṇāni samarpaye mantramudīrayet

mantreṇa devāya vastre dadyāt || 228 mantramāha viśvābharaṇa bhūtāyeti tasmai parātmane tubhyaṃ paramaṃ gandhamarpaye mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā puṣpametat pragṛhyatām āghreyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhūpo ghrāṇāya te'rpyate sabāhyābhyantarajyotirdīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām nivedayāmi bhaktyedaṃ juṣāṇa parameśvara sarvatṛptikaraṃ svacchamarpayāmi namo'stu te tāmbūlaṃ punarācamyaṃ dattvā vandanamācaret gandhaṃ dadyāt puṣpamityādinā mantreṇa devāya puṣpaṃ dadyāt mantreṇa devāya dhūpaṃ dadyāt suprakāśa ityādimantreṇa devāya dīpaṃ dadyāt naivedyamityādinā devāya naivedyaṃ dadyāt dadyādvā pṛthagādhāraṃ tattannāma samuccaran sācchādanaṃ gṛhaṃ prokṣya paṭhedenaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ devatāsthitidāneṣu sumerusadṛśo bhava yat tvayā vidhṛto devastasmāt tvaṃ suravanditaḥ māyavidhṛtadehasya tasya mūrtervidhāraṇāt sarvakāmaprado bhūtvā śāntiṃ me kuru te namaḥ ātmanaḥ kāmamuddiśya dadyāddevāya sādhakaḥ enaṃ kaṃ paṭedityākāṅkṣāyāmāha geha tvamityādi kukṣau udare || 242 dadyāt aṅgīkuru maheśāna kṛpayā sannidhīyatām

śaṅkhatūryādighoṣaistaṃ sthāpayedvedikopari iti devaṃ sthirīkṛtya bhavanaṃ prārthayet punaḥ utsṛṣṭe tvayi me lokāḥ sthirāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ māṃ ca me parivārāṃśca devadhāmni nivāsaya yatphalaṃ tatphalaṃ me'dya jāyatāṃ tvatprasādataḥ viśvāsaḥ tasmai vedikopari sthāpayet punarbhavanaṃ gṛhaṃ prārthayet yāvaddivāniśānāthau tāvanme vartatāṃ kulam darpaṇādyanyavastūni dhvajaṃ cāpi nivedayet śivāya vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā prārthayedvihitāñjaliḥ pṛṣṭhe vahasi deveśaṃ pūjyo'si tridaśairapi nigamāgamatantrāṇi daśanāgre vasanti te vāsaṃ dadātu kailāse tvaṃ māṃ pālaya sarvadā yathā stūyānmaheśāni tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu devānāṃ jayado bhīmo danujānāṃ vināśakṛt vṛṣabha tvamityādi daśanāgre dantāgre suprītaḥ bhavatu iti śeṣaḥ || 256 devyai samarpito bhaktyā jahi śatrūnnamo'stu te namaste'stu khagendrāya pakṣirāja namo'stu te tathā māmaridarpaghna viṣṇoragre nivāsaya tvayi prīte jagannāthaḥ prītaḥ siddhiṃ prayacchati nṛtyairgītaiśca vāditraiḥ sāmātyaḥ sahabāndhavaḥ veśmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ natvā'śayeddvijān

ārāmasetusaṃkrāmaśākhināmīrito'pi saḥ pūjāhomau tathā sarvaṃ gṛhadānavidhānavat tasmai devāya arcyā'pratiṣṭhite deve pūjādānaṃ vidhīyate yena pratiṣṭhitā devī tūrṇaṃ yacchati vāñchitam saṃkalpaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā yajedvāstvīśvaraṃ tataḥ vidhāya sādhakairvipraiḥ pratimāsannidhiṃ vrajet ānīyā'rcāmarcayitvā snāpayet sādhakottamaḥ veśyādvāramṛdā cāpi pradyumnahṛdajātayā kārayitvā gandhatailaiḥ snāpayet pratimāṃ sudhīḥ ityādibhiḥ | taddine śrīmadādyāpratiṣṭhādine herambo gaṇeśaḥ snāpayet bhasmanetyādi || 272 ete nigaditāḥ snāne kaṣāyāḥ pañca bhūruhāḥ pāṭalīkusumañcāpi pañcapuṣpaṃ prakīrtitam varvarātulasībilvaṃ patratrayamudāhṛtam pañcāmṛte gandhataile toyayogaṃ vivarjayet etaddravyasya toyena snāpayāmi namo vadet kavoṣṇasalilaiścāpi snāpayet pratimāṃ budhaḥ śālītaṇḍulacūrṇena mārjayitvā virukṣayet ityapekṣāyāmāha eteṣvityādinā sammārjitāṅgīṃ pratimāṃ pūjāsthānaṃ samānayet kalaśaiḥ snāpayedarcāṃ bhaktyā sādhakasattamaḥ pādyārghyādyairarcayitvā prārthayedvihitāñjaliḥ

namaste devatāvāse bhaktābhīṣṭaprade namaḥ śilpadoṣāvaśiṣṭāṅgaṃ sampannaṃ kuru te namaḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ mūlaṃ japtvā gātrāṇi saṃspṛśet ṣaḍdīrghabhājā mūlena ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret aṣṭavargairdevatāṅge varṇanyāsaṃ prakalpayet cavargamudare dakṣabāhau ṭādyakṣarāṇi ca pavargañca yavargañca śavargaṃ mastake nyaset varṇanyāsaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ tattvanyāsaṃ samācaret tejastattvaṃ nābhideśe vāyutattvaṃ hṛdambuje ghrāṇayorgandhatattvañca śabdatattvaṃ śrutidvaye manastattvaṃ bhruvormadhye sahasradalapaṅkaje mahattattvamahaṅkāratattvaṃ sarvāṅgake kramāt vatāṅge varṇanyāsaṃ prakalpayet kuryāt nyasedityākāṃkṣāyāmāha mukhe svarānityādi || 290 p. 444) tāramāyāmādyena ṅe namo'ntena vinyaset namo'ntaṃ mātṛkāsthāne mantranyāsaṃ prayojayet iyaṃ te kalpitā mūrtiratra tvāṃ sthāpayāmyaham prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ sampādya pūjayet paradevatām ta evātra prayoktavyā mantraliṅgena pūjane āvāhya devīṃ sampūjya jātakarmāṇi sādhayet cūḍopanayanaṃ caite ṣaṭsaṃskārāḥ śivoditāḥ sāmantraṇābhidhānaṃ te jātakarmādi nāma ca pṛthivītattvādikaṃ pādādau vinyaset vidadhyāt pañcapañcāhutīrdadyāt pratisaṃskārakarmaṇi

devyai dattvā'huteraṃśaṃ pratimāmūrdhni niḥkṣipet bhojayet sādhakān viprān dīnānāthāṃśca toṣayet snāpayitvā'rcayan śaktyā śrāvayennāma devatām evaṃ durgādividyānāṃ maheśādidivaukasām prayoktavyo vidhānajñairmantranāmohapūrvakam kathitaṃ me kṛpānātha tṛptā'smi tava bhāvataḥ acalasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ vidhireva kaḥ idaṃ hi paramaṃ tattvaṃ praṣṭuṃ vada vṛṇomi kam āśutoṣo dīnanātho mamā'nandavibardhanaḥ bhāvataḥ prītitaḥ || 1 tattvamityādi sarvavit sarvavicārakaḥ yatsthāpanānmahāpāpairmukto yāti paraṃ padam nistoye toyakaraṇāt dīnārtaparitoṣaṇāt śivaliṅgapratiṣṭhāyāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ tatra brahmā ca viṣṇuśca sendrāstiṣṭhanti devatāḥ puṇyakṣetrāṇi sarvāṇi vartante śivasannidhau śatahastapramāṇena śivakṣetraṃ prakīrtitam yatrā'marā virājante sarvatīrthāni sarvadā sa sarvapāpanirmukto yātyante śaṅkarālayam prabhāvāddhūrjaṭestattatkoṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet śaivakṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepasamaṃ priye yat karoti śivakṣetre tadanantāya kalpate yat phalaṃ tadavāpnoti sakṛjjaptvā śivāntike yat prāpnoti tadatraiva sakṛt piṇḍapradānataḥ

śaivatīrthe kṛtaśrādhāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatim yatrāsti tatra tiṣṭhanti bhuvanāni caturdaśa anādibhūtabhūteśamahimā vāgagocaraḥ vidyate vidyate naitalliṅgarūpadhare hare śivakṣetre mahatīrthe tathā jānīhi kālike prabhāvaḥ śivaliṅgasya mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate sādhakaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā svābhīṣṭaphalasiddhaye so'śvamedhāyutaphalaṃ labhate sādhakottamaḥ ghṛtaṃ svastikasindūraṃ śaṅkhakajjalarocanāḥ adhivāsavidhau viṃśaddravyāṇyetāni yojayet anenā'muṣyapadataḥ śubhamastvadhivāsanam pratiṣṭhāpūrvasāyāhne ityādibhiḥ dhavalasarṣapaḥ || 26 tataḥ praśastipātreṇa tridhaivamadhivāsayet gṛhadānavidhānena dugdhādyaiḥ snāpayettataḥ pūjānuṣṭhānavidhinā gaṇeśādīn samarcayet dhyāyet sadāśivaṃ śāntaṃ candrakoṭisamaprabham vibhūtiliptasarvāṅgaṃ nāgālaṅkārabhūṣitam yuktaṃ trinayanaṃ bibhrajjaṭājūṭadharaṃ vibhum kapālaṃ pāvakaṃ pāśaṃ pinākaṃ paraśuṃ karaiḥ varañca bibhrataṃ sarvairdevairmunivaraiḥ stutam vibhrataṃ dadhatam himakundendusaṅkāśaṃ vṛṣāsanavirājitam gīyamānamumākāntamekāntaśaraṇapriyam saṃpūjyā'vāhya talliṅge yajecchaktyā vidhānataḥ

mūlamatra manuṃ vakṣye maheśasya mahātmanaḥ ardhendubindubhūṣāḍhyaṃ śivabījaṃ prakīrtitam niveśya divyaśayyāyāṃ devīmevaṃ viśodhayet māyayā'tra karanyāsau prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret māyayā hrī/ bījena pīnottuṅgapayodharāṃ bhayaharāṃ pītāmbarāṃ cintaye tatastu daśa dikpālān vṛṣabhañca samarcayet bhagavatyā manuṃ vakṣye yenā'rādhyā jaganmayī binduyuktaṃ tadante ca yojayedvahnivallabhām dadhiyuktamāṣabhaktaṃ śarkarādisamanvitam saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ mantreṇānena cārpayet piśācā mātaro yakṣā bhūtāśca pitarastathā parivārya mahādevaṃ tiṣṭhantu girijāmapi gītavādyādibhiḥ sadbhirvidadhyānmaṅgalakriyām saṃkalpaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā pañca devān prapūjayet svāheti mantro jātaḥ | thāntamityatra sāntamiti vākvacit māṣabhaktaṃ sarvadevabaliṃ hareddadyāt ityādikam || 50 enaṃ hrī/ śrī/ dū/ svāhetīmam maheśadvārapālāṃśca yajet bhaktyā samāhitaḥ dvārapālāḥ śivasyaite sarve śastrāstrapāṇayaḥ maṇḍale sarvatobhadre sthāpayedvā śubhāsane snāpayitvā'rcayet bhaktyā ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sādhuḥ prārthayet śaṅkaraṃ śivam pinākapāṇe sarveśa mahādeva namo'stu te

bhagavatyā sahā'gaccha kṛpāṃ kuru namo namaḥ prasīda śambhunā sārdhaṃ namaste'stu harapriye pañca devān brahmādīn || 53 sampūjyānmaheśadvārapālānāha nandītyādinaikena yajāmahe ityādinā mantreṇa devīmitivā kvacit prītā bhava maheśāni sarvasampatkarī bhava sukhaṃ nivasatāṃ gehe prīyetāṃ bhaktavatsalau pradakṣiṇaṃ tridhā veśma kārayitvā praveśayet adhastribhāgaliṅgasya ropayenmūlamuccaran tāvadatra mahādeva sthiro bhava namo'stu te uttarāgrāṃ tatra vedīṃ mūlenaiva praveśayet yāvaddivāniśānāthau tāvadatra sthirā bhava sadāśive vedīṃ praveśayet || 67 p. 456) anena sudṛḍhīkṛtya liṅgaṃ spṛṣṭvā paṭhedimam yakṣā nāgāśca vetālāḥ lokapālā maharṣayaḥ yasya siṃhāsane yuktā bhūcarāḥ khecarāstathā āgaccha bhagavannatra brahmanirmitayantrake tato devapratiṣṭhoktavidhinā snāpayan śivam punardhyātvā maheśānaṃ puṣpaṃ liṅgopari nyaset candanāgurukāśmīrairvilipya girijāpatim jātanāmādisaṃskārān kṛtvā pūrvavidhānavat sudṛḍhīkṛtya vedīmiti śeṣaḥ abhyarcya tatra devasya mūrtīraṣṭau prapūjayet rudro'gnirugro vāyuḥ syād bhīma ākāśaśabditaḥ

īśānaḥ sūrya ityete mūrtayo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ pūrvādīśānaparyantamaṣṭa mūrtīḥ kramādyajet vṛṣaṃ vitānaṃ gehādi dadyādīśāya sādhakaḥ tataḥ kṛtāñjalirbhaktyā prārthayet pārvatīpatim prāguktavidhānena tatra liṅge prāṇānniveśayet || 75 tatra vedyāmeva kṣitirityādibhyāṃ dvābhyām || 78 evamevā'gneyādiṣu kramato'nyā api sapta mūrtīryajet iṣṭvā pūjayitvā || 81 prasīda bhagavan śambho sarvakāraṇakāraṇa tāvadasmin gṛhe tiṣṭha namaste parameśvara na tatpāpaiḥ pralipye'haṃ prasādāttava dhūrjaṭe prabhāte punarāgatya snāpayeccandraśekharam tataḥ sugandhitoyānāṃ kalaśaiḥ śatasaṃkhyakaiḥ saṃpūjya taṃ yathāśaktyā prārthayet bhaktibhāvataḥ sampūrṇamastu tat sarvaṃ tvatprasādādumāpate tāvanme kīrtiratulā loke tiṣṭhatu sarvadā viṣṇubrahmendrasūryādyairarcitāya namo namaḥ śuddhairityādi tam śivam bhakṣyaiḥ peyaiśca vāsobhirdaridrān paritoṣayet sthāvaraṃ śivaliṅgaṃ tu na kadāpi vicālayet saṅkṣepāt parameśāni sarvāgamasamuddhṛtā vidheyaṃ tatra kiṃ bhaktaistanme kathaya tattvataḥ tyājyā vā kena doṣeṇa tadupāyaśca bhaṇyatām

dinadvaye taddviguṇaṃ taddvaiguṇyaṃ dinatraye tadā'ṣṭakalaśairdevaṃ snāpayitvā yajet sudhīḥ punaḥ susaṃskṛtaṃ kṛtvā pūjayet sādhakāgraṇīḥ śrīdevyuvāca yadītyādi | tatra pūjābādhe sati || 95 patitaṃ duṣṭabhūmyādau na devaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ sparśādidoṣaduṣṭaṃ tu saṃskṛtya punararcayet sarvadā pūjayettatra svaṃ svamiṣṭaṃ sukhāptaye niḥśreyasāya tat sarvaṃ saviśeṣaṃ prakīrtitam anicchanto'pi vivaśāḥ kṛṣyante karmavāyunā jāyante ca pralīyante vartante karmaṇo vaśāt pravṛttaye'lpabodhānāṃ duśceṣṭitanivṛttaye aśubhāt karmaṇo yānti prāṇinastīvrayātanām prayāntyāyāntyamutreha karmaśṛṅkhalayantritāḥ tāvanna jāyate mokṣo nṛṇāṃ kalpaśatairapi tathā baddho bhavejjīvaḥ karmabhiścā'śubhaiḥ śubhaiḥ tāvanna labhate mokṣaṃ yāvat jñānaṃ na vindati jāyate kṣīṇatamasāṃ viduṣāṃ nirmalātmanām satyamekaṃ paraṃ brahma viditvaivaṃ sukhī bhavet pariniścitatattvo yaḥ sa muktaḥ karmabandhanāt vimalāntaḥkaraṇānām || 112 brahmaivā'hamiti jñātvā mukto bhavati dehabhṛt dehastho'pi na dehastho jñātvaivaṃ muktibhāg bhavet vihāya brahmaniṣṭho yaḥ sa mukto nā'tra saṃśayaḥ svapnalabdhena rājyena rājāno mānavāstadā kliśyantastapasā jñānaṃ vinā mokṣaṃ na yānti te

brahmajñānavihīnāścenniṣkṛtiṃ te vrajanti kim santi cet pannagā muktāḥ paśupakṣijalecarāḥ pariniścitatattvaḥ || 114 tapasā kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādinā niṣkṛtim nistāram | vrajanti prāpnuvanti || 120 stutirjapo'dhamo bhāvo bahiḥ pūjā'dhamādhamā sarvaṃ brahmeti viduṣo na yogo na ca pūjanam kiṃ tasya japayajñādyaistapobhirniyamavrataiḥ svabhāvāt brahmabhūtasya kiṃ pūjā dhyānadhāraṇā nāpi dhyeyo na vā dhyātā sarvaṃ brahmeti jānataḥ kiṃ tasya bandhanaṃ kasmānmuktimicchanti durdhiyaḥ dhyānarūpaṃ bhajanam tadbhinnaṃ pūjanamapi nāsti tasya || 123 dhāraṇā cittavṛttinirodhaḥ na punarbhavaḥ na punarutpattiḥ nirliptaḥ anāsaktaḥ svayaṃ virājate tatra hyapraviṣṭaḥ praviṣṭavat tathaiva bhāti sadrūpo hyātmā sākṣī svarūpataḥ sadaikarūpaścinmātro vikāraparivarjitaḥ paśyanto'pi na paśyanti māyāprāvṛtabuddhayaḥ tathaiva māyayā dehe bahudhā'tmānamīkṣate tathaiva buddheścāñcalyaṃ paśyantyātmanyakovidāḥ naṣṭe dehe tathaivātmā samarūpo virājate anūhanīyam || 128 ityādyardhena

tarhi kasya janmādikaṃ bhavati tatrāha janmetyādi sadaikarūpa iti tatrāha yathetyādi jānannihaiva muktaḥ syāt satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ātmanā'tmānamājñāya mukto bhavati mānavaḥ loke'sminnātmasambandhāt bhavantyanye priyāḥ śive vicāryamāṇe tritaye ātmaivaiko'vaśiṣyate vijñātā svayamevātmā yo jānāti sa ātmavit caturvidhāvadhūtānāmetadeva paraṃ dhanam kimidaṃ śrūyate citramavadhūtāścaturvidhāḥ caturvidhāvadhūtānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ saviśeṣataḥ śrīdevyuvāca dvividhāvityādi || 141 gṛhāśrame vasanto'pi jñeyāste yatayaḥ priye śaivāvadhūtāste jñeyāḥ pūjanīyāḥ kulārcite vidadhyuḥ sarvakarmāṇi madudīritavartmanā niṣiddhamannaṃ toyañca na gṛhṇīyuḥ kadācana prāgeva kathito dharma ācāraśca varānane sarvamāgamamārgeṇa śaivabrāhmāvadhūtayoḥ pūrṇaḥ paramahaṃsākhyaḥ parivrāḍaparaḥ priye tadā lokālaye tiṣṭhannātmānaṃ sa tu śodhayet brahmamantropāsakā ya ityādi || 143 sadā brahmaparo bhūtvā sādhayet jñānamuttamam kuryādātmocitaṃ karma sadā vairāgyamāśritaḥ yatetā'tmānamuddhartuṃ tattvajñānavivekataḥ gṛhastho vā'pyudāsīnastasyā'bhīṣṭāya tad bhavet o/ tatsanmantraniṣpannāḥ sampūrṇāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ

brāhmyeṇānena mantreṇa sarvakarmāṇi sādhayet nāstyetasmānmahāmantrādupāyāntaramambike gehastasya mahātīrthaṃ dehaḥ puṇyamayo bhavet o/ tatsaditi deveśi tavāgre satyamīritam prādurbhūto'yamoṃ tatsat sarvamantrottamottamaḥ mantrānyaiḥ śodhanenā'laṃ syāccedetena śodhitam svecchācāraḥ śuddhacittaḥ sa eva bhuvi kaularāṭ sākṣād brahmasamo dehī sārthamenaṃ japan manum sādhanādasya mantrasya bhavenmṛtyuñjayaḥ svayam japtvaitasya maheśāni sādhakaḥ siddhibhāg bhavet nāpi daive na vā pitre nārṣe kṛtye'dhikāritā trayo'nye yogabhogāḍhyā muktāḥ sarve śivopamāḥ prārabdhamaśnan viharenniṣedhavidhivarjitaḥ aśnan bhuñjānaḥ turīyo vicaret kṣauṇīṃ niḥsaṅkalpo nirudyamaḥ nirnaketastitikṣuḥ syānniḥśaṅko nirupadravaḥ mukto virakto nirdvandvo haṃsācāraparo yatiḥ lakṣaṇaṃ saviśeṣeṇa sādhūnāṃ matsvarūpiṇām sarvatīrthaphalāvāptirjāyate manujanmanām kulasannyāsināṃ dehe santi tāni sadā priye yairarcitāḥ kuladravyairmānavaiḥ kulasādhavaḥ abhakṣyamapi bhakṣyaṃ syāt yeṣāṃ saṃsparśamātrataḥ ātmaśarīranirvāhārthavyāpāraśūnyaḥ athāvadhūtānāṃ māhātmyamāha eteṣāmityādibhiḥ kuladravyaiḥ madyādibhiḥ || 175

śuddhyanti yeṣāṃ saṃsparśāttān vinā ko'nyamarcayet ye'rcayanti sakṛdbhaktyā te'pi pūjyā mahītale antyajo'pi yamāśritya pūtaḥ kaulapadaṃ vrajet kuladharme nimajjanti sarve dharmāstathā priye ye punantyātmasambandhān mlecchaśvapacapāmarān kulācāre viśanto'pi sarve gacchanti kaulatām tathā kulāmbudhau magnā na bhaveyurjanāḥ pṛthak te sarve'smin kulācāre bhaveyuradhikāriṇaḥ naṭaśca karaṇaścaiva khaso drāviḍa eva ca || iti sarvadharmaparibhraṣṭāste gacchantyadhamāṃ gatim tān vañcayan kulīno'pi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet kaulaṃ na kuryāt yaḥ kaulaḥ so'dhamo yātyadhogatim tasmāt koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyamekasmin kaulike kṛte kaulā bhavantaste pāśairmuktā yānti paraṃ padam snehena śraddhayā premṇā pūjyā mānyāḥ parasparam bhavābdhitaraṇe setuḥ kuladharmo hi nāparaḥ dahyante karmajālāni kuladharmaniṣevaṇāt pāvayanti kulācāraiste jñeyāḥ kaulikottamāḥ mahānirvāṇatantrasya pūrvārdhaṃ lokapāvanam sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ so'nte nirvāṇamāpnuyāt tantrarājamidaṃ jñātvā jāyate sarvaśāstravit jānannetanmahātantraṃ karmapāśairvimucyate sa jñānī brahmavit sādhurya etadvetti kālike kimanyairbahubhistantrairjñātvedaṃ sarvavidbhavet tava praśnena tantre'smiṃstat sarvaṃ suprakāśitam

mahānirvāṇatantraṃ me tathā jānīhi suvrate bhāsvāṃstejaḥsu tantreṣu tantrarājamidaṃ tathā paṭhitvā pāṭhayitvā'pi brahmajñānī bhavennaraḥ na tasya vaṃśe deveśi paśurbhavati karhicit śṛṇvannetanmahātantraṃ karmabandhādvimucyate vandanaṃ parameśāni nṛṇāṃ kaivalyadāyakam sarvadharmānvitaṃ tantraṃ nātaḥparataraṃ kvacit parārdhamasya yo vetti sa sarvajño na saṃśayaḥ trikālavārtāṃ trailokyavṛttāntaṃ kathituṃ kṣamaḥ mahānirvāṇatantrasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm viditvaitanmahātantraṃ brahmanirvāṇamāpnuyāt
